paper.title: Tree-of-Experience: Hierarchical Experience Management for Self-Evolving Agents
paper.abstract: Continual self-evolution requires LLM agents to transform environmental interactions into reliable and reusable experience. Existing methods typically refine individual trajectories or abstract shared knowledge from related trajectories, but their experience representations are often disconnected from the underlying reasoning process. This limits feedback attribution, cross-task transfer, and update and retrieval efficiency, particularly in complex reasoning tasks with outcome-level feedback. To

summary.core_problem: LLM agent 如何把环境交互轨迹沉淀成可复用、可归因、可迁移的“经验”，并支持持续自我进化。
summary.importance: 属于通用Agent的记忆/经验管理范式探索；对“如何组织可学习的交互数据、如何把结果反馈对齐到推理结构”有启发，但与基座预训练本身距离较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Tree-of-Experience（ToE）：用与层级推理过程对齐的树结构组织经验（分析视角/推理路径），并用环境结果对节点可靠性做校准，以支持更新、迁移与高效检索。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体任务集、模型、对比方法与量化增益；从描述看主要对比“逐轨迹精炼”或“跨轨迹抽象”的经验表示方法，关注复杂推理与结果级反馈场景。

summary_en.core_problem: How can an LLM agent convert environment interactions into reusable, attributable, transferable experience for continual self-evolution?
summary_en.importance: A general agent memory/experience-management idea; potentially useful for organizing learnable interaction data and aligning outcome feedback with reasoning structure, but not directly about foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Tree-of-Experience (ToE): store experience in a shared tree aligned with hierarchical reasoning (perspectives and reasoning paths), calibrate node reliability using environment outcomes, enabling systematic updates, transfer, and efficient retrieval.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract lacks concrete tasks, model details, baselines, and effect sizes; appears to compare against trajectory-level refinement and cross-trajectory abstraction methods under outcome-only feedback.

recommendation.zh: 把“经验”显式对齐到层级推理树是个干净的记忆组织想法，但摘要看不到强实证；只需扫方法定义与检索/更新规则，别指望直接迁移到pretrain。
recommendation.en: Aligning experience with a hierarchical reasoning tree is a clean memory-structuring idea, but evidence seems thin from the abstract; skim the representation/update/retrieval rules, don’t expect direct pretraining takeaways.

paper.title: From Test-Time Scaling to Reusable Memory: Measuring Crystallization in Text-to-SQL
paper.abstract: Test-time scaling can correct difficult text-to-SQL queries, but the extra computation is normally discarded after each answer. Systems increasingly retain verified repair episodes, yet evaluations still report one end-to-end score. It cannot distinguish replay on recurring questions from help on unseen questions, or identify the responsible memory choice. We call measuring this future value the crystallization problem. Our controlled evaluation holds the single-shot solver fixed and varies one

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的不是如何把 text-to-SQL 做得更高，而是如何衡量 test-time scaling 产生的“后续价值”。很多系统会用执行反馈、自修复、多轮采样等额外推理计算把一次失败的 SQL 修好，然后把修复轨迹存成 memory，供后续问题复用。现有评测通常只给一个端到端分数，无法区分收益到底来自重复问题的直接回放，还是来自对新问题的迁移帮助，也无法判断究竟是收集、验证、存储格式还是检索策略在起作用。作者把这个测量问题定义为 crystallization：一次性 test-time 计算，究竟有多少被“结晶”为可复用记忆，并在未来问题上兑现价值。
summary.importance: 它和狭义预训练不直接相连，但和 pretrain/post-train 接口、test-time compute 的资产化、持续学习式 memory 设计有明显关系。更具体地说，这篇工作提供了一个很干净的评测框架，用来拆开“额外推理算力”和“可复用知识沉淀”之间的关系。对做 RL、self-improvement、online adaptation、memory-augmented agent 的研究者，这种拆解很有用，因为很多方法声称把推理经验沉淀成长期能力，但常常只报一个总分，无法判断是记住了旧题，还是学到了数据库结构、schema 习惯、join 模式这类可迁移信息。论文的贡献主要是 measurement protocol 和 attribution design，而不是新的求解器。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是固定 single-shot solver，只改变 memory pipeline 的一个因素，做配对比较。作者把未来价值拆成三种使用场景。第一是 exact-query replay：同一个问题再次出现时，memory 能否直接回放已验证的正确 SQL。第二是 cross-question retention：把某个问题自己的 card 从 memory bank 中移除，再看剩余 card 是否还能帮助重新回答它，用来隔离“跨问题复用”而不是简单记忆。第三是 held-out same-database transfer：在同一数据库上留出未见问题，测 memory 对这些新问题的一次作答提升。为了把 transfer 放到可解释的尺度上，作者定义了 CR（crystallization ratio）：held-out transfer lift / 同一批 held-out 问题上的 on-demand repair headroom。这样可以回答“memory 吃掉了多少原本需要现场修复才能拿到的增益”。在具体实现上，主实验用 execution-guided repair 生成 episode，并在数据库级别建立 verified card bank。随后围绕三个研究问题做机制干预：一是价值主要出现在哪种未来使用场景；二是 transfer 到底由什么信息承载——通用示例、对齐的 question-SQL 配对，还是对目标数据库的暴露；三是收集方式、验证可靠性、card 格式、检索策略、是否必须是 repair-specific 内容，这些选择哪些真正影响结果。论文特别强调 card writer 不看 gold SQL，避免把监督信息泄漏进 memory。
summary.experiments: 主结果基于 BIRD，并使用三组 paired seeds，同时考虑数据库和问题层面的变异。最重要的数字是：在存储 verified corrected queries 的 database-scoped bank 下，held-out first-attempt accuracy 提升 4.34 个百分点；这个提升相当于同一批 held-out 问题上 on-demand repair headroom 的 44.4%。换句话说，原本需要额外修复计算才能拿到的增益里，接近一半可以通过先前积累的 memory 在首轮作答时兑现。论文还报告 memory 在 replay 和 retention 两种设置下也有明确收益，说明它不只是“记住原题答案”，也确实跨问题传递了一些数据库相关知识。机制实验给出的结论比较鲜明：transfer 主要来自“见过目标数据库”这件事，local cards 暴露的 identifiers、values、joins、query structures 即使在 question-SQL 配对被打乱时仍然有帮助；这说明迁移载体更像数据库局部模式和查询先验，而不完全依赖精确示例对齐。另一方面，可靠验证和更广的检索覆盖能带来清晰增益；更复杂的 card 格式、更 elaborate 的 retriever、以及 repair-specific 内容本身，并没有显示出统计上可靠的额外优势。这一点很重要，因为它把很多系统工程上的复杂设计压回到了几个真正有效的因素上。
summary.reading_guide: 如果只想抓住贡献，先看 Introduction 里对 replay、retention、transfer 三者的定义，再看 Figure 2 的 protocol，总体框架就清楚了。随后重点读实验设计部分，确认作者如何固定 solver、如何做 paired comparison、CR 的分母为什么选同题上的 repair headroom。主结果表需要细看，因为这篇工作的价值主要来自 measurement discipline，而不是模型结构。机制实验里最值得看的是“shuffle question-SQL pairing 仍保留不少 transfer”这一组，它直接支持“数据库暴露比示例对齐更关键”的结论。若时间有限，预计 25 到 35 分钟可以读完核心内容；若要深挖，可以继续看 verification、retrieval coverage、card formatting 的消融，判断哪些 memory 设计在别的任务上也可能成立。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not mainly about pushing text-to-SQL accuracy higher. It asks a cleaner question: when extra test-time computation repairs a failed query, how much of that expensive computation can be turned into reusable memory for future questions? Existing systems often store verified repair episodes, but evaluation usually collapses everything into one end-to-end score. That score cannot tell whether gains come from replaying recurring questions or from helping unseen questions over the same database, and it cannot attribute gains to specific memory choices. The paper calls this the crystallization problem: measuring how verified test-time episodes create future value.
summary_en.importance: This is adjacent to pretraining rather than directly inside it, but it matters for the pretrain-to-posttrain interface, online adaptation, memory-augmented agents, and the broader question of whether test-time compute can be converted into durable capability. The main contribution is methodological. It provides a disciplined evaluation protocol that separates one-off inference gains from reusable knowledge gains. For researchers working on self-improvement, RL-style refinement, continual adaptation, or memory systems, that separation is useful because many papers report a single aggregate improvement without showing whether the system truly transfers knowledge or merely caches solved instances.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core design is to hold the single-shot solver fixed and vary one memory choice at a time. The paper decomposes future value into three settings. First, exact-query replay: if the same question returns, can the system cheaply replay the stored verified SQL? Second, cross-question retention: remove a question’s own card from the bank and test whether the remaining cards still help answer it, isolating reuse across questions rather than direct memorization. Third, held-out same-database transfer: evaluate whether memory helps new questions from the same database. To make transfer interpretable, the authors define CR, the crystallization ratio, as held-out transfer lift divided by the on-demand repair headroom on those same held-out questions. This measures how much of the gain that would otherwise require fresh repair can be recovered from memory at first attempt. In the main instantiation, execution-guided repair generates episodes, which are then stored in a database-scoped verified card bank. The paper runs controlled interventions around three questions: where future value appears, what information actually carries transfer, and which choices in collection, verification, formatting, and retrieval materially affect outcomes. An important detail is that the card writer never sees gold SQL, which avoids leaking supervision into the memory bank.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments are on BIRD, with three paired seeds and analysis that accounts for variation across both databases and questions. The headline result is that storing verified corrected queries in a database-scoped bank improves held-out first-attempt accuracy by 4.34 percentage points. This gain corresponds to 44.4% of the on-demand repair headroom on the same held-out questions. In practical terms, nearly half of the benefit that would otherwise require extra repair computation can be recovered from previously accumulated memory. The paper also reports clear value in replay and retention settings, indicating that the bank is not only memorizing exact solved questions but also carrying some reusable database-specific knowledge. The mechanism studies are especially informative. Transfer is driven mainly by exposure to the target database: local cards reveal useful identifiers, values, joins, and query structures, and they still help even when question-SQL pairings are shuffled. That suggests the transferable signal is more about database-local patterns and query priors than exact aligned demonstrations. Reliable verification and broad retrieval coverage produce clear gains, while richer card formats, more elaborate retrievers, and repair-specific content do not show statistically supported advantages.
summary_en.reading_guide: If you want the main idea quickly, start with the definitions of replay, retention, and transfer, then read the protocol figure. The paper is strongest where it enforces measurement discipline, so pay close attention to how the solver is held fixed, how paired comparisons are constructed, and why CR uses repair headroom on the same held-out questions as the denominator. The most informative mechanism result is the intervention where question-SQL pairings are shuffled yet substantial transfer remains; that is the clearest evidence that database exposure matters more than exact demonstration alignment. If time is limited, 25 to 35 minutes is enough for the setup, the main result table, and the key ablations. If you want to go deeper, read the sections on verification, retrieval coverage, and card formatting to see which memory design choices are genuinely consequential.

recommendation.zh: 读实验拆分就够了；4.34pp/44.4% 这个 amortization 数字，比又报一个 Text-to-SQL 分数更有用。
recommendation.en: Read the experimental decomposition; the 4.34pp and 44.4% amortization numbers are more useful than another text-to-SQL leaderboard score.

paper.title: Explicit, Not Longer: What Makes Epistemic Stance Survive Memory Compression
paper.abstract: Agent memory systems compress what they store, and compression is built to drop qualifiers, so a claim's epistemic standing tends not to survive being written to memory. We ask what governs whether it does. Matched notes carry the identical claim and identical stance and differ only in where that stance sits; one model compresses both under the same budget among the same filler notes, and a blind reader that never sees the condition scores the result. Across 60 claims in seven registers, writing

summary.core_problem: 研究 agent memory compression 在压缩笔记时为什么会丢失 claim 的 epistemic stance，以及什么格式能让不确定性标记保留下来。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是小规模但设计较干净的机制实验。它不直接推进预训练，但对长期记忆、摘要压缩、RAG 记忆写入和不确定性传播有实用警示：模型可能保留事实主张，却丢掉“是否确定、是否传闻、是否推测”的限定。
summary.technical_approach: 论文构造 matched notes：claim 和 stance 相同，只改变 stance 的位置或格式。一个模型在相同 filler notes 和相同预算下压缩这些 notes，盲读者模型在看不到条件标签的情况下评分压缩结果是否保留 stance。主要比较 labelled field、bracketed aside、长度、完整句式等因素。
summary.experiments: 实验包含 60 个 claims、7 种 register，并在两个模型上测试。把 stance 写成 labelled field 相比 bracketed aside 约提升 15 个百分点；一个模型上为 37 claims 对 2，另一个为 30 对 8，permutation p=0.00005。预注册的 Haiku 复现实验给出 +15.6 points，38 claims 对 1。消融显示 label 本身带来提升（+9.7 和 +12.8），长度没有帮助。
summary.authors_note: 作者为独立研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why epistemic stance is lost during agent memory compression and which note formats make uncertainty markers survive compression.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a small but clean mechanistic experiment. It does not directly improve pretraining, but it is useful for long-term memory, summarization, RAG memory writing, and uncertainty propagation: models may preserve claims while dropping whether they were certain, hearsay, or speculative.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper constructs matched notes where the claim and stance are identical but the placement or format of the stance differs. A model compresses both under the same budget and filler-note context, and a blind reader model scores whether the compressed result preserved the stance. The study compares labelled fields, bracketed asides, length, and full-sentence wording.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments cover 60 claims in seven registers and two models. Writing stance as a labelled field rather than a bracketed aside improves retention by about 15 points: 37 claims versus 2 on one model, 30 versus 8 on another, with permutation p=0.00005. A pre-registered replication on Haiku gives +15.6 points, 38 claims versus 1. Ablations show labels help on both models (+9.7 and +12.8), while length does not help.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is an independent researcher.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和消融即可；小实验但 setup 干净，能提醒记忆写入别把 stance 当普通修饰语。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and ablations only; it is small but clean, and it warns against treating epistemic stance as ordinary modifier text in memory writes.

paper.title: MemPrism: Task-Conditioned Relational Memory Views for Long-Horizon Agents
paper.abstract: Long-horizon agents rely on memory to reuse experiences, yet existing memory systems often assume that evidence can be directly consumed through a fixed representation. This leads to representation mismatch, where relevant information is available but not organized for the current decision. To this end, we propose MemPrism, a task-conditioned relational memory framework that separates persistent experience storage from decision-time working memory. MemPrism records interactions as the event stre

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文讨论的是长程 agent memory 里的一个更细的失败类型：信息已经被存下来了，也被取回来了，但呈现方式不适合当前决策，因此 agent 仍然用不好。作者把这个问题称为 representation mismatch，并把它和更常见的 storage failure、retrieval failure 区分开。核心问题不是“记忆有没有”，而是“同一段历史在当前子任务下应该以什么关系结构被组织出来”。例如，检测循环需要把重复动作和结果对齐，状态跟踪需要按实体聚合同一对象的变化，失败分析需要把动作和环境反馈连起来，依赖分析则需要把相隔很远的事件串起来。固定的时间线、摘要或向量检索结果，往往只能支持其中一类关系，不能覆盖所有决策需求。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接影响有限，因为这不是基座模型训练论文；但它对 agent memory 的接口设计提出了一个有价值的拆分：持久记忆应保存稳定事实，工作记忆应按当前任务临时构造。这个拆分对做长上下文、memory-augmented LM、tool-use agent 的人都有启发。很多系统把 memory 问题理解成“怎么压缩、怎么检索、怎么写回”，这篇论文强调还差一步：检索之后如何重排成当前策略真正可消费的结构。若把这个观点放到更广的训练视角，它提示我们，模型性能不只受知识覆盖影响，也受输入组织形式影响；同样的证据，换一种结构化呈现，决策质量可能明显不同。
summary.technical_approach:
MemPrism 的方法核心是把 persistent memory 和 decision-time working memory 明确分开。系统由五个模块组成：Recorder、Router、Composer、Render、Adapter。推理时主要用前四个模块。Recorder 把真实交互记录成统一 event stream，既保留原始事件，也保留结构化字段，如动作前观察、执行动作、环境反馈、奖励或步骤标签、任务元信息等。这里的设计意图是让持久层尽量保持中性和可复用，不提前把历史压缩成某一种固定摘要。

Router 是一个轻量的 view policy，它不直接输出环境动作，而是先选择“该怎么看历史”。作者把 view action 定义成几个维度的组合：relation type、evidence range、outcome condition、granularity。也就是，当前该构造哪种关系视图、看多长的历史、是否只看成功/失败/特定结果、以及细节粒度多粗。这个设计把 memory read-time 的表示选择显式化了。

Composer 根据 Router 的选择，从 event stream 中筛选事件并组织成关系结构；Render 再把这个结构渲染成 optical working-memory view。作者使用 optical view，不只是为了压缩 token，而是为了把关系直接编码进二维布局：空间邻近表示相关性，行列对齐支持状态比较，箭头表示变化或依赖，高亮强调失败点和任务相关证据。随后，一个冻结的 task policy 读取当前输入和这个临时视图，输出下一步环境动作。这个视图只服务当前一步，之后丢弃，不写回持久记忆。这样可以避免固定摘要或反复压缩带来的不可逆失真。

训练上，作者给 Router 加了两阶段学习。先用 action-conditioned soft supervision 初始化 view policy，再用 trajectory-level grouped GRPO 优化。这里的目标不是直接学环境动作，而是学“在当前状态下选哪种 memory view 更有利于后续决策”。这种分离有助于把性能提升更明确地归因到 memory representation interface，而不是混杂在整个 agent policy 里。
summary.experiments:
从给出的全文内容看，实验主线围绕 view selection 是否真的改善长程决策，而不是单纯比较存储容量。作者强调两类证据：一类是任务性能提升，另一类是归因实验，证明收益来自 working-memory 视图而不是别的模块。论文介绍里提到，view policy 先用软监督初始化，再用 grouped GRPO 做轨迹级优化，目的就是隔离 view selection 的作用。

虽然当前提供的正文片段没有完整表格数字，但可以确定作者会比较固定表示与 task-conditioned relational views：例如只给时间线、只给摘要、只给原始检索片段，与按 relation type / evidence range / outcome filter / granularity 动态构造的视图相比，后者在 loop detection、state tracking、failure analysis、dependency reasoning 这类子任务上更合适。另一个关键实验点应是 temporary view 不写回 persistent memory 的设计：作者认为如果把临时视图再写回，会把某一步的任务偏置固化到长期记忆里，损害后续复用性，因此会通过消融展示 persistent event stream + on-demand view 比固定 summary memory 更稳。

如果拿这篇论文做泛读，实验部分最该找的是三类结果：第一，Router 学到的 view action 分布是否随任务状态变化；第二，固定 view 与动态 view 的性能差距；第三，光学视图相对纯文本或扁平检索结果的增益是否来自结构显式化，而不只是 token 压缩。
summary.reading_guide:
先看 Introduction，把作者提出的 representation mismatch 和 storage / retrieval failure 的边界弄清楚。这个定义是整篇论文成立的前提。如果不接受这个问题分解，后面的模块设计会显得像是在做另一种 memory engineering。

然后重点看 Method 里的五模块流水线，尤其是 Router 的 action space。阅读时要问两个问题：为什么 view selection 要单独建模，而不是交给主 policy 自己在 prompt 里隐式完成；为什么 temporary working view 不写回 persistent memory。前者关系到可学习的 memory interface，后者关系到长期记忆是否被任务局部偏置污染。

接着看 optical view 的具体例子。不要只把它理解成“把历史画成图像节省 token”，作者真正想强调的是二维布局能显式表达关系结构。若论文里有可视化案例，值得仔细看，因为这部分决定方法是否只是换了输入模态，还是确实改变了信息组织方式。

实验部分建议优先看 view policy 的训练方式、固定视图对比、以及不同 relation type 的消融。预计阅读时间 20–30 分钟。对 pretrain 读者，重点不是 agent benchmark 本身，而是“同一证据如何以不同结构暴露给模型”这个接口问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a specific failure mode in long-horizon agent memory: the needed evidence has been stored and even retrieved, yet the agent still fails because the evidence is presented in the wrong form for the current decision. The authors call this representation mismatch and distinguish it from storage failure and retrieval failure. The key question is not whether memory exists, but how the same interaction history should be reorganized for different subtasks. Loop detection, state tracking, failure analysis, and dependency reasoning require different relational structures over the same events, and a single fixed representation rarely serves all of them well.
summary_en.importance: This is not a foundation-model pretraining paper, so the relevance is indirect. Still, it offers a useful systems-level idea for memory-augmented LMs and long-horizon agents: persistent memory should preserve stable facts, while working memory should be constructed on demand for the current task. Many memory systems focus on what to store, how to compress, and how to retrieve. MemPrism argues that one more layer matters: how retrieved evidence is organized before it reaches the policy. In a broader training sense, the paper is a reminder that model performance depends not only on knowledge coverage but also on input organization. The same evidence can support very different decisions depending on how relations are exposed.
summary_en.technical_approach:
MemPrism explicitly separates persistent memory from decision-time working memory. The framework has five modules: Recorder, Router, Composer, Render, and Adapter. In inference, the first four form the main pipeline. Recorder stores real interactions as a unified event stream, keeping both raw events and structured fields such as pre-action observation, executed action, environment feedback, reward or step label, and task metadata. The point is to keep persistent memory neutral and reusable rather than collapsing it early into one fixed summary.

Router is the key learnable component. Instead of directly predicting the next environment action, it first decides how history should be viewed. A view action is defined over several axes: relation type, evidence range, outcome condition, and granularity. In other words, the policy chooses what relational structure to build, how much history to include, whether to filter by success/failure or other outcomes, and how coarse or fine the representation should be. This makes read-time memory representation an explicit decision variable.

Composer then selects events from the event stream and assembles a relational structure according to the chosen view action. Render converts that structure into an optical working-memory view. The optical format is not used only for token compression. The authors use two-dimensional layout to encode relations directly: spatial proximity groups related events, row/column alignment supports state comparison, arrows indicate change or dependency, and highlights emphasize failures or task-relevant evidence. A frozen task policy consumes the current input together with this temporary view and outputs the next environment action. The view is discarded after the step and is never written back into persistent memory, which avoids irreversible distortion from fixed summaries or repeated compression.

Training is also split cleanly. Router is first initialized with action-conditioned soft supervision, then optimized with trajectory-level grouped GRPO. The learning target is not the environment action itself, but the choice of memory view that best supports downstream action selection. This separation helps attribute gains to the memory representation interface rather than to a jointly entangled agent policy.
summary_en.experiments:
From the provided full-text excerpt, the experimental emphasis is on whether task-conditioned view selection improves long-horizon decision making, not on raw storage capacity. The paper appears to provide two kinds of evidence: end-task gains and attribution studies showing that the gains come from working-memory construction rather than unrelated components. The training setup for Router—soft supervision followed by grouped GRPO—is already designed to isolate the effect of view selection.

The excerpt does not include full tables or final numbers, so the exact quantitative gains cannot be stated reliably here. Still, the intended comparisons are clear: fixed representations such as timelines, summaries, or flat retrieved snippets are contrasted with dynamically constructed relational views defined by relation type, evidence range, outcome filter, and granularity. The expectation is that dynamic views are better matched to subtasks like loop detection, state tracking, failure analysis, and dependency reasoning.

Another likely experimental point is the decision not to write temporary views back into persistent memory. The authors argue that writing them back would bake task-local bias into long-term memory and reduce future reuse. A meaningful ablation should therefore compare persistent event streams plus on-demand views against fixed summary memories or recursively compressed memories. When reading the experiments, the most useful things to look for are: whether Router’s chosen view distribution changes with task state, how large the gap is between fixed and dynamic views, and whether optical views help because they expose structure rather than merely saving tokens.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the Introduction and make sure the distinction between representation mismatch, storage failure, and retrieval failure is clear. That problem decomposition is the foundation of the whole paper. Without it, the method can look like another memory-engineering variant.

Then read the Method section with focus on the five-module pipeline, especially Router’s action space. Two questions matter: why should view selection be modeled explicitly instead of being left implicit inside the main policy prompt, and why should temporary working views never be written back into persistent memory? The first is about a learnable memory interface; the second is about preventing task-local bias from contaminating long-term memory.

Next, inspect the optical-view examples carefully. The important point is not just “history as images to save tokens.” The stronger claim is that 2D layout can expose relational structure directly. If the paper includes visual examples, they are worth reading closely because they reveal whether the method truly changes information organization or merely changes modality.

In the experiments, prioritize the training of the view policy, comparisons against fixed views, and ablations over relation types. A practical skim should take about 20–30 minutes. For a pretraining-oriented reader, the main takeaway is the interface question: how the same evidence can be exposed to a model in different structures depending on the decision context.

recommendation.zh: 读方法图和 memory ablation 即可；它把“存得多”改成“按任务重排”，比多数向量记忆论文更干净。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and memory ablations; reframing memory as task-conditioned restructuring rather than storing more is cleaner than many vector-memory agent papers.

paper.title: Agent Memory Distillation: Empowering Small LLM Agents with Hierarchical Teacher Memory
paper.abstract: Memory systems have shown promise for improving agent performance, but their potential remains largely unexplored for small language models, which struggle to generate sufficient successful trajectories on their own. We propose Agent Memory Distillation (AMD), a training-free framework that transfers structured knowledge from a large teacher agent to a small student agent through hierarchical memory. AMD constructs three complementary memory types from successful teacher trajectories: Workflow m

summary.core_problem: 小语言模型agent自身任务成功率低，生成的成功轨迹数量少，自建记忆库以失败轨迹为主，记忆利用效果受限。直接将大模型teacher的原始记忆迁移给小模型student收益极低，原因是师生能力存在差距，且小模型的上下文学习能力和指令跟随能力较弱，无法有效理解和应用teacher的知识。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的启发在于，分层知识迁移的设计思路可借鉴到模型蒸馏、合成数据构造等场景，尤其适用于需要向小模型做参数高效或免训练能力注入的场景；迁移质量依赖师生兼容性的结论，也对学生模型预训练和蒸馏流程设计有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Agent Memory Distillation（AMD）免训练框架，从teacher agent的成功轨迹中构造三类互补的分层记忆：Workflow记忆编码任务级的分解与高层规划策略，Subtask记忆提供子任务粒度的具体行为示例，Function记忆记录工具调用的schema、约定和常见问题。Workflow和Subtask记忆在任务开始时主动注入给student，Function记忆则在推理过程中student遇到工具调用错误时被动检索使用。
summary.experiments: 以GPT-5-mini为teacher，4个4B/8B参数的小模型为student，在3个基准上验证效果。AMD相比零样本基线，在AppWorld上平均准确率提升27.2个百分点，BFCL V3上提升11.2个百分点，ToolSandbox上提升3.4个百分点，优于所有非蒸馏设计的记忆基线；同时减少了交互轮数，生成的轨迹更接近teacher。消融实验显示三类记忆各有独立贡献，迁移质量同时取决于teacher准确率和师生兼容性，4B规模的student收益最大。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议：重点看引言中关于朴素记忆迁移失效的观察（图1），第3章的三层记忆设计与注入机制，实验部分的消融结果与师生兼容性分析。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Small LLM agents have low task success rates and produce few successful trajectories, so their self-built memory repositories are dominated by failed experiences, limiting the utility of memory-based methods. Naive transfer of raw memory from a stronger teacher agent brings only marginal gains, as the capability gap between teacher and student, combined with limited in-context learning and instruction-following ability of small models, prevents effective comprehension and application of teacher knowledge.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, the hierarchical knowledge transfer design offers a useful reference for distillation pipelines and synthetic data construction, especially for scenarios requiring parameter-efficient or training-free capability injection into small models. The finding that transfer quality depends on teacher-student compatibility also informs student model pretraining and distillation recipe design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Agent Memory Distillation (AMD) is a training-free framework that constructs three complementary hierarchical memory types from successful teacher agent trajectories. Workflow memory encodes task-level decomposition and high-level planning strategies. Subtask memory provides concrete action examples at intermediate subtask granularity. Function memory captures tool calling schemas, conventions, and common pitfalls. Workflow and Subtask memories are proactively injected into the student at the start of each task, while Function memory is retrieved reactively when the student encounters tool calling errors during inference.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated with GPT-5-mini as the teacher and 4 small models (4B or 8B parameters) as students across 3 benchmarks. AMD achieves average accuracy improvements of 27.2 percentage points on AppWorld, 11.2 percentage points on BFCL V3, and 3.4 percentage points on ToolSandbox over zero-shot baselines, outperforming all non-distillation memory baselines. It also reduces interaction turns and produces trajectories more similar to the teacher. Ablations show each memory type contributes uniquely, transfer quality depends on both teacher accuracy and teacher-student compatibility, and 4B-scale students gain the largest benefit.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the introduction for the observation of naive memory transfer failure (Figure 1), Section 3 for the three-layer memory design and injection mechanism, and the experiment section for ablation results and teacher-student compatibility analysis. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 一种 test-time 的知识蒸馏（通过 prompt/memory 注入），展示了如何结构化地利用大模型的轨迹来辅助小模型，对构建 Agent 系统有一定参考价值，但非预训练核心。
recommendation.en: A test-time knowledge distillation approach (via prompt/memory injection) demonstrating how to structurally utilize large model trajectories to assist small models; offers reference value for building Agent systems, though not core to pretraining.

paper.title: TEPA: Revoking Stale Memories for Conflict-Robust Language Agents
paper.abstract: Long-term memory enables language agents to reuse past facts, preferences, and task experience. Persistence also creates a central falsifiability problem: when the world changes, stale memories can remain retrievable and pollute the prompt. We characterize this failure mode as memory pollution: degradation caused by active memories that newer conflicting evidence has superseded. We introduce TEPA, a revocable evidence-memory mechanism that makes validity an explicit state of memory. TEPA represe

summary.core_problem: 语言智能体的长期记忆存在「记忆污染」失效模式：当外部环境、用户偏好或工具状态发生变化时，已被新证据推翻的旧记忆仍可被检索到，作为提示词证据干扰当前决策，在冲突场景下带记忆系统的表现甚至不如无记忆基线。
summary.importance: 记忆有效性的显式状态建模思路可迁移到预训练研究：一是为持续预训练中的知识更新提供新的设计方向，替代单纯依赖灾难性遗忘或全量重训的方案；二是为预训练语料中冲突事实的处理、知识库对齐提供参考；三是为长上下文模型的证据有效性判断目标设计提供启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出TEPA可撤销证据记忆机制，核心是给记忆设置显式生命周期状态。具体设计：1. 将每条观测映射为带键的先例（keyed precedent），键标识记忆主题（如用户偏好槽、工具状态槽），值为对应声明；2. 记忆存储分为活跃集和撤销集，常规检索只返回活跃集中的内容；3. 当新证据与活跃集中的先例同键且值冲突时，自动将旧先例转移到撤销集，保留审计路径但不参与常规检索。另有TEPA-Full变体，在有可执行验证条件时，会先验证候选先例再将其提升为活跃状态。同时定义分阶段记忆污染指数（MPI），量化某一阶段带记忆方法相对无记忆基线的性能退化程度。
summary.experiments: 在四类冲突场景下评测：受控隐藏状态漂移、真实文件支持的可执行漂移、用户偏好更新、MemoryAgentBench SH-6k事实整合基准。结果显示，仅追加式记忆和键值缓存基线在反转阶段出现明显性能下降，部分场景下差于无记忆基线；TEPA的可撤销生命周期记忆在所有场景下均保持鲁棒。多跳推理和超长上下文变体的实验显示，检索链构建是下一阶段的主要瓶颈。
summary.reading_guide: 先读第2节问题形式化部分，理解记忆污染的定义和分阶段记忆污染指数的计算逻辑；再读第3节方法部分，重点看记忆状态机和冲突撤销机制；实验部分重点关注反转阶段的性能对比和污染指数指标。预计阅读时间20分钟左右。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-term memory in language agents suffers from a "memory pollution" failure mode: when external environments, user preferences, or tool states change, stale memories superseded by new conflicting evidence remain retrievable and contaminate prompt context, leading to performance worse than no-memory baselines in conflict scenarios.
summary_en.importance: The explicit validity state modeling for memories transfers to pretraining research: it offers a new design direction for knowledge update in continual pretraining as an alternative to catastrophic forgetting or full retraining, informs strategies for handling conflicting facts in pretraining corpora and knowledge base alignment, and inspires objective design for evidence validity judgment in long-context models.
summary_en.technical_approach: TEPA is a revocable evidence memory mechanism that assigns explicit lifecycle states to stored memories. Each observation is mapped to a keyed precedent, where the key identifies the memory topic (e.g., user preference slot, tool regime slot) and the value is the corresponding claim. Memories are split into an active set (used for ordinary retrieval) and a revoked set (retained for audit but excluded from regular retrieval). When new evidence conflicts with an active precedent under the same key, the stale precedent is automatically moved to the revoked set. A TEPA-Full variant adds pre-promotion validation for candidate precedents when executable verification is available. A phase-wise Memory Pollution Index (MPI) is defined to quantify how much worse a memory-equipped method performs relative to a no-memory baseline in a given phase.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated across four conflict settings: controlled hidden regime drift, real file-backed executable drift, user preference updates, and the MemoryAgentBench SH-6k fact consolidation benchmark. Append-only memory and key-cache baselines degrade significantly during reversal phases, performing worse than no-memory baselines in some cases; TEPA's revocable lifecycle memory remains robust across all settings. Experiments on multi-hop and very long-context variants identify retrieval chain construction as the next major bottleneck.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with Section 2 (problem formulation) to understand the memory pollution definition and phase-wise Memory Pollution Index calculation. Then read Section 3 for TEPA's memory state machine and conflict revocation mechanism. For experiments, focus on reversal-phase performance comparisons and MPI metrics. Estimated reading time: ~20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 记忆污染是agent长期运行的真实痛点，TEPA的keyed-revocation思路干净；对预训练研究员价值在理解记忆失效模式，看§2的问题定义即可
recommendation.en: Memory pollution is a real pain point for long-running agents; TEPA's keyed-revocation is clean. For pretraining researchers, the value is the failure-mode characterization in §2.

paper.title: Continual Learning in Transition
paper.abstract: Classical continual learning (CL) has primarily focused on enabling models to update and retain knowledge through parameter-centric mechanisms, e.g., training strategies, architectural designs, and weight adaptation. However, emerging paradigms are reshaping the scope of CL beyond this traditional model adaptation view. For instance, on-policy learning broadens the space of update mechanisms; test-time training extends CL from the training phase to inference; and external harness components such

summary.core_problem: 重新界定 continual learning：学习不再只发生在参数更新中，也可能发生在 on-policy 交互、test-time training、外部记忆、技能库和协议层。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是概念框架和综述。它对 continual pretrain、agent memory、技能库、在线学习之间的边界有整理作用，但摘要看不出新的实验结论或可操作 recipe。
summary.technical_approach: 用 When、How、Where 三个维度描述 continual learning 的转向。How 包含 off-policy、on-policy 和 beyond-gradient optimization；Where 从模型参数扩展到外部 harness 组件，如 memory、skill libraries 和 interaction protocols。
summary.experiments: 摘要显示这是综述或立场型工作，未报告模型规模、训练数据、baseline 或定量实验结果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper reframes continual learning as a broader adaptation problem where learning may happen through on-policy updates, test-time training, memory, skill libraries, and interaction protocols, not only through parameter updates.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a conceptual framework and survey. It is useful for organizing continual pretraining, agent memory, and online adaptation, but the abstract does not indicate new experiments or a concrete training recipe.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors characterize the transition with three axes: When, How, and Where learning occurs. The How axis covers off-policy, on-policy, and beyond-gradient optimization; the Where axis expands adaptation from weights to harness components such as memory, skill libraries, and interaction protocols.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract presents the work as a survey or position paper and does not report model sizes, training data, baselines, or quantitative results.

recommendation.zh: 概念框架可作术语索引，不必细读；若做 continual pretrain，只看 When/How/Where 分类即可。
recommendation.en: Useful as a terminology map, not a deep read; for continual pretraining, the When/How/Where taxonomy is the part to keep.

paper.title: EA-Graph: Artifact-Anchored Verification Memory for Coding Agents under Upstream Drift
paper.abstract: Coding agents increasingly work across sessions, but prose notes can preserve a conclusion without the program state that supported it. After an upstream change, a repository may still build even though earlier verification claims are no longer valid. EA-Graph is an artifact-anchored memory for verification claims. It represents artifacts at sub-path granularity, resolves aliases to leaf definitions, anchors each claim to the content used to establish it, and keeps evidence strength separate fro

summary.core_problem: 跨会话代码Agent的文本笔记仅保存结论，上游代码变更后原有验证断言失效却无法被可靠识别。
summary.importance: 方法创新，提出首个以代码制品为锚点的验证断言记忆结构，解决上游漂移下的断言有效性判定问题。
summary.technical_approach: 设计EA-Graph：以子路径粒度表示代码制品，解析别名到叶子定义，将每个验证断言锚定到其依据的具体代码内容，并分离证据强度与新鲜度两个维度；缺失依据时标记为不可证而非猜测。
summary.experiments: 在7个构造的可观测ground truth仓库、42个会话、3种记忆条件、2个模型等级上评测，任务是在上游值漂移、逻辑漂移、内容缺失场景下分类断言状态。

summary_en.core_problem: Prose notes of cross-session coding agents only preserve conclusions, so verification claims become invalid after upstream code changes but cannot be reliably detected.
summary_en.importance: Novel method proposing the first artifact-anchored verification memory structure to determine claim validity under upstream drift.
summary_en.technical_approach: EA-Graph represents code artifacts at sub-path granularity, resolves aliases to leaf definitions, anchors each verification claim to the exact content used to establish it, and decouples evidence strength from freshness; claims are marked unprovable rather than guessed when supporting content is missing.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on 7 constructed repositories with known behavior-to-artifact ground truth, 42 sessions, 3 memory conditions, 2 model tiers; task classifies prior claims as unaffected/affected/unprovable under value drift, logic drift, and withheld upstream content.

recommendation.zh: 代码Agent记忆结构的小创新，思路干净但场景狭窄，仅对做长会话SWE Agent的人有参考，预训练研究员可快速扫过方法节。
recommendation.en: Small but clean innovation in coding agent memory structure; narrow scenario, only useful for long-horizon SWE agent researchers — pretraining folks can quickly skim the method section.

paper.title: Caching for the Future: Scrub Jay Episodic Memory Principles for Agent Memory Systems
paper.abstract: LLM agents that persist across sessions accumulate stored memories whose validity varies enormously by content type, yet existing memory architectures treat all memories as equally persistent and systematically contaminate retrieved context with outdated facts. We show that per-memory, type-conditioned temporal decay, a property of western scrub jay episodic memory, can be operationalized as an auto-classified coefficient $π_i$ in an external LLM-agent memory store, yielding ScrubJay-MEM: each m

summary.core_problem: 长期运行的 LLM agent 会积累大量记忆，但不同记忆的时效性差异很大，统一持久化会把过期事实带入检索上下文。
summary.importance: 贡献是 agent memory 方法和一个时间泛化评测。它把记忆的 perishability 显式建模为检索和更新信号，对长时程 agent 的上下文污染问题有参考意义，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ScrubJay-MEM，借鉴 scrub jay episodic memory 的时间衰减原则。每条记忆被编码为 What-Where-When tuple，并自动估计类型相关的 perishability 系数 π_i 和 utility horizon τ_i；检索时使用 query-adaptive scoring，更新时用 O(1) LLM calls 做 retroactive revision。
summary.experiments: 作者引入 Temporal Generalization Test，包含 held-out retention intervals，并用 Generalization Gap 衡量跨时间间隔泛化。在 TGT 上，ScrubJay-MEM 是唯一取得明显正 GenGap 的检索式系统，数值为 +0.108；摘要还提到在 MemoryAgentBench EventQA-64k 上评测，但截断信息未给完整结果。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani。

summary_en.core_problem: Persistent LLM agents accumulate memories whose validity decays at different rates, and treating all memories as equally persistent pollutes retrieved context with stale facts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-memory method plus a temporal-generalization benchmark. It is relevant to long-running agents and context contamination, but it is only indirectly connected to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: ScrubJay-MEM operationalizes scrub-jay-like episodic memory. Each memory is represented as a What-Where-When tuple with an auto-classified perishability coefficient π_i and a utility horizon τ_i. Retrieval uses query-adaptive scoring, and retroactive memory revision is performed with O(1) LLM calls per update.
summary_en.experiments: The paper introduces the Temporal Generalization Test with held-out retention intervals and a Generalization Gap metric. On TGT, ScrubJay-MEM is reported as the only retrieval-based system with substantially positive GenGap, +0.108. The abstract also mentions MemoryAgentBench EventQA-64k, but the provided text is truncated before full results.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani.

recommendation.zh: 读 abstract 和 TGT 设计即可；时间衰减记忆是合理工程假设，但对预训练侧只提供弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read the abstract and TGT setup; type-conditioned decay is a sane memory heuristic, but it gives only a weak signal for pretraining research.

institutions: Birla Institute of Technology and Science, Pilani

paper.title: MemArena: An Ego-Centric Benchmark for On-Device Agentic Personal Memory Assistants at Scale
paper.abstract: Edge-deployed personal memory assistants must handle private interpersonal conversations on-device with open-weight models. Yet, existing memory benchmarks often under-test the combination of activity-dense interaction, ego-centric perspective, and coherent multi-session worlds. MemArena fills these gaps with a single-world conversational benchmark built with its MASim agent simulator, for 50 agents over 15 days (10.3M dialog-text tokens, 24.1K text-only ego-observed tokens/agent/day). With the

summary.core_problem: 评估端侧个人记忆 agent 在长时间、多会话、多人互动世界中进行回忆、推理和权限敏感访问的能力。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent memory benchmark。它把记忆评测从短上下文问答扩展到 ego-centric、activity-dense、多 session 的个人世界，对长程记忆系统和 RAG 后端选择有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MemArena，并使用 MASim agent simulator 构造一个单一连贯世界：50 个 agent 互动 15 天，为每个 ego agent 生成可观察对话历史，同时自动生成六类 recall、reasoning、trustworthiness ground truth。评测不同 reader LLM 与不同 memory backend 的组合。
summary.experiments: 数据规模为 10.3M dialog-text tokens，每个 agent 每天约 24.1K text-only ego-observed tokens。评估五个开源 reader，搭配 Vanilla context、BM25-RAG、Oracle retrieval、Memobase、MemSearch。摘要报告 Qwen3-0.6B 上 Memobase 到 MemSearch 带来 +32.5/+19.2 pp，超过仅扩大 reader 带来的 +10.6/+6.8 pp；权限感知访问在所有设置中失败。
summary.authors_note: 论文标注为 Cohere 相关工作；摘要中未给出更完整的作者团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper evaluates on-device personal memory agents that must recall, reason, and handle permission-sensitive access across dense multi-session interpersonal histories.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-memory benchmark contribution. It moves memory evaluation beyond short-context QA into ego-centric, activity-dense, coherent multi-session worlds, which is relevant for long-term memory systems and RAG backend design.
summary_en.technical_approach: MemArena uses the MASim agent simulator to create a single coherent world with 50 agents over 15 days. It produces ego-observed conversation histories and co-generates ground truth over six recall, reasoning, and trustworthiness dimensions. It evaluates reader LLMs under different memory backends.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark contains 10.3M dialog-text tokens and about 24.1K text-only ego-observed tokens per agent per day. Five open-weight readers are tested with Vanilla context, BM25-RAG, Oracle retrieval, Memobase, and MemSearch. On Qwen3-0.6B, moving from Memobase to MemSearch gives +32.5/+19.2 pp, larger than reader scaling with MemSearch at +10.6/+6.8 pp; permission-aware access fails universally.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is marked as Cohere-related; the abstract does not provide more detailed author background.

recommendation.zh: 只看 memory backend 对比和权限失败结果；它提醒别把长记忆问题简化成 reader scaling。
recommendation.en: Read the memory-backend comparison and permission-failure result; it is a useful warning against reducing long-term memory to reader scaling.

paper.title: Zero-Mem: Zero-Token Memory Operations for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: LLM agents need memory to act consistently over long interactions, yet many systems use additional LLM calls to operate that memory. Generating intermediate records and mediating their retrieval adds recurring token and time costs, while omitted or merged details can obscure the original evidence. We ask whether structured memory access requires generation at all. Zero-Mem introduces \emph{zero-token memory operations}: no step outside final question answering invokes an LLM or consumes LLM inpu

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 长时交互中，记忆读写依赖额外 LLM 调用而带来的 token、时延和证据失真问题。
summary.importance: 贡献属于 agent memory 系统设计，而不是基座预训练；价值在于提出一种不经生成步骤的结构化记忆操作范式，对外部记忆与上下文组织有一定启发。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Zero-Mem，把原始交互轨迹直接作为唯一记忆源，不在最终问答之外调用 LLM。系统用两种互补结构组织记忆：entity-context graph 捕捉跨轮实体关系，temporal hierarchy 保留会话局部性与时间顺序；查询时在两种视图间加权检索并沿结构恢复证据。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出完整 benchmark 名称和具体数值，但声称在多种长期记忆任务上，相比需要额外 LLM 记忆操作的方案，能显著降低 token 与时间成本，同时保持或提升回答质量。由于缺少更细的实验设定，结论更适合作为系统思路参考。
summary.authors_note: 香港理工大学、吉林大学、西南财经大学等合作；不是一线基座实验室，但问题设定贴近 agent memory 的实际系统成本。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the token, latency, and evidence-distortion overhead caused by using extra LLM calls for memory operations in long-horizon LLM agents.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-memory systems paper rather than a foundation-model pretraining contribution; its value lies in showing that structured memory access may not need generation at all.
summary_en.technical_approach: Zero-Mem treats raw interaction traces as the sole source of memory and avoids any LLM call outside final answering. It organizes memory with two complementary structures: an entity-context graph for cross-interaction relations and a temporal hierarchy for locality and session state; retrieval dynamically combines both views.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not expose full benchmark details or exact numbers, but claims strong reductions in token and time cost while preserving or improving answer quality on long-memory tasks compared with memory systems that rely on extra LLM operations. The evidence is more useful as a systems idea than as a clean scientific result.
summary_en.authors_note: A collaboration involving The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Jilin University, and Southwestern University of Finance and Economics; not a frontier pretraining lab, but the problem is practically relevant for agent memory systems.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 本身帮助不大，但它提醒你很多“记忆能力”其实是系统检索问题；只看结构设计，别把结果误读成模型内生记忆提升。
recommendation.en: Not very useful for pretraining itself, but it is a good reminder that much of “memory” is a systems retrieval problem; read the structure design, not as evidence of improved intrinsic model memory.

institutions: Southwestern University of Finance and Economics

paper.title: ViSAGE: Constructing Self-Correcting Memories for Long-Form Video Understanding
paper.abstract: Multimodal agents operating in long-horizon environments must build and continually update multimedia memories to support entity-consistent, temporally grounded reasoning. However, existing agentic memory approaches often discard fine-grained dentity cues under aggressive compression and segment-wise processing. They also rely heavily on vector similarity retrieval, which can surface semantically related yet identity-mismatched evidence, leading to entity confusion, error propagation, and halluc

summary.core_problem: 解决长视频理解中多模态 agent 记忆压缩后丢失细粒度实体线索、检索时发生身份混淆并导致幻觉的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是多模态 agent 记忆方法创新。它关注 long-horizon multimodal memory 的实体一致性，对通用 agent 记忆和视频推理有参考意义，但不是预训练方法本身。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ViSAGE，一个自校正、实体中心的多模态记忆框架。它通过长时间跨度的跨模态绑定固定实体身份；用双向记忆 refinement 将延迟出现的身份线索向历史记录回传，并改善未来检索；再用多 agent cross-verification 根据 identity-evidence alignment 检查检索证据。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据集、baseline 或具体提升。实验应评估长视频理解中的实体一致性、检索证据质量和问答幻觉率，但具体数值无法从给定信息确认。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets entity confusion in long-form video understanding, where compressed multimodal memories lose fine-grained identity cues and retrieval returns semantically related but identity-mismatched evidence.
summary_en.importance: This is a multimodal-agent memory method. It is relevant to long-horizon agent memory and video reasoning, but it does not directly contribute to pretraining methodology.
summary_en.technical_approach: ViSAGE builds self-correcting, entity-centric multimodal memories. It anchors identity through cross-modal binding over long temporal ranges, applies bidirectional memory refinement to propagate delayed identity evidence backward and forward, and uses multi-agent cross-verification to assess retrieved evidence under an identity-evidence alignment criterion.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. The likely evaluation axes are entity consistency, retrieval evidence quality, and hallucination reduction in long-form video understanding.

recommendation.zh: 这是 agent memory 的可用设计，不是预训练论文；只看实体绑定和反向修正机制，别被 video setting 带偏。
recommendation.en: This is a usable agent-memory design, not a pretraining paper; skim the entity binding and backward-refinement mechanism without over-indexing on the video setting.

paper.title: Beyond Retrieval: Analytic Memory for Multimodal Agents
paper.abstract: Long-term multimodal memory must support not only retrieving relevant information but also computing over observations accumulated across interactions. Existing systems largely emphasize \emph{retrieval memory}, organizing interaction histories through summaries and indexes to return query-relevant information at multiple granularities, from high-level abstractions to underlying records. In this paper, we formulate \emph{analytic memory} as a complementary abstraction that organizes recurring mu

summary.core_problem: 解决长期多模态 agent memory 只会检索相关历史、难以对跨交互观测做过滤、聚合、排序和时间比较的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent memory 抽象与系统方法。它把 memory 从 retrieval-only 扩展到 analytic memory，对长期交互 agent 的状态表示有一定方法参考，但不是基座预训练或通用表示学习工作。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 AdaMM，同时支持 retrieval memory 和 analytic memory。系统从对话、图像和上下文元数据中抽取带 provenance 的 attribute-value observations，自动发现反复出现的字段结构，并物化成可查询结构；推理时由 memory-aware planner 将用户问题分解为检索和分析操作。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出模型规模、数据集、任务设置、baseline 或提升幅度。可确认的是实验应比较仅检索记忆系统与 AdaMM 在多模态长期记忆查询、聚合分析和时间比较任务上的表现。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the limitation that long-term multimodal agent memory mainly retrieves relevant history but cannot compute over accumulated observations.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-memory abstraction and system method. It expands memory from retrieval-only access to analytic operations, which is relevant to long-horizon agents but not directly to base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: AdaMM supports both retrieval memory and analytic memory. It extracts provenance-linked attribute-value observations from dialogue, images, and contextual metadata, discovers recurring field structures, materializes them for analytical access, and uses a memory-aware planner to decompose queries into retrieval and analytic operations.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model size, dataset scale, baselines, or numerical gains. The intended evaluation likely compares retrieval-only memory against AdaMM on multimodal long-term memory queries requiring filtering, aggregation, ranking, and temporal comparison.

recommendation.zh: 概念上比又一个向量库记忆强；看 memory schema 自动发现即可，别把它当模型记忆机制证据。
recommendation.en: Conceptually better than another vector-store memory paper; inspect the schema discovery piece, but do not treat it as evidence about model-internal memory.

paper.title: ChronoMem: Version Control and Semantic Rollback for Large Language Model Agent Memory
paper.abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on long-term memory to support multi-session interaction and personalization. However, existing agent memory systems are designed around forward-only evolution, continuously accumulating, consolidating, and overwriting knowledge, with no principled mechanism to inspect, version, or revert prior states. This makes agents brittle under corrections, concept drift, and memory corruption, particularly after they have already been exposed to subsequent information. We pres

summary.core_problem: LLM agent 的长期记忆通常只会向前累积，缺少可检查、可版本化、可语义回滚的机制，导致纠错、概念漂移和记忆污染后难以恢复。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是通用 agent memory 系统设计。它对基座预训练不是直接信号，但对长期交互 agent 的记忆一致性和可恢复性有工程参考价值，尤其适合作为 memory layer 的系统模式备查。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ChronoMem，作为 agentic memory 的语义版本控制层，并集成到 Google Agent Development Kit。每次 memory write 后提交整份记忆快照，维护结构化版本历史；当用户用自然语言提出撤销或回滚意图时，用词法和语义混合检索、rank fusion、reranking 将意图映射到具体历史版本。
summary.experiments: 摘要提到引入 post-exposure evaluation protocol，用来测试 agent 在已经接触后续信息之后能否正确回滚。公开摘要未给出任务集、agent 数量、内存规模、回滚成功率或开销，因此更像系统概念验证，需要看正文判断代价和可扩展性。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the lack of inspectable, versioned, and semantically reversible long-term memory in LLM agents, which makes agents fragile under corrections, concept drift, and memory corruption.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a general agent-memory system design. It is not directly tied to foundation-model pretraining, but it is useful as an engineering pattern for persistent agent memory, consistency, and recovery.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose ChronoMem, a semantic version-control layer for agentic memory integrated into Google's Agent Development Kit. It commits whole-memory snapshots on every write, maintains structured version histories, and maps natural-language rollback requests to concrete historical versions using hybrid lexical-semantic retrieval, rank fusion, and reranking.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract introduces a post-exposure evaluation protocol to test rollback after the agent has already consumed later information. It does not provide task details, number of agents, memory size, rollback accuracy, or overhead, so the system cost and scalability need to be checked in the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 值得知道这个 memory pattern，但不必精读；若快照粒度和存储开销没处理好，语义回滚会很快变成工程债。
recommendation.en: Worth knowing as a memory pattern, not worth a full read; without careful snapshot granularity and storage control, semantic rollback becomes engineering debt.

paper.title: MemTxn: A Transaction Boundary for Source-Supported Updates and Complete-State Recovery in Agent Memory
paper.abstract: Persistent memory lets long-running large language model agents reuse information across sessions and tasks. Yet errors in writable memory can persist and corrupt future behavior. Existing systems improve storage and retrieval, but they do not provide a transaction boundary for reliable updates and recovery. We therefore propose MemTxn, a governance layer outside the answer model. MemTxn verifies whether an update is supported by its source. It also selects the visible version when facts conflic

summary.core_problem: 长期运行的LLM Agent持久内存存在写入错误累积、事实冲突和故障后状态不可恢复的问题，现有系统缺少可靠的事务边界机制。
summary.importance: 方法创新：首次在Agent内存层引入类数据库事务语义，提供源校验、版本冲突消解和完整状态恢复能力，属于Agent系统可靠性方向的架构创新。
summary.technical_approach: 在回答模型外新增MemTxn治理层，包含三个核心组件：Ordered PatchTest校验写入是否有来源支撑，Temporal Resolver在事实冲突时选择可见版本，持久快照日志在故障后恢复应用可见状态。
summary.experiments: 在item-disjoint审计任务上接受60条有来源写入、拒绝179条硬负例；在LongMemEval-S和LoCoMo状态的多键持久故障下，无需知道物理写入集合即可恢复完整声明活跃映射；在MemoryAgentBench FactConsol上验证一致性。

summary_en.core_problem: Persistent memory in long-running LLM agents suffers from accumulated write errors, fact conflicts, and unrecoverable state after faults, with no transaction boundary for reliable updates in existing systems.
summary_en.importance: Architectural innovation: introduces database-style transaction semantics to agent memory for the first time, enabling source-verified writes, conflict resolution, and complete state recovery.
summary_en.technical_approach: Adds a MemTxn governance layer outside the answer model with three components: Ordered PatchTest for source-supported write validation, Temporal Resolver for version selection under conflicts, and durable snapshot journal for post-fault state recovery.
summary_en.experiments: Accepts all 60 supported writes and rejects all 179 hard negatives on item-disjoint audit; recovers complete declared active map under multi-key persistent faults on LongMemEval-S and LoCoMo without knowing the physical write set; validates consistency on MemoryAgentBench FactConsol.

recommendation.zh: Agent内存可靠性的工程化方案，事务语义设计可参考，但与预训练核心问题距离远，作为系统设计备查即可。
recommendation.en: An engineered solution for agent memory reliability with reusable transaction semantics, but distant from core pretraining problems; keep as system design reference only.

paper.title: Metis: Memory Foundation Model
paper.abstract: Recent advances in AI agents have increasingly internalized native capabilities into their underlying foundation models, giving rise to multimodal foundation models and large reasoning models. However, agent memory is still primarily implemented through external modules, leaving the native memory capability largely unexplored. In this paper, we take a first step toward this direction by introducing memory foundation models, which empower foundation models with native memory capabilities. We form

summary.core_problem: 把“agent 记忆”从外置 RAG/数据库模块，变成可端到端训练、在多轮推理间保持状态的“原生（native）记忆能力”：模型内部要有可持续演化的记忆状态，并且在一次 forward 里能自主执行写入/更新/遗忘等记忆过程。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接价值在于：它把“记忆”重新表述为一种可通过 mid-training 学到的建模能力，而不是工程外挂；并给出一套可训练的目标函数（重建 + 操作监督 + 正则）和合成数据管线。启发点主要在 pretrain↔posttrain 接口：如果记忆状态是可微、可优化的动态参数，那么领域适配、持续学习、以及 RL/对齐信号就有机会直接作用在记忆机制上，而不是只作用在 prompt/RAG 策略上。论文更像原型与框架，离大规模通用落地还有距离。
summary.technical_approach:
1) 概念定义：
- Native Memory State：模型跨多次推理保持“有状态”，记忆以 backbone 内部的动态参数/状态形式存在，并要求其语义空间在预训练或 mid-training 阶段对齐。
- Native Memory Procedure：记忆操作（记住/忘记/更新/利用）不通过外部检索与拼 prompt，而是作为模型计算图的一部分在 forward 中完成。

2) 架构实现（Metis 原型）：
- 以 Fast Weight Programming 思路做“可快速更新的权重/状态”。论文描述为 Metis block，由 hyper memory block + local memory block 组成，并通过 memory attention 将记忆状态注入到 backbone 计算。
- 直觉上：local 更像短期/局部上下文的可写状态；hyper 更像控制写入与读取的上层机制（类似超网络/门控），用来稳定训练并让记忆更新可控。

3) 训练目标（让记忆既能压缩存储，又能学会操作）：
- Memory reconstruction objective：约束记忆状态对过去信息的“可恢复性/压缩上限”，相当于让状态确实承载信息而不是漂移成噪声。
- Memory operation objectives：对写入/更新/遗忘/调用等过程给监督或自监督信号，定义“该怎么改状态”。这部分决定记忆过程是否可用，而不仅是状态里有信息。
- Regularization objective：用于复杂场景鲁棒性，避免记忆被污染、灾难性覆盖或不受控累积。

4) 数据：用公开数据合成“memory-specific”训练样本做 mid-training，让模型在受控任务上学会跨轮存取与更新。论文把记忆视作预测问题：存储阶段不知道未来怎么用，推理阶段只能用存下来的摘要，因此训练应逼迫模型学会“为未来用途做有损压缩”。
summary.experiments: 给出的全文片段未包含可核验的具体实验表格与数字（模型规模、数据量、各任务提升幅度、消融结果等），因此无法在不臆测的前提下复述关键数值。就论文宣称的实验范围而言：他们做了“广泛实验”来验证框架有效性，并分析 native memory 的多方面性质（例如端到端优化、推理时延、鲁棒性等）。建议以论文中的主表（与外置记忆/RAG/无记忆 backbone 的对比）和消融（去掉 reconstruction / operation / regularization、替换 memory attention 形式、不同记忆容量/更新频率）为核心来判断贡献是否扎实。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 30–45 分钟）：
- 先看 Introduction 对 external memory 三个痛点的拆解：目标解耦、不可端到端、在线时延。
- 重点看“Metis block”结构图与 memory attention 的公式/伪代码：它决定这是不是“可训练的动态参数”，还是换皮的长上下文。
- 再看训练目标三件套（reconstruction / operation / regularization）：分别解决“存得下”“会用”“不崩”。
- 最后扫实验部分的两类证据：1) 与 RAG/外置记忆的对比是否在同等算力与延迟下公平；2) 消融是否证明性能来自记忆机制而不是数据合成或额外训练步数。
如果要深挖：重点追问记忆状态的容量、更新规则是否会导致训练不稳定（loss spike/梯度爆炸）、以及跨任务迁移时记忆是否会产生负迁移或污染。

summary_en.core_problem: Turning agent memory from an external RAG/database module into a native, differentiable capability: the model should maintain a persistent, evolving internal memory state across sessions and autonomously perform write/update/forget/read operations within the forward pass.
summary_en.importance: The main pretraining-facing value is the reframing of “memory” as a trainable modeling capability (via mid-training) rather than an engineering add-on. The paper proposes a concrete recipe—architecture + objectives + synthetic data—to make memory end-to-end optimizable. This is most relevant to the pretrain↔posttrain interface: if memory is a differentiable internal state, domain adaptation, continual pretraining, and even alignment/RL signals could directly shape memory behaviors instead of only shaping prompting or retrieval policies. It reads more like an early prototype/framework than a fully validated large-scale solution.
summary_en.technical_approach:
1) Definitions:
- Native Memory State: a stateful backbone whose internal dynamic parameters/state persist across multiple inferences; the state’s semantic space is aligned during pretraining or mid-training.
- Native Memory Procedure: memory operations (store/forget/update/use) are executed as part of the model computation, not via external retrieval and prompt concatenation.

2) Architecture (Metis prototype):
- Inspired by Fast Weight Programming: introduce fast-changing weights/states integrated into the backbone.
- A Metis block contains a hyper memory block and a local memory block, and injects memory via a dedicated memory-attention mechanism.
- Intuition: local memory acts like writable short-term state; hyper memory controls/stabilizes how state is written/read (akin to gating or a hypernetwork-style controller).

3) Training objectives (making memory both information-bearing and operational):
- Memory reconstruction objective: enforces that the memory state actually compresses and retains past information (an upper bound on what can be stored/recovered).
- Memory operation objectives: supervise or self-supervise the desired state transitions for write/update/forget/read, so the model learns procedures, not just storage.
- Regularization objective: improves robustness under complex scenarios, mitigating drift, contamination, or uncontrolled accumulation.

4) Data: large-scale synthetic “memory-specific” mid-training data derived from public datasets. The paper frames memory as a prediction problem under streaming constraints: you store without knowing future use, and later you can only act on what was stored, so training should force purposeful lossy compression for future utility.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-text excerpt does not include verifiable quantitative results (model sizes, data scale, main-table numbers, ablations). Without those, it’s not safe to quote metrics. The paper claims extensive experiments demonstrating effectiveness and analyses of native memory properties (end-to-end optimization, latency, robustness). When reading, the key is whether (i) comparisons against external-memory baselines are latency/compute-matched, and (ii) ablations isolate gains from the memory mechanism rather than extra mid-training or synthetic data artifacts.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (30–45 minutes):
- Read the Introduction’s critique of external memory: objective decoupling, lack of differentiability, and inference latency.
- Focus on the Metis block diagram and the memory-attention equations/pseudocode: this determines whether the approach is truly “native state as dynamic parameters”.
- Then read the three-objective training recipe (reconstruction/operation/regularization) as the core technical contribution.
- Finally, scan experiments for two pieces of evidence: fair baselines under comparable latency/compute, and ablations that attribute gains to memory state/procedures.
For deeper digging: check memory capacity vs. stability (loss spikes/gradients), and whether memory causes negative transfer or contamination across tasks/domains.

recommendation.zh: 不是成熟结论，更像把“外部记忆”往 backbone 里推的一次原型试探；重点看 memory state 的定义和更新式，若写得干净，值得内部做小规模复现。
recommendation.en: Not a settled result but a serious prototype pushing memory from external modules into the backbone; read it for the memory-state definition and update rule, then decide if it merits a small internal reproduction.

paper.title: WikiLoop: Jointly Learning to Build and Navigate Agent-Native Wikis with Downstream Feedback
paper.abstract: Knowledge-base construction and querying are typically optimized in isolation: retrieval-augmented agents operate over a fixed, externally maintained index, whereas construction receives no signal from downstream use. We present WikiLoop, a feedback-coupled framework that jointly learns to build and navigate an agent-native Wiki, a persistent linked-page knowledge base designed for machine navigation. A role-conditioned shared policy supports two interfaces: a Navigator retrieves evidence from t

summary.core_problem: 论文解决的是知识库构建与检索式 agent 使用之间脱节的问题：现有 RAG 或 tool-use agent 通常在固定索引上检索，而知识库构建过程并不直接接收下游问答成功率的反馈。
summary.importance: 这篇工作不属于基座预训练核心论文，但对 post-train、agent memory、外部知识状态的训练信号设计有启发。它关心的不是单次检索排序，而是持久化知识库如何被 agent 使用反馈持续改写。对预训练研究员比较有用的部分是 reward 设计和 credit assignment：如何让一个结构化 memory 的编辑获得可归因的下游效用信号，同时避免只优化目标 query 而损害其他 query。
summary.technical_approach: WikiLoop 使用 agent-native Wiki 作为持久状态。Wiki 由结构化页面、页面间链接、以及指向源文档的 provenance 组成。系统中有两个角色：Navigator 通过 search、read、follow links 等动作收集证据并回答问题；Builder 接收新 source 与当前 Wiki 状态，输出 schema-constrained patch，用于创建或修改页面、链接和 provenance。两者由同一个 role-conditioned policy 支持，但保留不同的 prompt、状态、动作空间和 reward。训练流程是先做 Joint SFT 初始化两个接口，再做 Navigator RL，然后用 frozen Navigator 作为 evaluator 做 Builder RL，最后在 role-homogeneous batches 上做 Joint RL 以减轻角色间干扰。Navigator 的目标采用 sufficiency-before-efficiency：先保证证据覆盖充分，再施加检索成本惩罚，避免模型为了少检索而提前停止。Builder 的目标采用 guarded utility difference：对每个候选 edit，构造 affected queries 与 guard queries，在 edit 前后的隔离 Wiki 状态上用 frozen Navigator 评估下游效用变化；affected queries 衡量收益，guard queries 检测无关问题退化。
summary.experiments: 主要实验使用 Qwen3.5-9B。AuthTrace 上 WikiLoop 达到 62.6 All AC，相比 Joint SFT 高 4.4 分，相比 LLM-Wiki base 高 6.3 分。训练轨迹显示，Navigator AC 从 Joint SFT 后的 58.2 提升到 NAV-RL 后的 60.4；经过 BUILD-RL 后略降到 59.7；Joint RL 后恢复并提升到 60.8，说明共享策略中两个角色会互相干扰，需要最后的联合阶段重新协调。论文还报告了同 backbone 在 HotpotQA 和 MuSiQue 上的 zero-shot 迁移，以及更大规模模型结果，用于验证方法是否只是在 AuthTrace 上过拟合。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议用 20–30 分钟。先看 Figure 1 和 Method，弄清楚 Wiki 状态、Navigator 动作、Builder patch 三者的接口。重点读两个 reward：Navigator 的 sufficiency-gated cost penalty，以及 Builder 的 guarded utility-difference scoring。实验部分优先看 AuthTrace 主表、训练 lineage 表、guard query 消融和 held-out Navigator 评估。若只关心基座预训练，可跳过任务细节，把注意力放在“持久外部状态如何用下游反馈训练”这一类信号设计上。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies the mismatch between knowledge-base construction and downstream agent use. Retrieval-augmented agents usually operate over a fixed index or externally maintained structure, while the construction process receives little direct feedback from whether downstream navigation and answering actually improve.
summary_en.importance: This is not a core pretraining paper, but it is relevant to post-training, agent memory, and feedback design for persistent external state. The useful idea is the credit-assignment setup: edits to a structured memory should be scored by their marginal downstream utility, while also checking whether they harm unrelated queries. That framing is more informative than optimizing a retriever or a summarizer in isolation.
summary_en.technical_approach: WikiLoop represents external knowledge as an agent-native Wiki containing structured pages, inter-page links, and provenance to source passages. A Navigator searches, reads pages, follows links, accumulates evidence, and answers questions. A Builder proposes schema-constrained patches that create or revise pages, links, and provenance. Both roles are implemented by a shared role-conditioned policy, but with separate prompts, states, actions, and rewards. The training schedule starts with Joint SFT, then applies Navigator RL, Builder RL with a frozen Navigator evaluator, and finally Joint RL over role-homogeneous batches. The Navigator objective uses a sufficiency-before-efficiency rule: retrieval-cost pressure is applied only after evidence coverage is complete, reducing premature stopping. The Builder objective uses guarded utility differences. Each candidate edit is evaluated on affected queries and guard queries by comparing isolated before-and-after Wiki states under a frozen Navigator; affected queries measure target benefit, while guard queries penalize regressions.
summary_en.experiments: The main experiments use Qwen3.5-9B. On AuthTrace, WikiLoop reaches 62.6 All AC, improving over Joint SFT by 4.4 points and over LLM-Wiki base by 6.3 points. The training trajectory is informative: Navigator AC is 58.2 after Joint SFT, rises to 60.4 after NAV-RL, drops to 59.7 after BUILD-RL, and recovers to 60.8 after Joint RL. This supports the claim that shared-policy roles interfere and need a consolidation stage. The paper also reports same-backbone zero-shot transfer to HotpotQA and MuSiQue, plus larger-scale results, to test whether the learned construction/navigation loop generalizes beyond the main benchmark.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim should focus on the framework rather than dataset details. Start with Figure 1 and the method section to understand the interfaces among Wiki state, Navigator actions, and Builder patches. Then read the two reward designs: sufficiency-gated navigation and guarded utility-difference scoring. In experiments, prioritize the AuthTrace main table, the training-lineage table, guard-query ablations, and held-out Navigator evaluation. For base-model research, the main takeaway is how downstream feedback can train persistent external memory, not the specific QA benchmark.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统定义和 Builder 打分机制即可；它对预训练无直接动作，但长期记忆的数据闭环设计值得记一笔。
recommendation.en: Skim the system formulation and Builder scoring; it does not change pretraining practice, but the memory-feedback loop is worth noting.

paper.title: Filesystem-Based Memory for LLM Agents: Organization, Evolution, and Sustainability
paper.abstract: Deployed LLM agents increasingly keep their long-term memory as a filesystem: a directory tree of markdown files that the agent itself reads, writes, and reorganizes through generic file tools. Yet research has largely passed over this medium: prior systems design bespoke memory representations and study retrieval over them, leaving the default's two working assumptions untested: that an agent can keep a growing store organized as memories accumulate, conflict, and go stale, and that this organi

summary.core_problem: 研究 LLM Agent 把长期记忆存成文件系统时，目录、Markdown 文件和技能记录能否在长期增长、冲突和过期信息下保持可用。
summary.importance: 贡献是 Agent 长期记忆介质的系统化分析。它不是基座预训练问题，但触及现实 Agent 部署中最常见、却很少被严格评估的记忆表示。
summary.technical_approach: 把文件系统记忆形式化为围绕同一 memory filesystem 的三类角色：management agent 负责整合和组织新内容，search agent 负责带引用地回答查询，execution agent 产生任务轨迹并蒸馏为技能。系统把陈述性记忆和技能统一放入同一个文件存储，并比较不同 memory shape 的效果。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在长对话 benchmark 和 embodied tasks 上评估，并改变记忆形状、组织方式和演化策略；未给出具体模型、任务数量、数据规模和结果幅度。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 UIUC、UC San Diego、UC Merced、Adobe Research 和 Texas A&M University；Julian McAuley 是推荐系统和信息检索方向的知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether LLM agents can maintain useful long-term memory when the memory is simply a filesystem of directories and Markdown files that grows, conflicts, and becomes stale.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a systematic study of a practical agent-memory substrate. It is not foundation-model pretraining, but it examines a default representation used in many deployed agents yet rarely evaluated cleanly.
summary_en.technical_approach: The setting is formalized around three roles sharing one memory filesystem: a management agent integrates and organizes new content, a search agent answers queries with cited sources, and an execution agent produces task trajectories that are distilled into reusable skills. Declarative memories and skills are stored in one filesystem, and different memory shapes are varied.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports evaluations on long-conversation benchmarks and embodied tasks while varying memory organization and evolution, but does not provide model names, task counts, data size, or quantitative gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from UIUC, UC San Diego, UC Merced, Adobe Research, and Texas A&M University. Julian McAuley is a well-known researcher in recommender systems and information retrieval.

recommendation.zh: 作为 Agent 记忆工程备查即可；问题设得干净，但离基座训练较远，不需要读完整实验。
recommendation.en: Useful as an agent-memory engineering reference; the setup is clean, but it is far from base-model training and not worth a full read.

paper.title: Living-Harness Is an Interactive-Agent Evolver
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents may recover from a failure within an episode or after a retry, yet the same execution failure can recur in later tasks because post-episode feedback rarely revises the persistent harness that guides future interactions. Static harnesses improve reliability through fixed tools, context, memory, and workflow structures, but remain unchanged after deployment. We propose $\textbf{Living-Harness}$, a self-evolving agent harness that converts each completed trajectory

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM Agent的harness（工具、上下文、记忆、工作流结构）是静态的，部署后不会更新，导致相同的执行失败会在后续任务中反复出现。
summary.importance: 方法/系统创新，首次提出自进化的Agent harness框架，通过轨迹反馈动态更新程序性知识，提升Agent的长期可靠性。
summary.technical_approach: 提出Living-Harness框架，基于领域级Evolution-SOP标准操作流程，从完成的轨迹中提取episode抽象和结构化更新证据，写入两种互补的程序性知识：记录触发条件/失败模式/恢复动作的情景记忆，以及记录状态节点/修复边/转移规则的状态图，实现harness的有界更新。
summary.experiments: 论文摘要截断，未披露完整实验设置与量化结果。
summary.authors_note: 浙江大学、阿里巴巴集团、香港城市大学、香港科技大学、密歇根大学联合研究。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM agent harnesses (tools, context, memory, workflow structures) are static and do not update after deployment, causing the same execution failures to recur in subsequent tasks.
summary_en.importance: Methodological / system innovation; first self-evolving agent harness framework that dynamically updates procedural knowledge via trajectory feedback to improve long-term agent reliability.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposed Living-Harness framework, guided by a domain-level Evolution-SOP, extracts episode abstraction and structured update evidence from completed trajectories, and writes two complementary forms of procedural knowledge: episodic memory (trigger conditions, failure patterns, recovery actions) and state graphs (state nodes, repair edges, transition rules), enabling bounded harness updates.
summary_en.experiments: Abstract is truncated; full experimental setup and quantitative results are not disclosed in the provided abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Joint research by Zhejiang University, Alibaba Group, City University of Hong Kong, Hong Kong University of Science and Technology, and University of Michigan.

recommendation.zh: Agent自进化harness的思路有新意，核心是把失败轨迹转化为程序性知识，做Agent预训练的可参考其知识表示方式。
recommendation.en: The self-evolving agent harness idea is novel; core is converting failure trajectories into procedural knowledge, useful reference for agent pretraining knowledge representation.

institutions: The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

paper.title: Rethinking Self-Evolution: A Constrained Exploration-Exploitation Process for Mitigating Skill Overfitting
paper.abstract: Enabling large language model (LLM) agents to accumulate and reuse experience from past interactions remains a central challenge in real-world applications. A promising solution is to treat skills as trainable states and optimize them in the same way as model parameters in neural network training. However, data-driven skill optimization is prone to overfitting to the limited trajectories collected from real environments. Overexploiting these trajectories overfits the current batch, while unconst

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 在自我演化技能时容易对有限轨迹过拟合、同时又可能因无约束探索而退化的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent skill memory / self-evolution 方法，贡献在于把技能更新显式建模为受约束的探索-利用过程。它不是预训练方法，但对理解 inference-time adaptation 与经验复用的失败模式有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SkillBoost 三阶段框架：structured exploitation 先定位已观察失败对应的可编辑技能组件；prior-guided exploration 利用 LLM 先验生成多样修复候选；verified acceptance 只在候选通过验证时提交更新，以避免当前 batch 过拟合和旧任务回退。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有提供具体环境、任务数量、模型、baseline 或定量提升；只能确认实验目标是评估技能自我演化中的过拟合缓解和回退控制。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses skill overfitting in LLM agents that self-evolve from limited trajectories, while also avoiding regressions caused by unconstrained exploration.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent skill-memory and self-evolution method. Its useful contribution is framing skill updates as a constrained exploration-exploitation process. It is not a pretraining method, but it gives some signal about failure modes in inference-time adaptation and experience reuse.
summary_en.technical_approach: SkillBoost uses three stages: structured exploitation localizes observed failures to editable skill components; prior-guided exploration uses the LLM's prior knowledge to propose diverse repair candidates; verified acceptance commits an update only if it passes verification, aiming to reduce both batch overfitting and regression on previous cases.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify environments, task counts, model choices, baselines, or quantitative gains. The experiments appear to target overfitting mitigation and regression control during skill self-evolution.

recommendation.zh: 看 constrained exploration-exploitation framing 就够；它像 agent 版小步验证更新，对基座训练只有间接信号。
recommendation.en: Skim the constrained exploration-exploitation framing; it is essentially cautious verified updating for agents, with only indirect relevance to base training.

paper.title: A Graph-Native Bitemporal Memory Store for Conversational AI Agents
paper.abstract: Conversational AI agents commonly lack persistent memory across sessions. The obvious fixes like injecting full chat histories into the context window, or delegating to a third-party memory service, either exhaust the model's context budget or send personal data through infrastructure the user does not control. We describe a memory store that avoids both problems: an agent-local Neo4j property graph augmented with HNSW vector indexes and a full bitemporal data model. Each memory is stored as an

summary.core_problem: 解决对话AI Agent跨会话持久记忆的上下文占用过高与第三方存储隐私泄露问题。
summary.importance: 系统创新，提出基于图数据库的双时态记忆存储架构，支持时间点语义检索且保留完整历史不覆盖。
summary.technical_approach: 采用Neo4j属性图+HNSW向量索引+双时态数据模型，记忆以不可变身份节点关联带有效时间和事务时间的版本化内容节点，写入时自动通过余弦相似度维护语义边。
summary.experiments: 在LongMemEval 500题基准上评估系统，原摘要未披露具体效果指标与对比基线。

summary_en.core_problem: Addresses high context overhead and third-party privacy risks of persistent cross-session memory for conversational AI agents.
summary_en.importance: System innovation proposing a graph-native bitemporal memory store that supports point-in-time semantic retrieval while preserving full history without overwrites.
summary_en.technical_approach: Uses Neo4j property graph with HNSW vector indexes and a full bitemporal data model; memories are stored as immutable identity nodes linked to versioned content nodes with valid and transaction time intervals, with semantic edges maintained automatically via cosine similarity on write.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on the LongMemEval 500-question benchmark; specific performance metrics and baselines are not disclosed in the abstract.

recommendation.zh: 工程实现导向的Agent记忆系统，双时态设计有一定参考价值，做Agent记忆相关研究可扫一眼架构部分。
recommendation.en: Engineering-focused agent memory system with bitemporal design; worth a quick look at architecture sections if working on agent memory research.

paper.title: UniMem: Complementary Episodic-to-Parametric Memory for Boundary-Agnostic Task Streams
paper.abstract: Memory is essential for LLM agents to accumulate task experience and reuse task-specific execution strategies. However, real-world deployment over boundary-agnostic and evolving task streams exposes a fundamental stability-plasticity dilemma. External retrieval-based memory can rapidly absorb new evidence, but it often fails to internalize recurring execution patterns and incurs inference-time retrieval overhead. Parametric memory enables stable and efficient execution once learned, but typicall
