The benchmark covers five core scenario types: rejecting memory as factual evidence, respecting memory scope, resolving memory-evidence conflicts, tracking memory updates, and using valid memory for personalization. Unlike prior memory benchmarks that assume retrieved memory should always be used, this benchmark centers evaluation on post-retrieval usage appropriateness rather than retrieval success rate.
summary_en.experiments: Disclosed experimental findings from tests on multiple mainstream memory systems and backbone LLMs show that the introduction of memory modules generally increases sycophancy levels. Agents perform poorly on post-retrieval decision-making, and cannot reliably balance personalized experience and factual reliability. Detailed quantitative results are available in the full experimental section.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the definition of memory-induced sycophancy in the introduction, as well as its three unique characteristics compared to conventional sycophancy (source, decision role, duration). Then review the benchmark's scenario design framework. The cross-model and cross-memory-system comparisons in the experiment section can be browsed quickly. Estimated skimming time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 视角新颖的 Agent 评测，指出了 RAG/Memory 带来的 sycophancy 问题，做 Agent 评测和对齐的值得关注其任务设计。
recommendation.en: A novel perspective on Agent evaluation, pointing out the sycophancy issue brought by RAG/Memory; worth attention for its task design by those working on Agent evaluation and alignment.

paper.title: When Classic Cache Policies Fail: Learning-Augmented Replacement for Semantic Retrieval Buffers
paper.abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on retrieval buffers to store and reuse past experience, yet the cache management policies governing these buffers remain largely ad-hoc. We formalize this as an online semantic cache replacement problem with switching costs, where items are matched by embedding similarity and hit quality is continuous rather than binary. Through experiments on two datasets from MemoryBench-Full (LoCoMo, DialSim) with 8 replacement policies, we reveal a surprising finding: classic he

summary.core_problem: LLM agent 依赖的语义检索缓冲区缺乏适配的缓存替换策略，经典启发式策略在语义工作负载下表现不佳。
summary.importance: 方法创新，首次将语义缓存替换形式化为带切换成本的在线优化问题，提出学习增强的替换框架并给出理论竞争比保证。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SOLAR 学习增强框架：通过遗憾累积确定缓存修改时机（修改率约 17%），基于隐式检索反馈的贝叶斯在线学习选择替换内容；证明其竞争比 ≤ 3，与缓存大小和时间跨度无关。
summary.experiments: 在 MemoryBench-Full 的两个数据集（LoCoMo、DialSim）上对比 8 种替换策略，发现经典 LRU/LFU  consistently 差于 FIFO 基线，SOLAR 性能优于所有对比方法。
summary.authors_note: 腾讯光速工作室（LIGHTSPEED）与香港中文大学合作完成。

summary_en.core_problem: Semantic retrieval buffers used by LLM agents lack suitable cache replacement policies, and classic heuristic policies perform poorly on semantic workloads.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation: first formalizes semantic cache replacement as an online problem with switching costs, proposes a learning-augmented framework with theoretical competitive ratio guarantee.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes SOLAR, a learning-augmented framework that determines modification timing via regret accumulation (~17% modification rate) and selects content via Bayesian online learning over implicit retrieval feedback; proves a constant competitive ratio ≤ 3 independent of cache size and horizon.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluates 8 replacement policies on two datasets from MemoryBench-Full (LoCoMo, DialSim), finds classic LRU/LFU consistently underperform the FIFO baseline, and SOLAR outperforms all baselines.
summary_en.authors_note: A collaboration between LIGHTSPEED (Tencent) and The Chinese University of Hong Kong.

recommendation.zh: 语义缓存下LRU反不如FIFO的结论反常识，可作为agent记忆系统设计参考，无需深读
recommendation.en: The counterintuitive finding that LRU underperforms FIFO in semantic caching is useful for agent memory design; no need for deep reading.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: Self-GC: Self-Governing Context for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Long-horizon LLM agents accumulate tool results, files, plans, and user constraints that are too structured to be treated as a disposable text suffix. Current systems mostly rely on in-run heuristics such as chronological pruning and tool-output masking, or on final self-summary near a context limit. Heuristics are cheap but blind to future dependencies; summaries preserve narrative state but often hide exact evidence, locators, and editable artifacts. We present Self-GC, where GC denotes self-g

summary.core_problem: 解决长程 LLM Agent 运行中上下文对象不断累积、简单截断或末尾总结会丢失证据和可编辑状态的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 系统方法。它把上下文管理从文本级压缩改成对象生命周期治理，对长程工具调用、文件编辑、计划维护这类 Agent 任务有工程参考价值，但距离基座预训练方法较远。
summary.technical_approach: Self-GC 将用户轮次、工具调用片段和技能状态转成带索引的对象，由侧通道 planner 提出 fold、mask、prune 等操作，再由执行 harness 强制可恢复 sidecar、安全提交边界和 cache-aware commit。方法核心不是训练新模型，而是给 Agent 上下文加一套类似垃圾回收的治理层。
summary.experiments: 论文在 33-session Hard Set 上评估，报告可裁剪 43.95% prefix tokens，并保留大部分运行状态；摘要未给出完整指标定义、模型规模或与更多 Agent 框架的横向对比。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses long-horizon LLM agents whose accumulated tool outputs, files, plans, and constraints cannot be safely handled as a disposable text suffix.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent-systems method. It reframes context handling as object lifecycle governance rather than plain text compression, which is useful for long-running tool and file-editing agents, but only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Self-GC turns user turns, tool spans, and skill state into indexed objects. A side-channel planner proposes fold, mask, and prune actions, while the harness enforces recoverable sidecars, safe commit boundaries, and cache-aware commits. The novelty is a context governance layer rather than a new trained model.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses a 33-session Hard Set and reports 43.95% prefix-token pruning while preserving most of the execution state. The abstract does not provide full metric definitions, model scale, or broad comparisons against other agent frameworks.

recommendation.zh: 作为 Agent 上下文工程备查即可；看对象化状态和 commit 边界设计，别把 33-session 结果当强结论。
recommendation.en: Useful as an agent-context engineering reference; read the object lifecycle and commit-boundary design, but do not overread the 33-session result.

paper.title: ACE: Pluggable Adaptive Context Elasticizer across Agents
paper.abstract: The increasing complexity of agentic tasks has led to rapidly growing trajectory lengths, which poses significant challenges for large language model (LLM) based agents with fixed context windows. Existing context management techniques, such as truncation and summarization, suffer from inherent inflexibility and irreversibility: once information is discarded or compressed, it cannot be recovered even when it becomes critically relevant in later decision steps. To address these limitations, we pr

summary.core_problem: 长轨迹Agent任务中，现有上下文管理方案（滑动窗口截断、阈值触发压缩、循环记忆、Agent自主压缩）存在两个固有缺陷：一是对所有历史步骤信息一视同仁，无法随当前决策的注意力焦点动态调整信息呈现形式；二是丢弃或压缩后的信息永久丢失，一旦后续步骤需要之前移除的细节就会引发推理错误，在固定上下文窗口约束下导致长程任务性能下降。
summary.importance: 这是一个实用的无训练Agent长上下文管理插件，对长上下文预训练研究的启发在于：上下文不必是历史信息的静态线性拼接，可以依托底层无损存储，按当前推理需求动态组装高信息密度的可见上下文，缓解长序列下的信息密度衰减和注意力分散问题。
summary.technical_approach: ACE采用两层解耦设计：第一层是无损消息存储层，永久保存每一步的原始消息和预生成的压缩摘要，全程不做覆盖修改；第二层是每步推理前动态重建的上下文编排层，针对当前任务状态，对每个历史消息做三类可逆决策：保留原文、使用压缩摘要、暂时移除。所有决策仅影响当前步送给推理模型的上下文，不改动底层存储，因此暂时移除的内容可在后续步重新引入，使用摘要的内容可随时展开为原文。整个模块作为Agent推理循环的外部wrapper实现，不需要修改Agent的动作空间、消息流，也不需要额外模型训练。
summary.experiments: 在经典ReAct框架上，ACE的上下文管理效果优于截断和各类压缩基线；作为即插即用模块，ACE适配了DeepAgent、WebThinker、MiroFlow三类不同架构的Agent框架，在多个标准长程Agent基准上相对原框架取得稳定性能提升，同时有效控制了送入模型的上下文长度。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点关注引言部分对现有上下文管理方法缺陷的分类梳理，以及两层弹性架构的设计思路（图1），无需深究三分类决策的具体实现细节，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing context management methods for LLM agents (sliding window truncation, threshold-triggered compression, recurrent memory, agent-controlled compression) face two inherent limitations when handling long task trajectories: they apply uniform treatment to all historical steps without adapting to the model's current attention focus, and discarded or compressed information is permanently lost, causing errors when previously removed details become relevant later in the task. This leads to degraded reasoning performance within fixed context window constraints.
summary_en.importance: This work provides a practical, training-free plugin for agent long-context management. It offers a useful design insight for long-context pretraining research: context does not need to be a static linear concatenation of history. Instead, high-information-density visible context can be dynamically assembled from an underlying lossless store to match current inference needs, reducing information density decay and attention dispersion over long sequences.
summary_en.technical_approach: ACE uses a decoupled two-layer design. The first layer is a lossless message maintenance store that permanently retains raw messages and precomputed compressed abstractions for every historical step, with no overwrites. Before each agent decision step, a separate context orchestration layer is rebuilt from scratch. It assigns each historical message one of three fully reversible states based on current task state: keep raw content, use compressed abstraction, or temporarily exclude. State assignments only affect the context passed to the reasoning model at the current step, with no changes to underlying storage. Temporarily excluded messages can be reintroduced, and abstracted messages can be expanded to raw text in any future step. The module runs as an external wrapper around the existing agent reasoning loop, requiring no changes to agent action spaces, message flows, or model training.
summary_en.experiments: On the standard ReAct framework, ACE outperforms truncation and compression baselines on long-horizon agent tasks. As a plug-and-play module, it integrates with three additional agent frameworks (DeepAgent, WebThinker, MiroFlow) and delivers consistent performance improvements over base implementations across standard agent benchmarks, while keeping the effective context length fed to the model compact.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim for the categorization of existing context management failure modes and the core two-layer elastic design (Figure 1). There is no need to dive into implementation details of the specific three-way classification logic. Expected reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和消融即可；可逆上下文编排是合理工程 prior，但没有强实验前别当成长上下文解法。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and ablations only; reversible context orchestration is a sound engineering prior, but not a long-context solution without stronger evidence.

paper.title: Supersede: Diagnosing and Training the Memory-Update Gap in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents operate over long, multi-session interactions in which facts change: a user moves, a price updates, a plan is revised. Acting correctly requires using the current value of a fact and discarding values that have been superseded. We isolate this ability on real conversational data and show that it is a distinct, unsolved failure. On the knowledge-update subset of LongMemEval, replacing an agent's full context with a bounded, self-maintained memory drops accuracy f

summary.core_problem: LLM agent 在多轮、多会话交互中需要维护会变化的事实；这项工作聚焦一个更窄的问题：当旧事实被新事实取代后，agent 是否能在受限自维护 memory 中保留当前值、丢弃过期值。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，但对 post-train 与长期记忆 agent 的训练信号设计有启发。它把“记住更多信息”拆成一个更可训练的能力：识别事实更新关系，并让 memory policy 主动覆盖或删除旧值。这个视角比单纯扩大上下文窗口或 memory budget 更有诊断价值，因为实验显示失败主要来自 memory maintenance，而不是上下文阅读理解。
summary.technical_approach: 方法核心是 Supersede 环境。每个任务由多段会话和一个关于当前事实值的问题组成。agent 只能逐段读取会话，并维护一个有字符上限的 notes 字段；原始会话不会在最后重新喂给模型。最终回答只能依赖自维护 memory。奖励主要是 r_cur，即答案是否表达了当前值；在知道旧值的合成任务或有更新标注的数据上，还可加入 r_stale，对回答过期值施加惩罚。匹配器是程序化的，使用归一化 variant match 和 token overlap fallback，避免依赖额外 judge model。训练部分用 Qwen2.5-3B 做 GRPO + LoRA，让模型在环境中学习如何更新 memory。与已有 LongMemEval 类评测的区别在于，它不只是给 frozen model 打分，而是把 supersession correctness 做成可优化的 RL 信号。
summary.experiments: 主要结果有三组。第一，在 LongMemEval knowledge-update 子集上，full-context 与 bounded self-maintained memory 的差距明显；前者能看到完整历史，后者只能依赖 notes。作者报告 frontier model gpt-5.4 在 full context 下约 92%，换成 bounded memory 后降到 77%，paired McNemar p=0.0033。第二，扩大规模没有自然消除问题。full-context accuracy 接近饱和，但 memory 条件下仍有明显 gap；会话长度增长 24 倍时，准确率从 68% 降到 28%。给 memory 按比例扩容，在 n=25 的设置下没有可检测恢复，说明瓶颈不只是压缩率。第三，训练有一定效果。Qwen2.5-3B 在该环境上用 GRPO 训练后，在真实未见会话上的 supersession accuracy 从 9.0% 提升到 16.7%。提升幅度相对明显，但绝对数值仍低，且目前报告的是单次训练 run，多 seed 显著性还在进行中。合成模板任务在 full context 下被 frontier model 做到 100%，说明过于干净的“X now Y”任务不能暴露真实 memory 更新失败。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20–30 分钟。优先看 Introduction 中对 supersession gap 的定义，以及 Section 5.1/5.2/5.3 的三组实验：full context 对 bounded memory、conversation scale 对 memory scale、GRPO 训练前后。环境设计部分也值得看，尤其是 no-re-feed 约束和程序化 reward 的构造。可以略读合成数据生成细节；它主要用于说明模板化更新任务太容易，不能代表真实会话中的更新维护难度。需要留意局限：训练收益还不大，且多 seed 结果未完成；对基座预训练的影响更多体现在“如何构造长期记忆训练信号”，不是模型架构或预训练数据配比层面的直接改进。

summary_en.core_problem: The work isolates a specific failure mode in long-horizon LLM agents: after a fact has been updated, can the agent maintain the current value and stop relying on the superseded one when it only has a bounded, self-written memory?
summary_en.importance: The contribution is more relevant to post-training and agent memory training than to base pretraining itself. Its useful point is the decomposition of long-term memory into an update-maintenance problem, rather than a generic retrieval or compression problem. The experiments suggest that larger context access and larger memory budgets do not automatically teach the policy how to overwrite stale facts. That is a concrete signal-design lesson for training memory-using models.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces Supersede, a trainable environment for conversational fact updates. An agent reads sessions one at a time and maintains a bounded notes field. The raw sessions are not fed again at answer time, so the final answer depends only on the agent-maintained memory. The main reward is r_cur, a binary check that the final answer conveys the current value. When superseded values are available, the environment can add r_stale, a penalty for asserting an obsolete value, although the reported training runs optimize r_cur alone. Scoring is programmatic, using normalized variant matching with a token-overlap fallback, so the setup avoids an auxiliary LLM judge. The training experiment fine-tunes Qwen2.5-3B with GRPO and LoRA. Compared with prior long-memory evaluations, the key change is that supersession correctness becomes an optimization target, not only an evaluation metric.
summary_en.experiments: The main diagnostic result is a gap between full-context answering and bounded self-maintained memory. On the knowledge-update subset of LongMemEval, the authors report that gpt-5.4 reaches about 92% with full context but drops to 77% with bounded memory; the paired McNemar test gives p=0.0033. The gap persists across model scale while full-context accuracy saturates. Scaling the conversation length makes the problem worse: with a 24x increase in conversation size, accuracy falls from 68% to 28%. Increasing the memory budget proportionally does not produce a detectable recovery in the n=25 setting, which argues against a simple compression-ratio explanation. Training helps but does not solve the task. GRPO fine-tuning of Qwen2.5-3B improves held-out real-conversation supersession accuracy from 9.0% to 16.7%. The paper also notes that synthetic templated updates are saturated by frontier models under full context, reaching 100%, so they are not sufficient for diagnosing the real failure.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20–30 minute skim is enough for most pretraining researchers. Focus on the definition of the supersession gap, the no-re-feed environment constraint, and the three empirical sections: full-context versus bounded memory, conversation scaling versus memory scaling, and GRPO training. The procedural reward is worth checking because it shows how a forgetting-aware metric can be converted into a training signal. The synthetic-task details can be read lightly. The main caveat is that the reported training gain is from a single run, with multi-seed significance still pending, and the absolute accuracy remains low.

recommendation.zh: 这不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“长上下文够强就能替代记忆系统”这个 prior 拆得很干净；读实验设定和误差分解即可，适合拿来约束 memory-augmented LM 的训练目标。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but it cleanly breaks the prior that long-context competence substitutes for memory maintenance; read the setup and error decomposition, then use it to constrain memory-augmented LM objectives.

paper.title: Temporal Validity in Retrieval Memory: Eliminating Stale-Fact Errors for AI Agents over Evolving Knowledge
paper.abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) gives agents access to accumulated knowledge, but has no model of time. When a fact changes (e.g., a function is renamed or API restructured), RAG retrieves both the stale and current value with near-identical embedding similarity. The agent then either abstains or serves the superseded fact. We show this is a structural problem: on a calibrated dataset, cosine similarity distinguishes a contradicted fact from a duplicated one with AUROC 0.59 (near chance), a

summary.core_problem: 解决 RAG/agent memory 在知识随时间变化时无法区分过期事实和当前事实，导致检索到 stale fact 并误用的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent memory / RAG 系统设计。它指出 embedding similarity 对“矛盾更新”和“重复改写”的区分能力接近随机，这对长期运行 agent 的记忆机制有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MemStrata，一个带 temporal validity 的 retrieval memory。系统以事实三元组形式存储信息，当 subject-relation-object 中对象值被新事实 contradicted 时，用确定性的 supersession rule 在 bi-temporal ledger 中退休旧值，不依赖相似度阈值，也不调用 LLM 判定。
summary.experiments: 论文称在校准数据集上，cosine similarity 区分 contradicted fact 与 duplicated fact 的 AUROC 只有 0.59。使用本地 7B 模型在六个 benchmark 上测试，MemStrata 在静态知识上与 RAG 持平，并针对变化事实减少 stale-fact 错误。摘要未给出完整数值。
summary.authors_note: MemStrata.dev / Called It Inc. 的企业侧工作。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets stale-fact errors in RAG and agent memory when retrieved knowledge changes over time.
summary_en.importance: This is a system-level contribution for agent memory and RAG. Its useful observation is that embedding similarity is nearly unable to separate contradicted updates from paraphrased duplicates, which matters for long-running agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: MemStrata stores facts like a retrieval memory but adds temporal validity. When a subject-relation-object fact is superseded by a contradictory value, a deterministic supersession rule retires the old value in a bi-temporal ledger, without similarity thresholds or LLM calls.
summary_en.experiments: On a calibrated dataset, cosine similarity distinguishes contradicted facts from duplicated facts with AUROC 0.59. The paper reports six local benchmarks with a 7B model, where MemStrata preserves static-knowledge recall comparable to RAG and reduces stale-fact errors. The abstract does not provide full numbers.
summary_en.authors_note: Enterprise work from MemStrata.dev / Called It Inc.

recommendation.zh: 看 abstract 和实验表就够；时间有效性是长期 agent 的真问题，但 SRO 规则更像工程约束，不会改变预训练判断。
recommendation.en: Abstract and result tables are enough; temporal validity is real for long-lived agents, but the SRO ledger is an engineering constraint, not a pretraining signal.

paper.title: Memory Depth, Not Memory Access: Selective Parametric Consolidation for Long-Running Language Agents
paper.abstract: Long-running language agents need more than memory access. Retrieval systems can fetch past facts at query time, but they do not decide which experiences should continue to shape behavior after the working context is unloaded. We study this separate problem as memory depth: durable goal-conditioned tendencies written into a small parametric store. We introduce the loop-drift protocol, a controlled stress test in which the retrieval index remains intact while working context is unloaded and goal-

summary.core_problem: 长时运行语言 Agent 不仅需要检索过去事实，还需要把少量关键经验写入可持续影响行为的参数化记忆。
summary.importance: 贡献是 Agent 记忆机制和评测协议。它区分 memory access 与 memory depth：前者解决查询时取回事实，后者解决工作上下文卸载后目标倾向是否仍能保留。对 continual learning、agent memory 和小规模参数更新有参考价值，但不是 LLM 基座预训练方法。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 loop-drift protocol，用于在检索索引完整但工作上下文被卸载、并存在长循环干扰时测试目标条件行为能否持续。方法上评估 EVAF，一种由 surprise 和 valence 门控的 LoRA consolidation 机制，只在少数事件上进行参数写入。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 GPT-2 和 TinyLlama。检索系统在浅层事实回忆上最强，short-fact accuracy 为 0.956-0.973；EVAF 在目标保持和上下文卸载后的恢复上更强，得分为 0.812-0.904，约每 200 个事件只需 2-3 次参数写入。摘要还提到机制控制实验将选择与写入强度分解为两个可控维度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that long-running language agents need durable parametric memory, not just retrieval access to past facts.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is a memory mechanism and a stress-test protocol. The key distinction is between memory access, which retrieves facts at query time, and memory depth, which preserves goal-conditioned behavioral tendencies after context is unloaded.
summary_en.technical_approach: The loop-drift protocol keeps the retrieval index intact while removing working context and adding long-loop interference. EVAF uses surprise- and valence-gated LoRA consolidation to write selected experiences into a small parametric store.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are reported on GPT-2 and TinyLlama. Retrieval achieves strong shallow factual recall with short-fact accuracy of 0.956-0.973, while EVAF performs better on goal persistence and post-unload recovery with scores of 0.812-0.904 using only 2-3 parametric writes per 200 events.

recommendation.zh: 记忆深度这个拆分比具体 EVAF 更有用；看 protocol 和控制实验即可，别把小模型 LoRA 结果外推太远。
recommendation.en: The memory-depth framing is more useful than EVAF itself; read the protocol and controls, but do not overgeneralize tiny-model LoRA results.

paper.title: MEMPROBE: Probing Long-Term Agent Memory via Hidden User-State Recovery
paper.abstract: Long-term memory promises LLM agents that grow more capable across sessions, maintaining an accurate, evolving understanding of the user that interaction forms. In practice, however, this memory is evaluated mostly through downstream behavior, such as later answers, personalization quality, or task success, which tests that understanding only indirectly and leaves the memory artifact itself largely unaudited. We argue that long-term memory should instead be evaluated as an auditable post-interac

summary.core_problem: 如何不再只通过下游任务表现，而是直接审计 agent 长期记忆中究竟保留了多少可恢复的用户状态。
summary.importance: 核心贡献是评测视角与 benchmark。它把长期记忆从“行为是否变好”转成“记忆产物是否可审计、可恢复”，对 agent memory、个性化系统和记忆压缩研究有价值，但与预训练关系较间接。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MEMPROBE：让带长期记忆的 agent 与携带隐藏用户状态库的模拟用户交互，在泄漏受控的任务轨迹后，从 agent 留下的 memory store 中重建结构化用户状态，并分别评测 full-store 与 top-k access 条件。关键设计是用 synthetic ground truth 提供可精确核对的用户状态标签。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模或分数，但 benchmark 关注的是记忆内容本身的可恢复率，而非最终任务成功率。评测设置区分完整记忆访问与检索受限访问，有助于分离“记住了什么”和“能取回什么”两类问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how to evaluate long-term agent memory directly, instead of inferring memory quality only from downstream behavior.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation perspective and benchmark. It reframes long-term memory from 'does behavior improve?' to 'what user state can be audited and recovered from the memory artifact?', which is useful for agent memory and personalization systems, though only indirectly tied to pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: MEMPROBE lets memory-equipped agents assist simulated users that carry hidden, taxonomy-anchored user-state banks. After leak-controlled interaction trajectories, the benchmark reconstructs structured user state from the resulting memory store under both full-store and top-k access settings. Synthetic ground truth enables precise auditing.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes or headline scores, but the benchmark explicitly measures recoverability of memory content rather than downstream task success. By separating full-store from top-k access, it helps disentangle what was stored from what can later be retrieved.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 agent memory，这个评测视角是对的；如果你做 pretrain，只需记住“行为好不等于记忆干净可审计”。
recommendation.en: If you work on agent memory, the evaluation lens is useful; for pretraining, the main takeaway is that good behavior does not imply clean, auditable memory.

paper.title: Compressing Observation History into Agent Memory: Distilling Transformers into Recurrent Transformers
paper.abstract: Transformers are AI's workhorse with strong performance in modeling sequential data, but their computational cost becomes prohibitive when processing long sequences. We target long-horizon streaming vision and robotics applications like map-free pose estimation, where it is particularly impractical to store and maintain a history of observations. Recurrent Transformers address this limitation by maintaining fixed-size memory but their performance lags behind that of transformers operating over t

summary.core_problem: 长时序流式视觉/机器人任务中，全历史Transformer计算内存开销过大，现有循环Transformer性能与全历史模型存在显著差距的问题。
summary.importance: 方法创新，证明循环Transformer与全历史模型的性能差距来自压缩策略学习难度而非架构限制，提出的蒸馏方案对固定内存长序列建模有通用参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 采用师生蒸馏范式，以可访问全观测历史的Transformer为教师，将其学习到的历史信息压缩策略迁移到固定内存的循环Transformer学生模型，强制学生显式学习每步的记忆保留决策。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖无地图位姿估计等长 Horizon 流式视觉/机器人任务，基线为全历史Transformer、无蒸馏的原生循环Transformer；摘要未披露具体量化提升幅度，仅说明蒸馏后循环模型性能显著接近全历史模型。

summary_en.core_problem: Prohibitively high compute/memory costs of full-history Transformers on long-horizon streaming vision/robotics tasks, paired with the persistent performance gap between recurrent Transformers and full-history baselines.
summary_en.importance: Methodological innovation demonstrating recurrent Transformer performance gaps stem from compression strategy learning difficulty rather than architectural limits, with a distillation framework generalizable to fixed-memory long-sequence modeling.
summary_en.technical_approach: A teacher-student distillation pipeline using a full-history Transformer as the teacher to transfer learned historical observation compression strategies to a fixed-memory recurrent Transformer student, explicitly training per-step memory retention decisions.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on long-horizon streaming vision/robotics tasks including map-free pose estimation against full-history Transformers and vanilla recurrent Transformer baselines; exact quantitative gains not disclosed in truncated abstract, with claims of significantly narrowed performance gaps.

recommendation.zh: 核心是视觉机器人的长序列蒸馏思路，对做LLM固定内存长上下文/循环架构训练的研究员可参考蒸馏目标设计，仅看方法部分即可。
recommendation.en: The fixed-memory sequence compression distillation pipeline is transferable to LLM long-context/recurrent architecture training; skim only the method section.

paper.title: DynamicMem: A Long-Horizon Memory Benchmark in Real-World Settings
paper.abstract: LLM agents increasingly act as personal assistants that must remember a user's profile over months: who they are (attributes), what they routinely do (habits), and what they prefer (preferences), and keep it updated as jobs, routines, and tastes drift. Existing benchmarks evaluate this "memory" ability through short, simplified interactions, missing three core properties of real behavior: the profile is heterogeneous, with attributes, habits, and preferences evolving on different timelines; chan

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“模型能不能从长上下文里找信息”这么简单，而是更接近真实个人助理场景的长期用户建模问题：用户画像由属性、习惯、偏好三类状态组成，它们变化速度不同，变化往往由季节、人生事件、环境切换等外部因素驱动，而且证据分散在跨应用、跨月份的大量细碎行为里。现有 memory benchmark 多半把历史压成短对话或独立事件列表，缺少跨 app 的因果连续性，也缺少随时间推移的覆盖式评测，因此很难判断一个 memory system 到底是检索失败、更新失败，还是只会记静态事实。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接价值不在于提出新的预训练算法，而在于把“长期记忆”从模糊能力拆成了可诊断的评测对象。它有三点启发。第一，长期 memory 不是单一 retrieval 指标，至少要区分静态保留、动态覆写、隐式偏好归纳、跨 app 实体绑定。第二，随着历史增长，系统退化未必体现在最终服务任务上，可能先体现在内部状态重建上，这对训练目标设计和 memory interface 设计都有意义。第三，作者的误差归因显示 93% 以上失败来自 memory retrieval 而不是 answer model，这说明当前瓶颈更多在记忆表示、索引、更新策略，而不是回答头本身。对做 agent memory、continual pretrain、长期上下文训练的人，这个 benchmark 是有用的诊断资产；对纯 pretrain 研究，它更偏评测基础设施，启发大于方法贡献。
summary.technical_approach: 核心方法是构建一个可扩展的合成用户轨迹生成管线，而不是从现有聊天数据拼接历史。作者设计了 16 个 stateful apps 和 66 个 API，在这些环境中生成 15 个月的细粒度行为日志。关键点有四个。第一，事件不是独立采样，而是 event chain：同一个潜在意图会在多个月份、多个 app 中展开，后续事件条件化于当前 app 状态和链上先前步骤，因此实体引用能在 app 内和 app 间保持一致。第二，用户画像被显式分解为 attributes、habits、preferences 三类，并分别设置两类任务：State Completion 用于重建当前用户状态，Personalized Service 用于基于该状态做服务决策。这样可以区分“记住了什么”和“能否用出来”。第三，画像演化不是随机漂移，而是由 season、major life event、circumstance shift 等外部原因触发，并允许一个原因同时推动多类状态联动变化，例如冬季健身计划同时改变装备、作息和消费偏好。第四，评测不是单点，而是在 15 个月轨迹上的 5 个季度 checkpoint 做分段测试，观察历史变长后系统如何退化，以及是否能正确覆盖旧值。这个设计比单次 full-history accuracy 更接近真实长期记忆系统的需求。论文还评测了五类代表性 memory systems。虽然你给出的全文片段没有完整方法细节，但从作者的分析看，他们把系统拆成 memory retrieval 与 answer model 两部分，并做了 failure attribution，这一点很关键，因为它把“模型答错”进一步定位到“取错记忆”还是“用错记忆”。
summary.experiments: 数据规模是这篇工作的硬指标：每个用户约 2.2M tokens、15 个月历史、17,715 个 grounded events、覆盖 16 个 apps 和 66 个 APIs，包含 1,837 个会演化的 attribute/habit/preference 项，以及 383 个带因果标注的状态转移；最终形成 3,634 个 checkpoint-based problems 和 4,994 个细粒度评分点。主要实验结论有三条。第一，随着历史增长，State Completion 准确率持续下降，而 Personalized Service 没有同等幅度下降，说明系统可能还能在服务任务上“蒙对”或依赖局部线索，但内部用户状态表征已经开始失真。第二，没有任何一个系统能同时做好两件事：保留仍然为真的事实，以及覆盖已经变化的事实。也就是说，当前 memory system 往往在 retention 和 overwrite 之间存在明显张力。第三，错误集中在两类更难的记忆对象上：隐式偏好，以及需要精确实体绑定的属性，比如具体工作工具、具体品牌或对象名称。最重要的误差归因结果是，超过 93% 的失败来自 memory retrieval，而不是 answer model。这意味着如果只换更强的回答模型，收益会很有限；真正需要改的是记忆写入、索引、检索和时间一致性机制。由于你提供的全文片段没有完整表格，我不编造各系统的具体分数，但这些趋势性结果已经足够说明 benchmark 的诊断价值。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看 Introduction，把作者指出的四个现有 benchmark 缺口读清楚，这决定了整个设计是否成立。然后重点看 Figure 2 和 Figure 3：一个讲因果驱动的画像演化，一个讲跨 app 的 event chain 生成，这两处是数据构造最有信息量的地方。接着看 benchmark construction 和 task definition，确认 attributes / habits / preferences 的 operationalization 是否合理，State Completion 与 Personalized Service 的评分标准是否能真正分离“记忆”和“使用”。实验部分建议优先看 checkpoint-based degradation 曲线、错误类型分析、以及 retrieval-vs-answer 的 failure attribution。阅读时间大约 20 到 30 分钟足够抓住主线；如果你在做 agent memory 或长期上下文训练，可以再细看附录里的 app schema、状态转移规则和标注协议，判断这个合成环境与真实产品日志之间的偏差。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a harder version of long-term memory than standard long-context retrieval. The setting is a personal assistant that must maintain a user model over months: attributes, habits, and preferences evolve at different rates; changes are usually caused by external events such as seasons or life transitions; and evidence is scattered across many small actions in different apps rather than stated explicitly. Existing memory benchmarks mostly use short dialogues or isolated events, so they fail to test cross-app consistency, causal profile evolution, and the overwrite-vs-retain behavior required in realistic long-horizon memory systems.
summary_en.importance: Its main value is as evaluation infrastructure, not as a new training method. For pretraining and foundation-model research, the benchmark is useful because it decomposes “memory” into more actionable failure modes: retaining stable facts, overwriting outdated ones, inferring implicit preferences, and binding exact entities across apps and time. The reported error attribution is especially informative: more than 93% of failures come from memory retrieval rather than the answer model. That shifts attention away from simply using a stronger responder and toward memory representation, indexing, update rules, and temporal consistency. For work on agent memory, continual pretraining, long-context training, or memory-augmented systems, this is a practical diagnostic asset.
summary_en.technical_approach: The core contribution is a scalable synthetic trajectory generator rather than a model. Instead of concatenating existing chat histories, the authors build 16 stateful apps and 66 APIs to simulate 15 months of user behavior. Four design choices matter. First, events are generated as cross-app event chains: a single latent user intent unfolds over multiple months and apps, and each log entry is conditioned on current app state and previous steps in the chain. This preserves entity consistency within and across apps. Second, the user profile is explicitly factorized into attributes, habits, and preferences, each with distinct temporal dynamics. Each category is evaluated with two task types: State Completion, which reconstructs the current user state, and Personalized Service, which tests whether the system can act on that state. Third, profile evolution is causally grounded rather than random. External drivers such as seasons, major life events, and circumstance shifts trigger coordinated changes across multiple facets of the profile. Fourth, evaluation is checkpoint-based rather than single-shot: the benchmark probes five quarterly checkpoints over the 15-month trajectory, making temporal scaling and overwrite behavior measurable. The paper also evaluates five representative memory systems and separates retrieval failures from answer-generation failures, which is one of the most useful parts of the methodology.
summary_en.experiments: The benchmark scale is substantial: about 2.2M tokens per user over 15 months, 17,715 grounded events, 16 apps, 66 APIs, 1,837 evolving profile items, 383 causally attributed state transitions, 3,634 checkpoint-based problems, and 4,994 fine-grained scoring points. Three findings stand out. First, State Completion accuracy degrades steadily as history grows, while Personalized Service degrades much less. That suggests systems may still perform service tasks using local cues or partial heuristics even when their internal user-state representation is already drifting. Second, none of the tested systems handles both retention and overwrite well: they struggle to preserve facts that remain true while also replacing facts that have changed. Third, failures concentrate on implicit preferences and exact entity identification for attributes, such as the specific tool or item tied to a user state. The most important analysis is the failure attribution: over 93% of errors are due to memory retrieval rather than the answer model. That strongly suggests the main bottleneck is the memory subsystem itself. The full numeric table is not available in the provided excerpt, so it is better to preserve the directional findings rather than invent exact scores.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and make sure the four benchmark gaps are clear; they justify the entire construction. Then inspect Figure 2 and Figure 3 carefully: one explains causally grounded profile evolution, the other shows how cross-app event chains are generated. After that, read the benchmark construction and task-definition sections to see whether the operationalization of attributes, habits, and preferences is convincing, and whether State Completion is truly separable from Personalized Service. In the experiments, prioritize the checkpoint-based degradation plots, the error taxonomy, and the retrieval-versus-answer failure attribution. A 20-30 minute skim is enough to capture the main ideas. If you work on agent memory or long-horizon context modeling, it is worth checking the appendix for app schemas, state-transition rules, and annotation details to judge how far the synthetic environment is from real product logs.

recommendation.zh: 看数据生成协议和指标；2.2M-token 用户轨迹是好压力测试，但合成分布要当主要风险看。
recommendation.en: Read the data protocol and metrics; 2.2M-token user trajectories are a useful stress test, but synthetic distribution is the main caveat.

institutions: University of North Carolina at Charlotte

paper.title: Plans Don't Persist: Why Context Management Is Load Bearing for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Long-horizon agents depend on context management: systems compress, summarize, and evict old tokens so tasks can continue beyond finite windows. That is safe only when dropped information is no longer needed or has been internalized. Plans are the stress case: they are written early, used for many steps, and first to be evicted. We introduce replay pairing, a diagnostic that runs the same trajectory with and without the plan in history and measures hidden-state cosine distance. On Llama-3.1-70B,

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要回答的不是“计划有没有帮助行为”，而是更细的一层：LLM agent 早期写下的 plan，到后续多步决策时究竟是以“窗口内反复重读的文本”存在，还是已经被模型转成了可持续的内部状态。这个问题直接关系到 context management 是否安全。若 plan 只是 context-time object，那么摘要、压缩、淘汰旧 token 时，最先被删掉的往往正是 plan，系统表面上还能跑，但决策依据已经被悄悄拿走。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的意义主要在两点。第一，它把 agent 里的“长期依赖”问题拆成了可测的表征问题，而不是只看最终成功率。这对研究长上下文、记忆、KV eviction、上下文压缩很有用。第二，它给出一个不太乐观但很清楚的结论：在标准 LLM agent 里，plan 信号在 hidden state 中衰减得很快，通常一个 action-observation cycle 内就掉 4 到 12 倍，说明模型并不会自然把计划稳定内化。对预训练和中期训练的启发是，若想让模型真正持有跨步计划，单靠 ReAct 式外显计划和更长窗口不够，可能需要专门的训练目标、记忆机制或状态持久化设计。
summary.technical_approach:
方法核心是 replay pairing。对同一条 agent 轨迹，构造两个匹配条件：A 保留历史中的原始 plan；B 在重放同一轨迹时把 plan 从历史里移除。然后在每一步、每一层比较两条件 hidden state 的 cosine distance，把它当作 plan-fidelity signal。若模型真的把 plan 内化，那么删掉 plan 文本后，后续 hidden state 不应立刻大幅变化；若模型依赖每步重读 plan，则距离会在 plan 仍可见时显著、随后快速衰减。

作者先在 Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct 的 ReAct agent 上做主实验，再在 Llama-3.1-8B 和 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B 上做复现与对照。一个关键技术点是他们发现 reasoning model 的 <think> trace 会污染测量：即便删掉显式 plan，旧的思维链里仍会重复 plan 内容，导致 A/B 两条件都还带着 plan 信息，距离被低估。为此他们提出 strict stripping，只在 B 条件中移除先前 <think> block，以更干净地测“plan 是否还在上下文里”。

除了直接看 hidden-state distance，作者还训练 Ridge probe 去预测 plan signal 强度，并区分 active plan 与 decayed plan。探针在 Llama 的峰值层 L32 上效果最好。作者也做了 probe transfer：用 Llama 上训练的 probe 去测 R1 strict-stripped hidden states，发现仍有一定可迁移性，但方向差异很大，说明不同模型家族编码 plan 的表征子空间并不一致。

这篇工作的边界也交代得比较清楚：它主要是 representational claim，不是强因果行为结论。作者承认 cosine distance 会混入 step index、长度、话语结构等因素；他们也指出 step index 在同层几乎可被完美解码，因此 probe 的高 AUROC 不能简单理解为“纯 plan 内容检测”。
summary.experiments:
主结果来自 ALFWorld 和 HotpotQA。Llama-3.1-70B 上，plan signal 在写完 plan 后的下一步达到 0.453，随后一个 action-observation cycle 内下降 4.1 倍，到 step +5 附近稳定在约 0.027。HotpotQA 衰减更快，达到 12.4 倍量级。这个结果支持“plan 主要靠上下文保留，而不是 hidden state 持久保存”。

探针实验里，L32 的 Ridge probe 对 signal 强度预测达到 R^2=0.875，区分 active/decayed plan 的 AUROC 为 0.999；但同层 step index 的可解码性也很高，R^2=0.978，说明这里有明显混杂。

在 reasoning model 上，若不处理 <think> 污染，R1 的 step+1 signal 只有 0.022，而 Llama 为 0.099，看起来像是 R1 几乎不编码 plan。strict stripping 后，R1 的信号在样本内提升 163%，留出集提升 153%，而对非 reasoning 的 Llama 只带来 4.8% 变化，说明这个修正主要是在消除 trace contamination。Llama 训练的 L32 probe 迁移到 R1 strict-stripped states 上，n=19 时 AUROC 0.748，p=6×10^-4；R1 自探针在两个 distilled family 上可到 1.000，但与 Llama 的方向夹角约 89.3°，说明表征方向几乎正交。

行为层面，作者做了一个压缩压力测试：naive plan eviction 会让 ALFWorld 成功率下降 34.7 个百分点，而 probe-gated re-surfacing 不能恢复，说明“检测到 plan 变弱再补救”并不容易。另一方面，strict stripping 对任务成功率影响小且不显著，L32 的统一 steering 也是 null result，这进一步说明论文主张集中在表征层，而不是已经证明了简单干预就能改进行为。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先看 Introduction 和 Figure 1，抓住 replay pairing 的测量逻辑。然后看方法部分里 A/B 条件如何构造，尤其是 reasoning model 的 strict stripping 细节，这是全文最容易被忽略、但决定结论是否可信的地方。

接着重点看主结果图：plan signal 随 step 的衰减曲线、不同层的峰值位置、Llama 与 R1 的对比。再看 probe 部分，注意作者自己如何处理 step index 混杂，不要只看 AUROC 数字。最后看 compression stress test，理解为什么“plan 被删掉会坏”，以及为什么简单 re-surfacing 没救回来。

预计 20 到 30 分钟能读完主要内容。若只想抓结论，看引言、主实验图、strict stripping 结果和局限性讨论即可。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks a representation-level question: when an LLM agent writes a plan early in a trajectory, does that plan persist as internal state, or does the model keep relying on the literal plan text remaining in the context window? This matters because modern agent systems routinely summarize, compress, or evict old tokens. If plans are not internalized, context management is not a harmless systems trick; it directly removes decision-critical information.
summary_en.importance: Its value is less about agent benchmarking and more about measurement. It gives a concrete way to separate behavioral usefulness from representational persistence. For pretraining and systems work, the main takeaway is sobering: standard LLM agents do not appear to carry plans forward as durable hidden state. The signal decays within one action-observation step. That has implications for long-context training, memory mechanisms, KV-cache eviction, summarization, and any attempt to treat explicit planning as a substitute for persistent state.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The core method is replay pairing. For a fixed trajectory, the authors run two matched conditions: one keeps the original plan in history, the other replays the same trajectory with the plan removed from history. At each step and layer, they measure cosine distance between hidden states across the two runs. This distance is treated as a plan-fidelity signal. If the model has internalized the plan, removing the text should not quickly change later hidden states. If the model depends on rereading the plan from context, the difference should be large near the plan and then collapse once the plan is no longer actively represented.

They test this on ReAct agents built from Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct, replicate within family on Llama-3.1-8B, and compare against DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B. A key methodological contribution is the reasoning-trace confound. In reasoning models, prior <think> blocks often restate the plan. If one removes only the explicit plan text, both replay conditions may still contain plan information, making the measured distance artificially small. Their strict stripping fix removes prior <think> blocks from the plan-removed condition, yielding a cleaner estimate of whether the plan remains available in context.

They also train Ridge probes on hidden states to predict signal magnitude and classify active versus decayed plans. The best layer is L32 in Llama. Probe transfer from Llama to R1 is only partial, and self-probes indicate that R1 uses a substantially different representational direction. The paper is careful about scope: these are representational claims, not strong causal claims about behavior. The authors explicitly note confounds from step index, history length, and discourse structure.
summary_en.experiments:
On ALFWorld with Llama-3.1-70B, the plan signal peaks at 0.453 one step after the plan is written, then drops by 4.1x within a single action-observation cycle, settling near 0.027 by step +5. On HotpotQA, the decay is even faster at 12.4x. This is the main empirical basis for the claim that plans behave like context-time objects rather than persistent internal state.

The probe analysis is strong numerically but also revealing about confounds. A Ridge probe at L32 predicts signal strength with R^2 = 0.875 and separates active from decayed plans with AUROC 0.999. But step index is also almost perfectly decodable at the same layer, with R^2 = 0.978, so part of the classification power is clearly tied to trajectory phase.

For DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-70B, naive replay pairing suggests a much smaller step+1 signal than Llama, 0.022 versus 0.099, which would imply weak plan encoding. After strict stripping, the signal increases by 163% in-sample and 153% on held-out data, while Llama changes by only 4.8%, supporting the claim that the original measurement was contaminated by reasoning traces. A Llama-trained L32 probe transferred to strict-stripped R1 states reaches AUROC 0.748 with n = 19 and p = 6e-4. R1 self-probes reach 1.000 AUROC on two distilled families, but along a direction 89.3 degrees away from Llama’s, suggesting near-orthogonal representational geometry.

They also include a compression stress test: naive plan eviction reduces ALFWorld success by 34.7 percentage points, and probe-gated resurfacing does not recover the loss. Meanwhile, strict stripping has only small, non-significant effects on task success, and uniform L32 steering is a null result. That reinforces the paper’s framing: the evidence is strongest at the representation level, not yet as a simple intervention recipe.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Start with the introduction and the first main figure to understand what replay pairing is actually measuring. Then read the method section carefully, especially how the matched replay conditions are constructed. The strict stripping treatment for reasoning models is the most important implementation detail in the paper.

After that, focus on the decay curves over steps, the layerwise peak analysis, and the Llama versus R1 comparison. In the probe section, pay attention to the step-index confound rather than just the headline AUROC. The compression stress test is worth a quick read because it connects the representational finding back to practical context management.

This is a 20 to 30 minute skim if the goal is to extract the main result and the measurement idea.

recommendation.zh: 只看 replay pairing 和衰减曲线；它把“计划已内化”的常见假设打成了可测量弱信号。
recommendation.en: Read the replay-pairing setup and decay curves; it turns the usual “plans are internalized” assumption into a weak measurable signal.

paper.title: AdaMem: Learning What to Remember for Personalized Long-Horizon LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Long-term memory systems for Large Language Model (LLM) agents typically try to \emph{remember everything}, extracting memories uniformly to retain as many facts as possible. In production, however, inference cost and finite context budgets make this untenable: beyond consolidating raw dialogue into memory, an agent must exert \emph{write control}, efficiently keeping only the information each user actually cares about. Otherwise, long-horizon personalized interactions suffer \emph{memory bloat}

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论的不是“怎样存更多记忆”，而是“在长期个性化交互里，什么值得被写进记忆”。作者认为现有 LLM memory agent 大多默认一个统一写入规则：只要对话里出现事实，就尽量提取并保存。这个假设在短任务里问题不大，但在真实长周期场景里会导致 memory bloat：无关细节不断累积，占用检索预算和上下文窗口，最终让真正重要的信息更难被召回。更关键的是，记忆价值是角色相关、用户相关的。同一句对话，对商务助理和健身伙伴的重要性完全不同。AdaMem 试图解决的核心问题，就是如何让记忆写入策略从“尽量全记”变成“按用户偏好有选择地记”，并且能从反馈中持续修正。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身的直接贡献有限，但对 post-train memory system 和 agent training interface 有现实意义。它把长期记忆问题从 retrieval 侧往前推了一步，强调 write control 才是部署瓶颈。这个视角很重要，因为很多记忆系统把主要精力放在更强的检索器或更长的上下文，却默认写入阶段是无害的；AdaMem 说明如果写入策略错了，后面再强的检索也只是在噪声里找答案。对基座研究员而言，启发主要有两点。第一，长期记忆不只是压缩问题，也是偏好建模问题；“什么该保留”本身需要学习。第二，反馈闭环可以不直接更新主模型，而是更新一个外部 memory policy，这是一种比全量 RL 或 continual finetuning 更轻的适配路径。它更像 memory management 层的方法，而不是新的语言建模范式。
summary.technical_approach:
AdaMem 的核心对象是一个结构化 Memory Policy。它用 JSON 形式为每个角色 C_i 指定一段自然语言偏好描述 T_i，例如只保留业务决策和 deadline，忽略日常寒暄。整个系统按周循环，包含四步。

第一步是 Daily Extraction。每天对新对话做记忆抽取时，不再使用统一 prompt，而是把当前 policy 渲染成定制化抽取指令，让 extractor LLM 按角色偏好决定写入内容。作者还加入了 Time Anchoring：在抽取 prompt 中显式提供会话绝对日期，要求模型把“明天”“下周三”这类相对时间解析成绝对日期再存储，避免长期记忆里时间语义漂移。

第二步是 Weekly Evaluation。每周末用针对偏好相关信息构造的 QA 来测试系统，观察哪些问题答错。

第三步是 Policy Reflection。系统分析错误来源，将失败分成两类：Recall Failure，说明对话里有信息但没被写入，当前 policy 太保守；Precision Failure，说明检索出的无关记忆干扰了回答，当前 policy 太宽松。基于这些错误，模型生成一个 patch ΔP_t 去修改 policy，而不是重写整套规则。patch-style 更新的好处是局部、可追踪，也更适合失败回滚。

第四步是 Failure Rollback 和 Policy Rendering。如果新 policy 在历史验证 QA 上表现变差，就拒绝这次更新并回滚，防止 policy drift。通过这种闭环，AdaMem 试图把 memory extraction 从一次性 prompt engineering 变成持续校正的控制过程。

方法上最有意思的地方不是模型结构，而是把长期记忆系统拆成了“写入策略—反馈诊断—局部修补—回滚保护”这条控制链。它没有训练新的大型记忆模块，也不依赖复杂 agent 架构，因此比较容易嵌入现有 RAG memory stack。
summary.experiments:
实验部分包含方法评测和 benchmark 构建两层内容。作者提出了 AdaMem-Bench，用来专门测 preference-guided long-horizon memory。这个 benchmark 的设计比较贴近真实部署：多周多 session 对话、多个角色并行、角色之间存在同类语义干扰、并且提供 session-level golden memories，只把符合角色偏好的原子事实标为应保留信息，其余视为噪声。这样的标注方式比普通 QA benchmark 更适合评估写入策略是否正确。

结果上，作者报告在两种 extraction LLM 和两种 feedback 模式下，AdaMem 相比基线最高带来 +9.0% QA accuracy，同时 memory volume 缩小 9%。这个组合结果比单看准确率更有说服力，因为它说明收益不是靠“多存一点”换来的，而是通过更好的写入筛选减少噪声。作者还指出，提升主要集中在 soft preference 类别，例如情绪、承诺、日程安排等。这很合理，因为这些信息往往不是显式事实三元组，统一抽取规则最容易漏掉或误存。剩余瓶颈则在于 weak feedback 下的 policy inference，也就是系统能看到答错了，但未必总能准确推断是该放宽还是收紧哪一类规则。

从给出的内容看，实验更像系统行为验证，而不是大规模统计显著性研究。阅读时要留意几件事：基线是否包括“记全部”的强 RAG memory、是否比较了不同 extractor 模型的稳定性、rollback 触发频率有多高、以及 memory volume 的定义是 token 数、条目数还是检索上下文长度。若文中有按错误类型拆分的分析，那部分最能说明方法是否真的学会了 write control，而不是仅靠 prompt wording 改善。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，重点放在问题设定和 benchmark 设计，不必把它当成新的模型论文来读。先看 Introduction，作者对 memory bloat 和 write control 的论证比较清楚。然后直接看 Method，抓住 weekly closed loop、Recall/Precision failure 诊断、policy patch、rollback、time anchoring 这几个部件。实验部分优先看 AdaMem-Bench 的构造原则，再看主结果表和按类别拆分的分析，判断收益来自哪里。预计 20 到 30 分钟可以读完主线；如果只想获取启发，看方法图、错误分类定义和 benchmark 示例就够了。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper argues that long-term memory for personalized LLM agents is not mainly a retrieval problem but a write-control problem. Most existing systems try to remember everything: every factual statement is extracted and stored under a uniform rule. That works poorly in long-horizon deployment because memory keeps growing, irrelevant details accumulate, retrieval gets noisier, and finite context budgets are wasted on trivia. More importantly, what should be remembered is role-dependent. A manager-facing assistant and a fitness companion should preserve different parts of the same conversation. AdaMem is built to learn that selectivity: not just how to store memories, but what to store for a given user role and how to revise that policy from feedback over time.
summary_en.importance: Its direct relevance to pretraining is limited, but it is useful for researchers thinking about the interface between foundation models and persistent memory systems. The main contribution is conceptual and operational. It shifts attention from better retrieval over an ever-growing memory bank to better admission control at write time. That is a meaningful correction, because downstream retrieval quality is bounded by the quality of what was written in the first place. For LLM systems work, the paper also shows a lightweight adaptation route: instead of updating the base model or running full continual finetuning, one can update an external memory policy through a feedback loop. This is closer to memory management than to a new modeling paradigm, but it is a practical idea for long-horizon agents.
summary_en.technical_approach:
AdaMem centers on a structured Memory Policy. The policy is a JSON object that maps each character or role C_i to a natural-language extraction preference T_i, such as keeping only final business decisions and deadlines while ignoring casual chatter. The system then runs a weekly closed loop with four stages.

First is Daily Extraction. New conversations are processed by an extractor LLM, but the extraction prompt is conditioned on the current policy rather than using a generic save-everything rule. The paper also adds Time Anchoring: the prompt includes the absolute session date and instructs the model to resolve relative expressions like “tomorrow” into absolute dates before storing them. That is a small but important systems detail, because relative temporal references decay quickly in long-term memory.

Second is Weekly Evaluation. At the end of each week, the system is probed with QA examples targeting preference-aligned information.

Third is Policy Reflection. Errors are diagnosed into two categories. Recall Failure means the relevant information appeared in dialogue but was never written, so the policy is too restrictive. Precision Failure means irrelevant retrieved memories polluted the answer, so the policy is too permissive. Based on these failures, the model generates a policy patch rather than rewriting the full policy from scratch. This patch-style update is easier to inspect and easier to roll back.

Fourth is Failure Rollback and Policy Rendering. If the updated policy hurts validation performance on historical QA pairs, the change is rejected and the system reverts to the previous policy. The accepted policy is then rendered into extraction instructions for the next week. The interesting part here is not a new neural architecture but a control loop: write policy, evaluate, diagnose, patch, validate, and only then deploy. That makes the method easy to insert into existing RAG-style memory stacks.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation includes both a new benchmark and the method comparison itself. The benchmark, AdaMem-Bench, is designed specifically for preference-guided long-horizon memory. It uses multi-session dialogues over multiple weeks, multiple concurrent personas, and deliberately overlapping semantic content across characters so that the system must avoid confusing similar but irrelevant memories. Each session is annotated with golden memories: atomic facts that match the character’s preference profile are labeled as relevant, while the rest is treated as noise. That setup is better aligned with the paper’s goal than generic QA benchmarks.

Empirically, the paper reports up to +9.0% QA accuracy while reducing memory volume by 9%, across two extractor LLMs and two feedback modes. That combination matters more than the accuracy number alone, because it suggests the gains come from better selectivity rather than from simply storing more information. The analysis says improvements are concentrated in soft-preference categories such as emotions, promises, and schedules. That is plausible: these are exactly the categories where a uniform extraction rule tends to either miss subtle information or over-store irrelevant details. The main remaining bottleneck is policy inference from weak feedback, meaning the system can observe that an answer failed but cannot always infer the right policy adjustment.

When reading the experiments, the most useful questions are practical ones: what the baselines are, how memory volume is measured, how often rollback is triggered, and whether the gains hold across different extractor models. If the paper includes error-type breakdowns by recall versus precision failure, those are likely more informative than the top-line QA score.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is best read as a systems paper on memory control, not as a model-architecture paper. Start with the introduction, where the memory-bloat argument is laid out clearly. Then read the method section with attention to five components: the weekly closed loop, the recall-versus-precision failure taxonomy, patch-based policy updates, rollback, and time anchoring. In the experiments, first inspect how AdaMem-Bench is constructed, because the benchmark design explains why the method helps. Then look at the main result table and the category-wise analysis to see where the gains come from. A focused skim should take 20 to 30 minutes. If time is short, the method figure, the failure taxonomy, and a few benchmark examples are enough to capture the main idea.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是基座论文，但把 agent memory 的关键矛盾从 retrieval 转到 write policy，方向是对的；先看 memory policy 定义和 rollback 机制。
recommendation.en: Not a core pretraining paper, but it correctly reframes agent memory from retrieval to write policy; read the memory-policy formulation and rollback mechanism first.

paper.title: EvoEmbedding: Evolvable Representations for Long-Context Retrieval and Agentic Memory
paper.abstract: Existing embedding models are inherently static: they encode text segments in isolation, ignoring their surrounding context and temporal order. This paper introduces EvoEmbedding, a novel embedding model that generates evolvable representations for retrieval. It is tailored for long-context scenarios, where information is dynamic, sequential, and requires continuous state tracking. Our design is simple: EvoEmbedding maintains a continuously updated latent memory as it sequentially processes inpu

summary.core_problem: 静态 embedding 无法表达长上下文中随时间演化的语义状态，导致检索和 agent memory 在动态场景下失真。
summary.importance: 这不是基座预训练论文，但它碰到一个真实问题：检索表征若忽略顺序和历史状态，就很难支撑长上下文 agent memory。贡献属于表示学习与记忆建模方法创新。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 EvoEmbedding：顺序处理输入时维护持续更新的 latent memory，并将该状态与当前内容联合编码为 evolvable embedding，使同一查询在不同上下文阶段可检索不同目标。为训练该能力，构建 EvoTrain-180K，并引入 memory queue 缓解 recurrent encoding 下的表征坍塌。
summary.experiments: 摘要表明方法面向 long-context retrieval 和 agentic memory，包含新训练集 EvoTrain-180K；但未给出 backbone、参数量、基线名称和具体提升幅度。若正文实验干净，重点应看与静态 embedding、late interaction、memory-augmented retriever 的对比。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自南京大学。

summary_en.core_problem: Static embeddings fail to represent evolving semantic state in long contexts, which hurts retrieval and agent memory in dynamic settings.
summary_en.importance: This is not a foundation-pretraining paper, but it targets a real bottleneck: retrieval representations that ignore order and history are weak for long-context agent memory. The contribution is a representation-learning and memory-modeling method.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes EvoEmbedding, which maintains a continuously updated latent memory while processing inputs sequentially, and combines that state with current content to produce evolvable embeddings. This allows the same query to retrieve different targets under different contextual histories. It also introduces EvoTrain-180K and a memory queue to avoid representation collapse in recurrent encoding.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract positions the method for long-context retrieval and agentic memory and mentions a new training set, EvoTrain-180K, but does not report backbone details, parameter counts, baselines, or exact gains. If the full paper is clean, the key comparison should be against static embeddings, late-interaction retrieval, and memory-augmented retrievers.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from Nanjing University.

recommendation.zh: 如果你在想“RAG/agent memory 为什么总像无状态检索”，这篇值得看方法节；关键不是新数据，而是把 embedding 从静态键改成随上下文演化的状态变量。
recommendation.en: If you keep asking why RAG and agent memory feel stateless, read the method section: the useful idea is treating embeddings as evolving state, not fixed keys.

paper.title: Multi-Agent Transactive Memory
paper.abstract: The decentralized deployment of LLM agents with diverse capabilities across diverse tasks motivates infrastructure for knowledge sharing across heterogeneous agent populations. Just as search engines index human-generated artifacts to support human problem solving, retrieval systems can organize agent-generated artifacts for reuse across agent populations. We extend retrieval-augmented generation - which demonstrates the value of human-authored artifacts to individual agents - to retrieval of ag

summary.core_problem: 分散部署的多Agent群体中，每个Agent产生的轨迹（procedural knowledge）通常用完即丢，新Agent反复重解已有问题，缺乏群体级记忆共享基础设施。
summary.importance: 把RAG从'Agent检索人类产出物'扩展到'Agent群体共享自身产出轨迹'的transactive memory框架。
summary.technical_approach: 提出MATM（Multi-Agent Transactive Memory）：producer Agent将解决任务的轨迹写入群体级存储，后续Agent通过检索这些Agent生成的轨迹复用程序性知识，而不是只依赖人类文档或重新探索。
summary.experiments: 论文为框架性提案，摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据或定量SOTA结果。

summary_en.core_problem: In decentralized multi-agent populations, agent trajectories encoding reusable procedural knowledge are typically discarded after single use, forcing new agents to repeatedly rediscover existing solutions.
summary_en.importance: Extends RAG-style retrieval of human-authored artifacts to population-level storage and reuse of agent-generated trajectories via a transactive memory framework.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes MATM (Multi-Agent Transactive Memory), where producer agents contribute their trajectories to a population-level memory, and downstream agents retrieve and reuse this agent-generated procedural knowledge instead of relying only on human-authored documents or rediscovering solutions.
summary_en.experiments: A framework proposal; the abstract does not report concrete model scales, datasets, or quantitative SOTA results.

recommendation.zh: 把'Agent轨迹当语料'做群体级记忆是个干净的想法，对长期运行Agent系统的数据回流有启发，但当前是框架论文无硬结果，知道即可。
recommendation.en: A clean framing of treating agent trajectories as first-class retrievable artifacts for population memory; conceptually relevant to data flywheels, but framework-only with no hard results—know the idea, skip the details.

paper.title: PreAct: Computer-Using Agents that Get Faster on Repeated Tasks
paper.abstract: Computer-using agents drive real software through the screen -- clicking and typing -- but they solve every task from scratch: asked to repeat a task, an agent re-reads the screen, re-reasons every tap, and pays the full cost again. We present PreAct, which lets such an agent get faster on tasks it has done before. The first time it succeeds, PreAct compiles the run into a small state-machine program-states that check the screen, transitions that act-and on later runs replays it directly instead

summary.core_problem: 现有基于屏幕交互的计算机操作Agent每次执行重复任务时都从零启动完整的视觉-推理-行动循环，没有对历史成功经验的可验证复用能力，重复任务执行冗余成本高、效率低。
summary.importance: 为Agent在使用过程中的效率自提升提供了轻量可落地的范式，核心的"先校验再执行、入库前先验证"设计思路对大模型调用缓存、技能复用类工作有直接参考价值，同时点出了当前Agent评测普遍忽略重复任务效率维度的问题。
summary.technical_approach: 1. Agent首次成功完成任务后，将完整执行轨迹编译为小型状态机：每个状态存储屏幕校验规则，每个迁移对应具体可执行操作；2. 后续遇到同类任务时优先执行状态机，每步操作前先校验当前屏幕是否符合状态机预期，完全匹配则无需调用大模型直接执行，出现不匹配立刻交回原始Agent接管；3. 新编译的程序入库前额外做一次独立完整重放，只有通过任务本身的判定器确认确实能完成目标的状态机才会存入技能库，避免错误程序累积导致性能随使用衰减。
summary.experiments: 在AndroidWorld（移动端）、OSWorld（桌面端）、WebArena（网页端）三个跨平台基准上测试，成功复用状态机的重复任务执行速度比全量调用Agent快8.5-13倍，全程无逐步骤大模型调用；屏幕校验机制相比无校验的盲目重放，在冷启动到热启动的过渡阶段任务成功率提升1.75-2.6个点；检索环节用简单嵌入检索替代大模型选程序，检索准确率仅从100%降到75.6%但成本大幅降低，对最终效果影响极小；提示词措辞、手写运行护栏等因素对结果无显著影响。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读即可，重点看引言部分对现有复用方案缺陷的对比、核心的两层校验设计，以及消融实验中区分高影响设计与无关设计的结论，不需要深入推导状态机构建的实现细节，预计阅读时间15分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing screen-interfacing computer-using agents solve every task from scratch even for recurring routines, running full vision-language reasoning cycles for every action without verifiable reuse of past successful trajectories, leading to high redundant cost on repeated tasks.
summary_en.importance: This work presents a lightweight, production-ready paradigm for agent efficiency improvement over extended use. Its core design principles of 'check before acting, verify before storing' provide direct reference for LLM call caching and skill reuse systems, and highlights the missing repeated-task efficiency dimension in most current agent evaluation protocols.
summary_en.technical_approach: 1. After an agent successfully completes a task for the first time, PreAct compiles the full trajectory into a lightweight finite state machine, where each state stores a screen state validation rule, and each transition stores a concrete executable action. 2. For subsequent matches to the same task, PreAct runs the state machine directly: it validates screen alignment with expected state before every action, invokes no LLM calls during successful replay, and immediately returns control to the base agent when a screen mismatch is detected. 3. Newly compiled state machines are only added to the skill library after a full independent replay that passes the benchmark's native task verifier, preventing accumulation of buggy programs that cause performance degradation over time.
summary_en.experiments: Tested across three platforms: AndroidWorld (mobile), OSWorld (desktop), WebArena (web). Warm replays of matched tasks run 8.5-13x faster than full agent inference with zero per-step LLM calls. The screen check mechanism improves success rate by 1.75-2.6 tasks across the cold-to-warm transition compared to blind replay without validation. Replacing LLM-based skill retrieval with a simple embedding retriever drops retrieval accuracy from 100% to 75.6% but has negligible impact on end performance at significantly lower cost. Factors including prompt wording and hand-written runtime guardrails show no measurable effect on results.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim the paper. Focus on the comparison of limitations of prior skill reuse approaches in the introduction, the two-layer verification design, and the ablation results separating high-impact design choices from irrelevant ones. There is no need to dig into low-level implementation details of state machine construction. Expected reading time: 15 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 读方法和验证门槛即可；它把 agent 记忆做成可检查程序，比向量记忆更像工程上能落地的重复任务缓存。
recommendation.en: Read the method and validation gate; programmatic replay is a cleaner repeated-task cache than vector-memory reuse.

paper.title: A Unified Framework for Context-Aware and Relation-Aware Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
paper.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a paradigm for enhancing large language models (LLMs) with external knowledge, yet existing graph-based methods face a fundamental limitation: entity-centric and chunk-centric approaches operate on representations anchored to original text without true knowledge fusion. While entity-centric methods connect logically related content and chunk-centric methods preserve context, both retrieve information separately through similarity search, missin

summary.core_problem: 解决图RAG中实体中心和chunk中心方法各自割裂的问题：前者能连接关系但丢上下文，后者保留上下文但难以融合关系知识。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是RAG系统方法改进。它试图把上下文信息和关系信息融合进层级图索引，用于提升检索阶段的综合表示能力。对预训练本身不直接相关，但对外部知识接入和agent memory有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出HyGRAG层级图RAG框架，在混合表示上构建层级索引，生成同时整合上下文和关系信息的摘要节点，并利用这些合成表示进行检索；同时考虑动态语料下层级结构的高效更新。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出数据集、模型、baseline和具体提升数值。可确认评估重点应是graph-based RAG检索与问答表现，以及动态语料更新效率。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses a split in graph RAG: entity-centric methods capture relations but lose context, while chunk-centric methods preserve context but fail to fuse relational knowledge.
summary_en.importance: This is a RAG-system method contribution. It aims to fuse contextual and relational information into a hierarchical graph index for better retrieval representations. It is not directly about pretraining, but it may be useful for external knowledge access and agent memory design.
summary_en.technical_approach: HyGRAG builds hierarchical index structures over hybrid representations, creates summary nodes that integrate both contextual and relational information, retrieves through these synthesized representations, and includes mechanisms for efficient updates under dynamic corpora.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide datasets, models, baselines, or numerical gains. The likely evaluation focus is graph-based RAG retrieval/QA quality and update efficiency for dynamic corpora.

recommendation.zh: 常规RAG系统增量；若做agent memory可看索引构造，预训练视角不必读实验细节。
recommendation.en: A conventional RAG-system increment; useful for agent-memory indexing, but pretraining researchers need not read the experiments closely.

paper.title: Control-Plane Placement Shapes Forgetting: An Architectural Study of Agent Memory Across Thirteen System Configurations
paper.abstract: Where an LLM sits in an agent memory pipeline -- between the recall plane that retrieves stored facts (extensively benchmarked) and the control plane that mutates them via supersede, release, purge (largely untested) -- shapes which forgetting failure modes the system recovers. Comparing thirteen system configurations on a 385-case adversarial surface, we observe three placement regimes with partly complementary coverage: deterministic primitives suffice for lexical/temporal categories but fail

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的不是“能不能记住”，而是“能不能按指令忘掉，而且忘得对”。作者把 agent memory 拆成 recall plane 和 control plane 两层：前者负责取回记忆，后者负责 supersede、release、purge 这类变更与删除。核心问题是，LLM 放在这条链路的哪个位置，会决定系统能修复哪一类 forgetting failure。现有记忆系统和评测大多盯着检索召回，几乎不测控制面，因此无法回答一个更接近生产的问题：旧事实能否被正确覆盖、临时信息能否过期、指定实体能否被彻底删除、连续变更后是否只剩最新版本可见。
summary.importance: 对基座研究的直接价值不在 agent 应用本身，而在两个更底层的判断。第一，记忆系统的行为不能只用 recall 指标描述，删除与更新是独立能力轴，且与架构放置强相关。第二，LLM 的作用不是“加进去就更聪明”，而是放在 inscribe-time 还是 mutation-time，会改变它能处理的错误类型：前者更擅长 canonicalization，后者更擅长 intent-aware deletion。这种“能力由控制流位置决定”的结论，对工具调用、外部记忆、RAG 写回、长期状态管理都有启发。贡献量级上，它更像一个架构诊断与评测框架，而不是新的通用训练方法；对做 pretrain 的人，价值主要在于理解外部记忆接口该如何设计与评估。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上有三块。第一块是 ForgetEval。作者把 forgetting 拆成 5 个结构家族：supersession、decay、amnesia、purge、drift；再加一层 10 类 adversarial attack，例如 substring trap、prefix collision、paraphrase supersession、negation trap、temporal qualifier、identifier obfuscation、cross-lingual 等。每个 case 都是确定性的 dataclass：先写入 setup facts 和 distractors，再执行 mutation，再看 final query 的 top-10 recall 是否满足 must_contain / must_not_contain。整个评分不用 LLM judge，靠确定性字符串匹配完成，这一点很重要，因为它把“评测对象”和“评测器”解耦了。

第二块是 Adapter Protocol。作者定义了一个六方法接口，把不同 memory backend 统一到同一行为契约下。即便某个系统没有原生 supersede，也可以用 add+delete 组合实现并接受同样测试；没有某个 primitive 的系统则记为 N/A，而不是硬算失败。这个设计避免了把“接口缺失”和“实现错误”混在一起。

第三块是 13 种系统配置的架构比较。作者把它们归成几类：无删除、deterministic、vec-only、inscribe-time LLM、KG abstraction、joint、mutation-time LLM hook。论文的关键观察是三种 placement regime 呈现互补覆盖，而不是简单强弱排序。deterministic primitive 对 lexical/temporal 类问题足够，但在 canonicalization 上几乎失效；inscribe-time LLM 能在写入时把别名、改写、跨表述归一化，因此 canonicalization 类能做到 100%，但它无法理解后续删除意图；mutation-time hook 则在删除时调用 LLM，把自然语言删除命令映射到精确 mutation，因此能处理 intent-aware deletion，同时保持 recall hot path 不变。两种不同 backend 只要共享这个窄 JSON mutation hook，整体表现会收敛到接近的水平，这说明关键不是底层存储形态，而是控制面接口设计。
summary.experiments:
实验最有信息量的部分有四个。第一，ForgetEval 数据本身：总计 1385 个英文 case，其中 1000 个模板化 case，385 个 adversarial case；adversarial 层由 132 个手工核心样例和 253 个 LLM 起草、人工 oracle 验证样例组成。数据准入使用 Qwen-2.5-72B judge，但正式评分不依赖 judge。100 个样本、10 位标注者的人类一致性 Fleiss’ kappa 为 0.958，说明标签质量较稳。

第二，控制面与召回面脱钩的证据。文中给出 MemPalace 在 Memora 上 recall 很强，达到 60/150，但在 adversarial forgetting 上是 0/385。这个结果很关键：高召回不意味着可控遗忘，甚至可能意味着“错误地记得太牢”。

第三，13 个配置的主结果。deterministic primitive 在 lexical/temporal 类别上有效，但 identifier obfuscation 成绩不超过 5%，cross-lingual 为 0%。inscribe-time LLM 在 canonicalization 类别上恢复到 100%，但对 intent-sensitive mutation 无能为力。mutation-time LLM hook 的两种 backend 在去掉 primitive-existence compound_fact 类后，总体达到 93.3%–94.2%；若包含该类，则为 91.7%–93.2%。而且一次 385-case 跑完成本约 0.17 美元，且不改 recall hot path，这说明控制面增强可以低成本叠加。

第四，类别级分析。论文强调失败模式不是随机分布，而是和 placement 一一对应：canonicalization 依赖写入时语义归一；intent-aware deletion 依赖变更时语义解释；lexical/temporal correctness 则可由规则系统稳定覆盖。这个结论比单一平均分更重要，因为它告诉你该把 LLM 放在哪个环节，而不是盲目把整个 memory pipeline 都“LLM 化”。
summary.reading_guide: 这篇适合泛读，不必逐段细抠。建议先看 Introduction，把 recall plane / control plane 的问题设定吃透；再看 ForgetEval 的任务定义和 5 个 structural families，理解作者到底在测什么；然后重点看 Fig. 2 和 placement regime 对比，那里是全文最有价值的结论。实验部分优先看 adversarial categories 的分类结果，而不是只看总分，因为论文真正的信息在“哪类错误由哪种 placement 修复”。如果时间有限，30–40 分钟足够抓住主线。值得深挖的点有两个：一是 deterministic scoring 的设计边界，二是 mutation-time hook 是否会引入新的误删风险，论文更多强调覆盖率，对误操作代价的讨论相对少。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not about whether an agent can remember, but whether it can forget on command and do so correctly. It separates agent memory into a recall plane, which retrieves stored facts, and a control plane, which mutates them through operations such as supersede, release, and purge. The central question is where the LLM is placed relative to these two planes, and how that placement determines which forgetting failures the system can recover from. Existing memory systems and benchmarks mostly optimize retrieval quality, but they rarely test whether stale facts can be overwritten, temporary facts can expire, entity-specific memories can be deleted, or only the latest state remains reachable after a chain of updates.
summary_en.importance: Its value to foundation-model researchers is indirect but real. First, it shows that memory behavior cannot be summarized by recall metrics alone; deletion and update are separate capability axes. Second, it argues that the effect of an LLM depends on where it sits in the control flow, not merely on whether an LLM is present. Inscribe-time LLMs help with canonicalization, while mutation-time LLMs help with intent-aware deletion. That is a useful design lesson for external memory, RAG write-back, long-term state management, and tool-mediated agents. This is more of an architectural diagnosis and evaluation contribution than a new training method, but it sharpens how memory interfaces should be designed and tested.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The work has three main components. The first is ForgetEval. Forgetting is decomposed into five structural families: supersession, decay, amnesia, purge, and drift. On top of that, the benchmark adds ten adversarial attack categories such as substring traps, prefix collisions, paraphrase supersession, negation traps, temporal qualifiers, identifier obfuscation, and cross-lingual variants. Each case is a deterministic dataclass with setup facts, distractors, mutations, a final query, and must-contain / must-not-contain constraints. A case passes if the top-10 recall blob satisfies those constraints. Importantly, scoring is deterministic string matching rather than LLM judging.

The second component is the Adapter Protocol. It defines a six-method behavioral interface that allows heterogeneous memory backends to be compared under the same contract. Systems without a native supersede primitive can still implement it compositionally via add plus delete. Missing primitives are marked as N/A rather than counted as failures. This avoids conflating interface absence with implementation failure.

The third component is the architectural comparison across thirteen system configurations. These are grouped into regimes such as no-deletion, deterministic, vec-only, inscribe-time LLM, KG abstraction, joint, and mutation-time LLM hook. The key finding is that these regimes provide complementary coverage rather than a simple ranking. Deterministic primitives handle lexical and temporal cases well but fail on canonicalization. Inscribe-time LLMs normalize aliases and paraphrases at write time, so they recover canonicalization failures, but they cannot interpret later deletion intent. Mutation-time LLM hooks instead parse deletion intent at update time and map it to precise mutations while leaving the recall hot path unchanged. Two different backends converge to similar performance once they share the same narrow JSON-shaped mutation hook, suggesting that control-plane interface design matters more than the storage substrate.
summary_en.experiments:
Four experimental results stand out. First, the benchmark itself contains 1,385 English cases: 1,000 templated cases and 385 adversarial ones. The adversarial layer includes 132 hand-crafted core cases and 253 LLM-drafted but oracle-validated cases. Qwen-2.5-72B is used only for data admission, not for evaluation. Human agreement is strong, with Fleiss' kappa of 0.958 on a 100-case, 10-annotator audit.

Second, the paper shows a clear decoupling between recall quality and forgetting ability. MemPalace scores 60/150 on Memora, indicating strong recall, yet gets 0/385 on adversarial forgetting. That is the cleanest evidence in the paper that retrieval success says little about controllable forgetting.

Third, the main comparison across thirteen configurations is informative at the category level. Deterministic primitives work for lexical and temporal categories, but identifier obfuscation stays at or below 5%, and cross-lingual cases are at 0%. Inscribe-time LLMs recover canonicalization to 100% but do not help with intent-sensitive mutation. Mutation-time LLM hooks reach 93.3% to 94.2% overall when excluding the primitive-existence compound_fact category, and 91.7% to 93.2% when including it. The reported cost is about $0.17 per 385-case run, with the recall hot path unchanged.

Fourth, the category-wise analysis is more important than the average score. Canonicalization depends on semantic normalization at write time. Intent-aware deletion depends on semantic interpretation at mutation time. Lexical and temporal correctness can often be handled by deterministic rules. The paper's practical lesson is therefore about where to place intelligence, not about replacing the entire memory stack with an LLM.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a skim paper. Start with the introduction to understand the recall-plane versus control-plane framing. Then read the ForgetEval task definition and the five structural families, because the benchmark design is the backbone of the paper. After that, focus on the placement comparison figure and the category-level results. Those sections contain the main insight. If time is limited, 30 to 40 minutes is enough to extract the core message. Two points are worth probing further: the limits of deterministic scoring, and whether mutation-time hooks introduce new false-deletion risks. The paper is stronger on coverage than on the cost of wrong deletions.

recommendation.zh: Agent记忆架构的系统对比研究，仅看§3的三种放置范式性能边界即可，对预训练内在记忆设计有弱参考价值
recommendation.en: Systematic comparison of agent memory architectures; only review §3 for the three placement regimes’ performance boundaries, provides weak reference for intrinsic pretraining memory design

paper.title: Not All Skills Help: Measuring and Repairing Agent Knowledge
paper.abstract: LLM agents can improve without weight updates by accumulating natural-language skills from experience, but current systems entrust every decision about which skills to keep and how to apply them to LLM judgment alone. We argue that this conflates two distinct roles: generating a skill from experience is a creative act that judgment handles well, while deciding whether that skill actually helps requires empirical evidence across many tasks. Measuring per-skill causal contributions via randomized

summary.core_problem: 基于经验积累自然语言技能的 agent 往往把“生成技能”和“判断技能是否有用”都交给 LLM，本工作指出这种做法会掩盖技能在不同任务上的异质性。
summary.importance: 这是 agent memory / skill library 方向的方法论文。贡献点是用因果归因而不是全局平均效果来筛技能，属于较干净的 agent 诊断与修复思路。对基座预训练的直接帮助有限，但对 post-train 后的无参数更新能力积累有一点启发。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 ASSAY，把 skill generation 和 skill curation 分离。先在小型开发集上通过 randomized masking 估计每个 skill 的因果贡献，再离线重组技能库，并在测试时按任务抑制预测为负效应的技能。核心观察是 causal heterogeneity：同一个 skill 可能对某些任务有帮助、对另一些任务有害，平均后会被全局指标掩盖。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型和 benchmark 名称。实验重点是比较原始 skill library 管理方式与 ASSAY 的差异，展示单个 skill 的正负迁移会在 aggregate metric 下相互抵消，而基于 per-skill causal attribution 的筛选能改善 agent 表现。由于缺少规模与具体数字，这里更适合作为方法思路了解，而不是结果导向阅读。

summary_en.core_problem: Agents that accumulate natural-language skills from experience often let the LLM both generate skills and decide whether they are useful; this paper argues that such a setup hides strong task-dependent heterogeneity in skill utility.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent memory / skill-library paper. Its main contribution is to use causal attribution rather than global average utility for skill curation, which is a relatively clean diagnosis-and-repair idea. The direct relevance to core pretraining is limited, though it offers some signal for post-training systems that improve without weight updates.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes ASSAY, which separates skill generation from skill curation. It estimates per-skill causal contribution on a small development set via randomized masking, restructures the skill library offline, and suppresses skills predicted to have negative effect for each test task. The key observation is causal heterogeneity: the same skill can help some task types and hurt others, and these effects cancel out under aggregate metrics.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify model sizes or benchmark names. The experiments compare standard skill-library management against ASSAY, showing that positive and negative transfer from individual skills can cancel in aggregate metrics, while per-skill causal attribution improves agent performance. Without concrete scale and numbers, this is better treated as a method idea than a result-heavy paper.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“技能平均有效≠逐任务有效”这个诊断值得记住；看 randomized masking 的归因设定即可，正文不用深读。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the diagnosis that average skill utility hides per-task harm is worth keeping; read the randomized-masking attribution setup and move on.

paper.title: StreamMemBench: Streaming Evaluation of Agent Memory for Future-Oriented Assistance
paper.abstract: A central role of personal-agent memory is to turn stored information and prior interactions into future-oriented assistance. In daily use, useful cues come from what the agent observes and how the user interacts with the agent, and the agent must carry them forward from the current request to similar future tasks.
