summary_en.core_problem: Existing long-context management for LLM agents relies on iterative history summarization, where the extra decoding overhead of summarization sits on the inference critical path, leading to growing end-to-end latency as interaction rounds increase. Neither context compression nor system-level optimizations can fundamentally resolve the latency bottleneck under unbounded interaction traces.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining research, this work indicates agent memory management modules can be decoupled from the main base model and trained on specialized lightweight models, removing the requirement to build all long-context capabilities into a single monolithic model. It also provides a reference for asynchronous training and inference paradigm design.
summary_en.technical_approach: Decouple memory management from the main agent reasoning workflow, offload history compression to a dedicated lightweight summarization model; design a k-step-off asynchronous pipeline that overlaps memory model summarization with main agent inference, masking context processing latency from the critical path; adopt a reward-driven alignment strategy with functional equivalence reward to train the memory model, ensuring compressed summaries enable the main agent to achieve policy performance comparable to full-context inference.
summary_en.experiments: Tested on the SWE-Bench-Verified benchmark, decoding overhead is reduced by up to 1.4x while task performance stays on par with state-of-the-art long-context baselines.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the asynchronous pipeline design in Section 3 and reward alignment methodology in Section 4, plus the latency-performance comparison table in the experiment section. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.
summary_en.authors_note: Halıcıoğlu Data Science Institute, UC San Diego; Amazon. Corresponding author: Yuwei Zhang

recommendation.zh: 这类工作容易沦为系统小技巧，但“异步记忆+奖励对齐”确实碰到 agent memory 的真问题；先看方法图和 latency/quality trade-off，若曲线干净，值得内部复现。
recommendation.en: This could have been just a systems trick, but the async-memory plus reward alignment angle hits a real agent-memory problem; read the method figure and latency-quality trade-off first, and replicate internally only if the curves are clean.

paper.title: S3Mem: Structured Spatiotemporal Scene-Event Memory for Long-Horizon Interactive Question Answering
paper.abstract: Long-horizon interactive agents often accumulate large trajectory histories yet still fail to answer questions about earlier events reliably. We argue that the main bottleneck is not context length alone, but the trajectory-to-answer interface of long-term memory. When histories are stored as plain-text chunks and queried with standard retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), systems often retrieve locally relevant but chain-incomplete evidence, especially for spatial, temporal, repeated-event, and

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程交互式智能体在回答早期事件相关问题时，单靠长上下文或普通RAG仍经常检索到局部相关但证据链不完整内容的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent 长时记忆接口设计问题，不是基座预训练问题本身；价值主要在于说明“记忆表示与检索接口”比单纯拉长上下文更关键，对做长期交互 agent 或 memory-augmented LM 的人有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 S3Mem，将轨迹写入结构化的 scene-event episodic memory，而不是纯文本块；检索时使用 anchor-sensitive retrieval，尽量围绕时空锚点、重复事件和多跳状态组织证据；回答阶段再暴露一个紧凑、受 token budget 约束的 evidence interface，减少模型在长轨迹中自行拼接证据链的负担。
summary.experiments: 摘要只说明在两个内部长时程交互 QA 基准上评测，重点覆盖空间、时间、重复事件和多跳状态问题；未在摘要中给出模型规模、训练数据量、具体 baseline 和量化提升幅度，因此目前更像一个系统接口思路，需看正文确认实验是否干净、是否优于更强长上下文和更强检索基线。

summary_en.core_problem: It targets the failure of long-horizon interactive agents to answer questions about earlier events, where longer context or vanilla RAG still retrieves locally relevant but chain-incomplete evidence.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly an agent memory-interface paper rather than a foundation pretraining paper; its value is in showing that memory representation and retrieval interfaces can matter more than raw context length for long-horizon agents.
summary_en.technical_approach: S3Mem writes trajectories into structured scene-event episodic memory instead of plain text chunks. At query time, it uses anchor-sensitive retrieval to organize evidence around spatial/temporal anchors, repeated events, and multi-hop state dependencies, then exposes a compact token-budget-aware evidence interface for answer generation.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract mentions evaluation on two internal long-horizon interactive QA benchmarks, focusing on spatial, temporal, repeated-event, and multi-hop state questions. It does not provide model sizes, training data, baselines, or exact gains, so the current signal is more about system design than a fully validated methodological result.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但如果你在做 memory-augmented agent，只看“结构化轨迹写入+检索接口”这件事即可；先别把它当长上下文替代结论。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but if you work on memory-augmented agents, read it for the structured write/retrieval interface only; do not treat it as a clean long-context replacement result yet.

paper.title: WorldMemArena: Evaluating Multimodal Agent Memory Through Action-World Interaction
paper.abstract: Multimodal large language models are increasingly deployed as long-horizon agents, where memory must do more than recall: it must track an evolving world, revise what has gone stale, and surface the right evidence at decision time. Existing benchmarks measure recall over static dialogue, collapse memory into a single end-of-task accuracy, and reduce visual observations to captions, leaving us unable to localize failures to writing, maintenance, retrieval, or use. The rise of agent harnesses that

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“模型能记住多少内容”，而是多模态长程 agent 在动态世界里，记忆系统到底在哪个环节失效。作者指出，现有 memory benchmark 大多把问题压缩成静态上下文里的 recall 或最终问答准确率，因此无法区分：信息有没有被写入、世界变化后有没有更新、需要时有没有被正确取回、取回后有没有真正用于决策。对带执行轨迹的 agent 来说，这个问题更尖锐，因为记忆不再只是外挂数据库，而是和策略、工具调用、环境反馈一起形成闭环。论文因此把 memory 重新定义为一个 Action–World Interaction Loop 中的四阶段生命周期：writing、maintenance、retrieval、use，并围绕这个过程做可诊断评测。
summary.importance: 它的价值主要在评测范式，而不是提出新的 memory 算法。对基座研究的意义有两层。第一，它把“长上下文/外部记忆是否有效”从单点终局指标拆成过程指标，这对分析 agent memory、长上下文建模、RAG-style memory、self-authored memory 都有帮助。第二，它把多模态证据和环境状态变化纳入 memory 评测，避免把视觉观察先压成 caption 再评估，这更接近未来原生多模态 agent 的训练与诊断需求。对做 pretrain/post-train 接口的人，这篇文章提供了一个很实用的视角：很多失败并不是存不进去，而是存了也不会用，或者世界变了但记忆没被修正。这个区分会直接影响训练信号设计。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上，作者先给出一个较清晰的形式化。环境有潜在状态 z_t，agent 只能看到由 Ω 映射得到的局部 observation o_t；策略 π 基于 observation 和当前 memory state m_t 选择 action a_t；环境 ℰ 执行动作后更新状态并返回 feedback f_t。完整轨迹写成 τ=(x;η_1,...,η_T)，其中 η_t=(o_t,a_t,f_t)，再进一步切成多 session 轨迹，使得局部上下文受限，但世界状态跨 session 持续演化。这个设定很关键，因为它把“记忆”从长 prompt 内的被动保留，变成跨 session 的主动状态管理。

在这个框架下，作者定义四个可观测阶段。writing 关注系统是否把未来有用的信息写入 memory；maintenance 关注世界状态变化后，旧记忆是否被修订、删除或标记失效；retrieval 关注回答或决策时是否取回了正确证据；use 关注取回的证据是否真的支撑了最终行为，而不是只是表面命中。论文的一个设计重点，是为这四个阶段提供共享的 trajectory-level gold evidence，而不是让每个指标各自依赖不同标注口径。

基于这个定义，作者构建了 WorldMemArena。数据由 400 个长程多模态交互任务组成，覆盖两类场景。Lifelong Evolution 更像跨 session 的持续状态跟踪，强调个人信息、任务状态、偏好或环境条件的长期变化与复用；Agentic Execution 更接近真实 agent 执行，关键信息分散在 observation、action、tool feedback 和环境变化中，要求系统从执行过程里抽取可复用证据，而不是依赖整理好的叙事文本。每个 session 都标注了 gold memory points、state updates、distractors 和 answer-supporting evidence chains，因此可以分别诊断写入、维护、检索、使用四个环节。

论文还统一比较了三类 memory 范式：长上下文直接塞进 prompt 的 agent、人工设计的 memory pipeline、以及依托 agent harness 让模型自己编写和重组 memory 的系统。这个比较的重点不是谁最终分数高，而是不同范式在四阶段上的失效模式：人工系统通常结构更规整，写入和检索更可控，但适应性差；harness-based memory 更灵活，能在执行中自组织记忆，但成本更高，稳定性也更差。
summary.experiments:
从全文可见的关键信息看，评测集规模是 400 个多 session 长程任务，覆盖 Lifelong Evolution 和 Agentic Execution 两个 regime。作者在统一设置下比较了三类代表性 memory 系统，并给出四个主要经验结论。

第一，写入更多正确记忆点，并不自动带来更好的最终表现。也就是说，memory quantity 和 downstream utility 之间并不是线性关系。很多系统在 writing 指标上不差，但在 use 阶段掉得很明显，说明问题不在“有没有记住”，而在“决策时能否把证据接上”。

第二，多模态 memory 仍是明显瓶颈，尤其在需要复杂视觉推理时更突出。论文强调，若把视觉证据简化成 caption，会掩盖真实困难；在原始多模态交互里，系统更容易在写入和检索阶段丢失视觉细节，最终影响 use。

第三，不同 domain 的 memory 表现差异很大，而且在 Agentic Execution 上普遍比 Lifelong Evolution 更差。原因是后者的信息来源更分散，既包含观察，也包含动作结果、工具反馈和状态变化，memory system 需要从“过程”中抽取证据，而不是从静态文本中摘录事实。

第四，人工 memory 系统与 harness-based memory agent 呈现明显取舍：前者更结构化，但对开放环境变化不够灵活；后者更能适应复杂执行轨迹，但代价更高，且可靠性不足。摘要和正文节选里没有给出完整的数值表，因此这里不编造具体分数；精读时应重点看各阶段指标、不同任务类型分层结果，以及 error case 对四阶段失效的归因。
summary.reading_guide:
这篇适合按“问题定义—数据构造—诊断结论”三步读。

先看 Introduction 和 Problem Formulation。重点不是形式化本身，而是作者为什么坚持把 memory 拆成四阶段，以及为什么要用 session 化的动态世界，而不是长对话。这里决定了整篇工作的评测哲学。

然后看 benchmark 构造部分，尤其是 Lifelong Evolution 与 Agentic Execution 的差别、gold memory points / state updates / evidence chains 的标注方式。这里值得细看，因为很多 benchmark 的上限其实由标注口径决定；如果标注只覆盖显式文本事实，就很难真正测到 agent memory。

实验部分建议优先看三类 memory 范式的对比表，以及四阶段指标和最终任务成功率之间的关系。如果有图表展示 writing 与 use 的脱钩、不同模态或不同任务类型上的退化，这些是最有信息量的地方。

如果时间有限，预计 25 到 35 分钟可以抓住主线；如果要把它当作 agent memory 研究的评测底座来用，建议再花时间看附录中的标注协议、任务示例和 failure case。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not asking whether an agent can retain more tokens. It asks where multimodal memory actually breaks in long-horizon interaction with a changing world. Existing memory benchmarks mostly test recall in static dialogue or collapse everything into final QA accuracy. That setup cannot tell whether useful evidence was written at all, whether stale memory was updated after the world changed, whether the right evidence was retrieved at decision time, or whether retrieved evidence was truly used. This becomes more important for execution-based agents, where memory is intertwined with policy, tool feedback, and environment transitions. The paper therefore reframes agent memory as a four-stage lifecycle inside an Action–World Interaction Loop: writing, maintenance, retrieval, and use.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is an evaluation lens rather than a new memory algorithm. For foundation-model research, the value is twofold. First, it decomposes memory quality into process-level signals instead of a single end metric. That is useful for studying long-context agents, external memory systems, retrieval-augmented memory, and self-authored memory. Second, it keeps multimodal evidence and world-state evolution in the loop, instead of reducing visual observations to captions before evaluation. That makes the benchmark more relevant to native multimodal agents. For people working on the pretrain/post-train interface, the paper offers a practical diagnosis: many failures are not about failing to store information, but about failing to revise or use it when the environment changes.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The paper starts with a clean formalization. The environment has a latent state z_t. The agent only observes partial inputs o_t through an observation mapping Ω. A policy π chooses action a_t based on the current observation and memory state m_t. The environment ℰ executes the action, updates the world, and returns feedback f_t. A full trajectory is written as τ=(x;η_1,...,η_T), where each event η_t=(o_t,a_t,f_t). The trajectory is further segmented into multiple sessions, so local context is limited while the world state persists across sessions. This is an important design choice: memory is treated as active state management across sessions, not passive retention inside one long prompt.

On top of this setup, the paper defines four observable stages. Writing asks whether future-useful information is stored. Maintenance asks whether memory is revised, deleted, or marked stale when the world changes. Retrieval asks whether the correct evidence is surfaced when answering or acting. Use asks whether the retrieved evidence actually supports the final decision rather than being superficially present. A notable design choice is that all four stages are grounded in shared trajectory-level gold evidence, which makes diagnosis more consistent.

The benchmark, WorldMemArena, contains 400 long-horizon multimodal interaction tasks spanning two regimes. Lifelong Evolution focuses on persistent personal or task states that evolve across sessions and must be tracked and reused over time. Agentic Execution is closer to realistic agent trajectories, where reusable evidence is distributed across observations, actions, tool feedback, and state changes rather than packaged as clean text narratives. Each session is annotated with gold memory points, state updates, distractors, and answer-supporting evidence chains, enabling stage-level diagnosis.

The paper then evaluates three representative memory paradigms under one setup: long-context agents that rely on prompt accumulation, manually designed memory pipelines, and harness-based memory agents that author and reorganize their own memory during execution. The comparison is useful because it exposes different failure modes rather than only ranking systems by final accuracy. Manual systems tend to be more structured and controllable, while harness-based systems are more adaptive but also more expensive and less reliable.
summary_en.experiments:
From the full text provided, the benchmark contains 400 multi-session long-horizon tasks across Lifelong Evolution and Agentic Execution. The paper compares three classes of memory systems and reports four main empirical findings.

First, storing more correct memory items does not guarantee better downstream performance. Memory quantity and memory utility are clearly decoupled. Some systems do reasonably well on writing but still fail badly at use, which means the bottleneck is often decision-time integration rather than storage.

Second, multimodal memory remains a major bottleneck, especially on tasks requiring nontrivial visual reasoning. The paper explicitly argues that caption-based evaluation hides this difficulty. In native multimodal interaction, visual details are more easily lost during writing and retrieval, which then hurts use.

Third, performance varies substantially by domain and degrades on Agentic Execution relative to Lifelong Evolution. The reason is that evidence in Agentic Execution is distributed across the interaction process itself, including actions and tool feedback, not just observations. Memory systems therefore need to extract reusable evidence from trajectories rather than copy facts from text.

Fourth, manual memory systems and harness-based memory agents show a clear trade-off. Manual systems are more structured but less adaptive. Harness-based systems are more flexible in open-ended execution but remain costly and less reliable. The excerpt does not include the full numeric tables, so it is better not to invent exact scores. The most informative parts to inspect are the stage-level metrics, the gap between writing and use, and the breakdown by task regime and modality.
summary_en.reading_guide:
Read it in three passes: problem framing, benchmark construction, and diagnosis.

Start with the Introduction and Problem Formulation. The key point is not the notation itself, but why the authors insist on a four-stage lifecycle and a session-based dynamic world instead of long dialogue. That choice defines the benchmark’s philosophy.

Then read the benchmark construction carefully, especially the difference between Lifelong Evolution and Agentic Execution, and how gold memory points, state updates, and evidence chains are annotated. This is worth attention because the usefulness of a memory benchmark depends heavily on what is labeled as evidence.

In the experiments, prioritize the comparison across the three memory paradigms and the relationship between stage-level metrics and final task success. Any figure showing the disconnect between writing and use, or degradation by modality and task type, is likely to be the most informative.

If you only need the main idea, 25–35 minutes should be enough. If you want to reuse it as an evaluation scaffold for agent memory work, spend extra time on the annotation protocol, task examples, and failure cases in the appendix.

recommendation.zh: 将agent记忆拆解为四阶段生命周期并建立可诊断的评测框架，这种设计方法论对思考通用agent能力评估范式有借鉴价值，建议看评测设计章节。
recommendation.en: The four-stage lifecycle decomposition of agent memory and diagnosable evaluation design methodology is insightful for thinking about general agent capability assessment paradigms. Read the evaluation design section.

paper.title: Beyond Recall: Behavioral Specification as an Interpretive Layer for AI Personalization
paper.abstract: If an AI agent makes decisions on a person's behalf, those decisions must align with its user. We introduce representational accuracy to measure how faithfully a system captures a person's interpretation. An interpretive layer is operationalized as a Behavioral Specification. Our reference implementation aggressively compresses a person's data into interpretive patterns, served as context to a language model. We evaluate the Specification on a prototype benchmark of held-out behavioral predictio

summary.core_problem: 个性化 AI agent 代表用户做决策时，如何用更低上下文成本捕捉用户的解释框架和行为偏好，而不只是检索事实记忆。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent memory 和 personalization 表示方法。它提出 representational accuracy 作为个性化系统是否忠实表达用户解释方式的指标，并把 Behavioral Specification 作为可插入的解释层。
summary.technical_approach: 方法把个人数据压缩成 Behavioral Specification，即一组解释性行为模式，并作为上下文提供给语言模型。它不是简单保留原始语料或抽取事实，而是尝试提炼用户如何解释、权衡和行动的模式；并与 raw corpus、extracted facts 以及 Mem0、Letta、Supermemory、Zep 等商业 memory 系统组合比较。
summary.experiments: 实验使用 14 个 public-domain autobiographical corpora，构造 held-out behavioral prediction benchmark，并用校准的 5-judge LLM panel 打分。摘要报告 Behavioral Specification 提升 aggregate representational accuracy，几乎消除模型 hedging，并以约 25x 更少上下文成本恢复 raw corpus 的大部分效果。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how a personalized AI agent can capture a user's interpretive patterns and behavioral preferences at low context cost, rather than merely retrieving facts from memory.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-memory and personalization representation contribution. It introduces representational accuracy as a measure of whether a system faithfully captures a person's interpretation, and proposes Behavioral Specification as an interpretive layer.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method compresses a person's data into a Behavioral Specification: a set of interpretive behavioral patterns served as context to a language model. It contrasts this with using the full raw corpus, extracted facts, and commercial memory systems such as Mem0, Letta, Supermemory, and Zep.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments use 14 public-domain autobiographical corpora and a prototype held-out behavioral prediction benchmark scored by a calibrated five-judge LLM panel. The abstract reports improved aggregate representational accuracy, near elimination of model hedging, and recovery of most raw-corpus benefits at roughly 25x lower context cost.

recommendation.zh: 可作为 agent memory 压缩方案备查；LLM judge 和自传语料 setup 偏窄，不宜外推到通用个性化。
recommendation.en: Keep it as a reference for agent-memory compression; the LLM-judge and autobiographical-corpus setup is too narrow for broad personalization claims.

paper.title: MemCog: From Memory-as-Tool to Memory-as-Cognition in Conversational Agents
paper.abstract: Existing agent memory systems universally follow what we term a Memory-as-Tool paradigm where a single query triggers one-shot retrieval of flat passage lists, suffering from passive invocation, reasoning-retrieval decoupling, and structural mismatch between retrieved fragments and the agent's navigational needs. We propose MemCog, a Memory-as-Cognition system that makes memory access an integral part of the reasoning process. MemCog organizes user knowledge as Navigable Memory Store with associ

summary.core_problem: 解决对话 agent 的记忆系统只做一次性被动检索，无法把记忆访问纳入持续推理过程的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 agent memory 架构工作，贡献点在记忆组织、主动触发和 benchmark 构建。对做长期上下文、外部记忆和 agent 系统的人有参考，但对 LLM 基座预训练的直接启发较弱。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MemCog，把 memory 从工具式调用改为认知式过程：用带关联边的 Navigable Memory Store 组织用户知识；提供 Cross-Dimensional Navigation Interface 支持多步遍历；再用 Proactive Reasoning Protocol 让 agent 从对话上下文主动发起记忆探索。另构建 ProactiveMemBench 评测主动记忆触发。
summary.experiments: 在 LoCoMo、LongMemEval 等被动 QA benchmark 以及自建主动记忆 benchmark 上评估，摘要声称在被动任务上达到 92.98 和 95.8，并在主动记忆场景显著优于基线。实验更像系统集成验证，尚不足以回答这类记忆结构是否能迁移到更广泛 agent 设定。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the limitation of conversational agents whose memory systems rely on one-shot passive retrieval rather than integrating memory access into ongoing reasoning.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-memory systems paper with contributions in memory organization, proactive triggering, and benchmarking. It is relevant to long-context and external-memory systems, but only loosely connected to core pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: MemCog reframes memory from a tool into a cognition process: a Navigable Memory Store with associative links, a Cross-Dimensional Navigation Interface for multi-step traversal, and a Proactive Reasoning Protocol that triggers memory exploration from dialogue context. It also introduces ProactiveMemBench.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on passive QA benchmarks such as LoCoMo and LongMemEval, plus a new proactive memory benchmark. The abstract reports 92.98 and 95.8 on passive tasks and substantial gains on proactive settings. The evidence is mainly system-level rather than a clean study of memory mechanisms.

recommendation.zh: 是个像样的 agent memory 设计，但更偏系统拼装；若你关心长期记忆接口，只看 benchmark 设定和主动触发协议即可。
recommendation.en: A decent agent-memory design, but mostly systems glue; read only the benchmark setup and proactive triggering protocol if long-term memory interfaces matter to you.

paper.title: Is Agent Memory a Database? Rethinking Data Foundations for Long-Term AI Agent Memory
paper.abstract: Long-running AI agents need persistent memory. Memory supports learning across sessions, reduces repeated context injection, and enables auditing of past decisions. Current agent memory systems and database paradigms treat memory as storage. They localize correctness at records, embeddings, or edges. Each supplies only some of the capabilities that long-term memory requires. The result is four recurring failure modes: unregulated growth, missing semantic revision, capacity-driven forgetting, and

summary.core_problem: 长期运行的 AI agent 记忆应如何定义“正确性”：把记忆当数据库/向量库/知识图谱存储会导致哪些系统性失败。
summary.importance: 偏系统与数据管理视角的概念性工作：把 agent memory 视为“状态随时间演化的工作负载”，对构建可审计、可修订、可遗忘的长期记忆有启发，但缺少与 LLM 训练目标/预训练 recipe 的直接连接。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Governed Evolving Memory (GEM)：用 state-level 操作符（ingestion/revision/forgetting/retrieval）替代 record-level CRUD；给出 6 条 correctness 条件，并论证 record-level 系统无法同时满足这些条件。
summary.experiments: 摘要未体现实证实验，主要是形式化定义与系统设计论证。

summary_en.core_problem: How to define and enforce correctness for long-term AI agent memory beyond treating memory as a database/embedding store/graph store.
summary_en.importance: A data-management framing: agent memory as an evolving state trajectory with governance (revision/forgetting/auditing). Useful for system design, but not directly tied to LLM pretraining objectives or recipes.
summary_en.technical_approach: Proposes Governed Evolving Memory (GEM) with state-level operators (ingestion, revision, forgetting, retrieval) and six correctness conditions; argues record-level systems cannot satisfy them simultaneously.
summary_en.experiments: No clear empirical evaluation in the abstract; primarily formalization and design arguments.

recommendation.zh: 不是算法论文，更像把 agent memory 的“正确性”从检索命中率拉回到状态演化约束；读定义与 failure modes 列表即可，别指望可复现的量化结论。
recommendation.en: More a reframing than an algorithm: it shifts agent-memory “correctness” from retrieval accuracy to state-evolution constraints—read the definitions and failure modes, don’t expect reproducible quantitative takeaways.

paper.title: SAM: State-Adaptive Memory for Long-Horizon Reasoning Agent
paper.abstract: Long-horizon agentic reasoning requires large language models to act over long interaction histories containing thoughts, tool calls, observations, and partial conclusions. The challenge is not merely that these histories grow long, but that information needed for the current decision may be scattered across distant steps and only become relevant later. Existing approaches address this difficulty by truncating the interaction history, compressing it into shorter surrogates, or retrieving selecte

summary.core_problem: 长程 Agent 推理中，交互历史持续增长，关键信息分散在远距离步骤里，现有截断、压缩或检索方法难以随 Agent 当前状态动态调整记忆访问。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 Agent 记忆机制改进。它把长程推理中的上下文管理问题明确表述为 state-adaptive memory，而不是单纯的长上下文压缩或固定检索，对通用 Agent 的执行轨迹管理有一定参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SAM，一个独立的状态自适应记忆框架。方法将持续交互浓缩为紧凑 memory cues，同时保留原始 trajectory pages；memory cues 不是历史替代物，而是用于指导后续意图驱动召回的轻量索引信号。核心思想是让召回策略跟随 Agent 状态变化，而不是固定保留最近上下文或静态检索片段。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体模型规模、数据规模、基线名称和数值结果。可确认的是论文针对长程 agentic reasoning 场景评估 SAM，并与截断、压缩、检索式历史复用等现有范式形成对比。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-horizon agents accumulate long interaction traces, where information needed for the current decision may be scattered across distant prior thoughts, tool calls, observations, and partial conclusions.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an agent memory design rather than a base-model training method. Its useful angle is to frame trajectory management as state-adaptive access, not just context truncation, summarization, or static retrieval.
summary_en.technical_approach: SAM keeps compact memory cues while preserving raw trajectory pages. The cues act as lightweight intent-conditioned pointers for recall rather than lossy replacements for the history, allowing memory access to change with the evolving agent state.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report model sizes, datasets, baselines, or numerical gains. It states that SAM is evaluated for long-horizon agentic reasoning against common history truncation, compression, and retrieval-style approaches.

recommendation.zh: Agent 记忆论文里算 setup 比较干净的一类；预训练侧不必细读，扫方法图看它如何区分 cue 和 raw page 即可。
recommendation.en: A reasonably clean agent-memory setup; for pretraining work, skim the method figure and the cue-versus-raw-page design, not the full paper.

paper.title: Personalize-then-Store: Benchmarking and Learning Personalized Memory for Long-horizon Agents
paper.abstract: Existing large language model (LLM) based memory systems apply universal, static policies that overlook a fundamental reality: the contexts that are worth storing in memory are different across users. This misalignment wastes limited memory budget on transient interactions while failing to preserve critical context for long horizon tasks. To address this gap, we investigate an underexplored question: can LLM based memory systems learn personalized memory policies? We introduce PerMemBench, the f

summary.core_problem: 现有 LLM agent 记忆系统通常使用统一、静态的存储策略，无法区分不同用户长期任务中真正值得保留的上下文。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent 长程记忆 benchmark 和经验分析。它不直接影响基座预训练，但触及长期交互、个性化上下文选择和记忆预算分配，对未来 continual pretrain 或 posttrain memory 数据构造有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 论文提出 PerMemBench，用多年、多领域交互历史和多样用户画像评估个性化记忆系统；同时提出 session-level storage gating，在会话级判断是否跳过记忆写入，从而把有限记忆预算留给更长期有用的上下文。
summary.experiments: 摘要称在理想 gating 条件下，个性化策略带来明显 retention gains；但实际准确 gating 仍未解决。摘要未给出具体模型、数据规模、baseline 数字或提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: Current LLM-agent memory systems often use universal and static storage policies, failing to account for which contexts are worth remembering for different users over long horizons.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a benchmark and empirical study for long-horizon personalized memory. It is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to long-term interaction, personalized context selection, and memory-budget allocation, which may inform continual pretraining or post-training data design.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper introduces PerMemBench, built around multi-year, multi-domain interaction histories and diverse user personas. It also studies session-level storage gating, a lightweight policy that skips memory operations for transient sessions.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports substantial retention gains under perfect gating, while showing that accurate real-world gating remains open. It does not provide model sizes, dataset scale, baseline numbers, or exact improvement figures.

recommendation.zh: 个性化 memory 的问题设定比方法更有用；读 benchmark schema 和 gating 误差分析即可。
recommendation.en: The personalized-memory setup is more useful than the method; read the benchmark schema and gating-error analysis.

paper.title: Mitigating Provenance-Role Collapse in Long-Term Agents via Typed Memory Representation
paper.abstract: Long-term memory is essential for persistent LLM agents, yet prevailing architectures store historical interactions as unstructured, flat text. This unconstrained storage induces provenance-role collapse, a critical failure mode where agents suffer from source-monitoring errors. To resolve this cognitive vulnerability at the architectural level, we propose MemIR, a typed Memory Intermediate Representation that operationalizes source monitoring as a structural constraint. MemIR writes long-term m

summary.core_problem: 解决长期 LLM agent 将历史交互以扁平文本存储时出现的来源与角色混淆问题，即 agent 无法区分原始证据、检索线索和可用于回答的事实声明。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent memory 架构改进。它把长期记忆中的 source monitoring 显式结构化，对 persistent agent 的记忆可靠性有参考意义，但与基座预训练方法的直接关系较弱。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MemIR，一种 typed Memory Intermediate Representation。方法将长期记忆写成 grounded atoms，分离 raw evidence、retrieval cues 和 truth-bearing claims，并限制只有被证据支持的 claim atoms 能进入事实授权路径；随后用 multi-route atomic projection 和 provenance-scoped utilization，把异构检索结果转换成以 claim 为中心的候选包和规范化 fact interface。
summary.experiments: 在 LoCoMo 和 BEAM-100K 上与现有 memory baselines 比较，摘要称 MemIR 稳定优于基线，尤其在需要长期记忆和来源约束的场景中表现更好；摘要未给出模型参数量、具体基线列表和提升幅度。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses provenance-role collapse in long-term LLM agents, where flat textual memory makes the agent confuse raw evidence, retrieval cues, and truth-bearing claims.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-memory architecture contribution. It makes source monitoring a structural constraint, which is useful for persistent agents, but it has only indirect value for base-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: The proposed MemIR stores long-term memory as typed grounded atoms that separate evidence, cues, and supported claims. Factual use is restricted to authorized claim atoms, and retrieval results are transformed through multi-route atomic projection and provenance-scoped utilization into claim-centered bundles for generation.
summary_en.experiments: Experiments are reported on LoCoMo and BEAM-100K against memory baselines. The abstract claims consistent gains, especially under long-term provenance-sensitive settings, but does not specify model sizes, baseline details, or numerical margins.

recommendation.zh: agent 记忆的 typed IR 比花式检索更干净；看失败定义和 atom schema，别外推到通用长期学习。
recommendation.en: Typed memory IR is cleaner than retrieval tricks; read the failure definition and atom schema, but do not overread it as general long-term learning.

paper.title: AgentIR: A Workload-Adaptive Cascade Retrieval Substrate for Long-Term Conversational Memory
paper.abstract: Long-term conversational memory is a retrieval workload classical IR was not built for: the index grows during the query stream, query types shift intra-session, and the latency budget per retrieval is sub-10 ms. Lucene-class engines treat the index as static and the query as stateless, leaving the workload's structure unexploited.   AgentIR treats fusion as a per-query decision along two axes: which fusion to apply (BM25, Dense, RRF, or agent-aware RRF), and whether the ~52 ms dense channel is

summary.core_problem: 面向长期对话记忆，如何在动态增长索引、会话内查询类型变化和亚 10ms 延迟预算下，决定是否调用昂贵的 dense retrieval。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent memory / RAG 检索系统优化。它不改 LLM，也不涉及预训练，但提出了一个 workload-adaptive cascade：对每个查询决定用 BM25、Dense、RRF 或 agent-aware RRF，并判断 dense 通道是否值得运行。
summary.technical_approach: AgentIR 把融合策略做成 per-query 决策。第一维选择检索融合方式，第二维用 BM25 top-k margin 作为置信信号触发 cascade router；router 不需要重新训练，可随 workload 重新调阈值。关键取舍是用便宜的稀疏检索 margin 预测 dense channel 的边际价值。
summary.experiments: 在 LongMemEval 上 n=500，dense 通道确实提供额外信息时，cascade 跳过 63% 查询，在两个 LLM judge 下保持准确率相当，并取得 2.67x 加速；按 query type 调阈值后，5-fold cross-validation 下达到 5.76x。LoCoMo 上 n=1,982，摘要显示 BM25 已很强，但后续结果片段被截断。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses long-term conversational memory retrieval under a growing index, shifting query types within sessions, and sub-10 ms latency constraints.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-memory and RAG retrieval-systems contribution. It does not change the LLM or pretraining process, but it proposes a workload-adaptive cascade that decides per query whether to use BM25, dense retrieval, RRF, or agent-aware RRF, and whether the dense channel is worth its cost.
summary_en.technical_approach: AgentIR makes fusion a per-query decision. It chooses the fusion mode and uses the BM25 top-k margin as a cheap confidence signal for a cascade router that can be retuned across workloads without retraining. The key idea is to predict the marginal utility of dense retrieval from sparse-retrieval confidence.
summary_en.experiments: On LongMemEval with n=500, where the dense channel adds information, the cascade skips 63% of queries while preserving LLM-judged accuracy under two judges and gives a 2.67x speedup; per-query-type thresholds reach 5.76x under 5-fold cross-validation. On LoCoMo with n=1,982, the abstract indicates BM25 is already strong, but the provided fragment truncates the remaining result.

recommendation.zh: 系统味道比模型味道重；记住 BM25 margin 路由 dense 的结果即可，不值得为预训练读正文。
recommendation.en: This is more systems than modeling; keep the BM25-margin dense-routing result in mind, but it is not worth a full read for pretraining.

paper.title: Dynamic Mixture of Latent Memories for Self-Evolving Agents
paper.abstract: Achieving self-evolution in intelligent agents requires the continual accumulation of new knowledge across changing task sequences without forgetting previously acquired abilities. Existing approaches either internalize knowledge by updating model parameters, which induces catastrophic forgetting, or rely on external memory, which fails to genuinely enhance the model's intrinsic capabilities. We propose MoLEM, a generative mixture of latent memory framework based on a dynamic mixture-of-experts

summary.core_problem: 这篇论文处理的是 agent 在连续任务序列中如何积累经验，同时避免遗忘。它不更新主干 LLM，而是希望把新任务经验写入可训练的 latent memory 模块，让冻结的推理模型在后续推理时直接使用这些连续表示。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的直接贡献有限，更接近 post-train / agent memory / continual learning 接口问题。值得泛读的点在于：它把“持续学习”从参数更新转到 latent memory 更新，并用动态 MoE 做容量扩展和任务隔离。这对研究 continual pretrain、adapter memory、非参数外部记忆与参数记忆之间的中间形态有参考意义。它也提醒一个实际问题：冻结 backbone 并不等于没有遗忘，若 latent memory 生成器共享参数，仍然会发生跨任务覆盖。
summary.technical_approach: MoLEM 使用动态 mixture-of-experts 作为 latent memory 生成器。多个 expert 被看作独立的记忆载体，每个 expert 生成一段连续 latent memory；router 通过 key-query matching 选择并加权相关 experts；聚合后的 latent memory 被注入到 LLM 的推理过程中。主干 reasoner 参数全程冻结，只训练 MoE memory 模块。论文还引入 task-ID-free 的 domain-aware routing：每个训练阶段配一个轻量 autoencoder，推理时用输入在各阶段 autoencoder 上的 reconstruction error 选择最匹配的 routing group；如果输入不匹配任何阶段，则回退到原始预训练模型，作为 OOD 保护。latent memory 的触发位置由 delimiter token 控制，例如逗号、句号等位置生成连续记忆序列。这和纯 retrieval memory 的区别是：检索方法只是把文本上下文塞回 prompt；MoLEM 试图学习一个可复用的内部连续表示。它和直接 SFT / GRPO 的区别是：不改 backbone，因此减少对原始能力的破坏。
summary.experiments: 实验设置是 continual learning，任务序列覆盖 math、science、code。每个训练阶段结束后，在对应测试集上评估新任务学习和旧任务保持。完整任务序列结束后，MoLEM 相比 Vanilla pretrained baseline 的平均准确率提升 10.40%。论文强调，对比方法在不同训练顺序下不能稳定超过 vanilla baseline，说明直接参数更新或普通记忆方法在任务顺序变化时稳定性较弱。可用数字主要是平均准确率提升；参数量、expert 数量、训练 token 规模等关键信息在给定内容中无法确认。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读，预计 20–30 分钟。重点看方法部分的三块：latent memory 如何生成和注入、MoE router 的 key-query matching、stage-wise autoencoder 如何做无 task ID 的路由选择。实验部分优先看不同任务顺序下的平均准确率和遗忘曲线，而不是只看最终分数。若关心 continual pretrain，可以重点比较它和 adapter tuning、LoRA continual learning、RAG memory 的边界：MoLEM 的优势来自冻结 backbone 和专家隔离，但代价是新增推理模块、路由错误风险，以及 latent memory 是否真正泛化到新组合任务仍需更强验证。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses continual self-evolution for LLM agents: how an agent can acquire experience over a sequence of changing tasks without overwriting previously acquired skills. The proposed answer is to keep the base reasoner frozen and store new experience in trainable latent-memory modules that are injected into the reasoning process.
summary_en.importance: The work is not a core pretraining paper, but it is relevant to the interface between post-training, agent memory, and continual learning. Its useful idea is to move continual adaptation away from backbone parameter updates and toward expandable latent memory. This gives a concrete middle ground between parametric fine-tuning and external retrieval: the memory is learned and internal to the computation, but the pretrained backbone remains unchanged.
summary_en.technical_approach: MoLEM builds a generative latent-memory module on top of a dynamic MoE structure. Each expert acts as an independent latent-memory carrier. A router performs key-query matching, selects and weights relevant experts, and aggregates their generated latent memories. The aggregated continuous memory is then injected into the frozen reasoner during generation. The method also uses task-ID-free domain routing. Each training stage has a lightweight autoencoder; at inference time, the system selects the routing group with the lowest reconstruction error. If no stage matches well, the input falls back to the pretrained model, which is used as an OOD safety path. Latent memory generation is activated around delimiter tokens, following prior latent-memory approaches such as MemGen-style designs.
summary_en.experiments: The experiments use continual-learning task sequences spanning math, science, and code. After each stage, the model is evaluated on the corresponding test sets to measure both new-task acquisition and competence preservation. After the full sequence, MoLEM improves average accuracy by 10.40% over the vanilla pretrained baseline. The paper reports that competing methods do not consistently exceed the vanilla baseline under different task orders, which suggests sensitivity to interference and task ordering. Details such as the exact number of experts, trainable parameter count, and training scale are not available in the provided content.
summary_en.reading_guide: A skim is enough, around 20–30 minutes. Focus on the latent-memory injection mechanism, the MoE router, and the stage-wise autoencoder routing design. In the experiments, the important plots are the per-stage continual-learning curves and the results under different task orders. For pretraining researchers, the useful question is not whether this is a stronger agent method, but whether expandable latent modules can provide a cleaner continual-adaptation interface than LoRA-style parameter updates or plain retrieval.

recommendation.zh: 只读方法图和 continual ablation；冻结基座加可路由 latent memory 是干净设定，但别把它等同于真参数内化。
recommendation.en: Read the method diagram and continual ablations; frozen-base routed latent memory is a clean setup, but do not equate it with true parameter internalization.

institutions: The Chinese University of Hong Kong

paper.title: DeferMem: Query-Time Evidence Distillation via Reinforcement Learning for Long-Term Memory QA
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents still struggle with long-term memory question answering, where answer-supporting evidence is often scattered across long conversational histories and buried in substantial irrelevant content. Existing memory systems typically process memory before future queries are known, then retrieve the resulting units based on similarity rather than their utility for answering the query. This workflow leaves downstream answerers to denoise retrieved candidates and reconstru

summary.core_problem: 解决长期记忆问答中证据分散、历史噪声大、传统相似度检索难以给出 query-specific supporting evidence 的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献是通用 LLM agent memory/RAG 框架，而不是基座预训练方法。它的价值在于把“先压缩记忆再等未来查询”的流程改为查询时证据蒸馏，并用 RL 训练 distiller。
summary.technical_approach: DeferMem 先用轻量 segment-link 结构组织原始对话历史，在查询时做高召回候选检索；随后用 memory distiller 将高召回但噪声很大的候选压缩成忠实、自包含、能回答当前问题的证据集合。DistillPO 是用于训练这个 distiller 的强化学习算法。
summary.experiments: 摘要聚焦长期记忆 QA 场景，声称 DeferMem 能从长对话历史中抽取 query-conditioned evidence，减轻 answerer 的去噪和重构负担；未给出 benchmark 名称、模型规模、训练数据量或量化提升。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自浙江大学 State Key Lab of CAD&CG。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles long-term memory QA where supporting evidence is scattered across long conversational histories and buried in irrelevant content.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a general LLM agent memory/RAG framework rather than a base pretraining method. Its useful idea is to defer memory compression until the query is known and train a distiller with RL to produce answer-useful evidence.
summary_en.technical_approach: DeferMem organizes raw history with a lightweight segment-link structure and retrieves broad high-recall candidates at query time. A memory distiller then compresses noisy candidates into faithful, self-contained evidence for the current query. DistillPO is the reinforcement learning algorithm used to train the distiller.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract focuses on long-term memory QA and claims that DeferMem extracts query-conditioned evidence from long histories, reducing denoising and reconstruction burden for the answerer. It does not specify benchmarks, model scale, data size, or quantitative gains.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the State Key Lab of CAD&CG, Zhejiang University.

recommendation.zh: 只看 query-time distillation 设计即可；这是 agent memory 工程，不会直接改变 pretrain prior。
recommendation.en: Skim the query-time distillation design only; this is agent-memory engineering, not a pretraining prior changer.
