paper.title: MemGym: a Long-Horizon Memory Environment for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Memory is a central capability for LLM agents operating across long-horizon tasks. Existing memory benchmarks predominantly evaluate retention of personalized information in multi-turn chat scenarios, overlooking the dynamic memory formation that occurs during extended agent execution. Consequently, the memory systems they produce transfer poorly to realistic agentic environments, such as coding and web navigation. We present MemGym, a benchmark for agentic memory that unifies existing agent gym

summary.core_problem: 现有“记忆”评测要么是长上下文/多轮聊天里的静态信息记忆，要么是像 SWE-Gym/WebArena 这类长程 agent 环境但只给端到端成功率，导致记忆失败与推理/工具使用失败纠缠在一起，且评测成本高。论文要解决的是：为长程 agent 的“记忆形成”（保留/压缩/淘汰）提供可分离、可迭代、成本可控的评测与训练闭环。
summary.importance: 对预训练本身影响间接，但对 post-train 与“pretrain↔posttrain 闭环”更相关：它把记忆模块从 reasoner 中剥离，提供 memory-isolated 指标与可规模化的轨迹数据，并用轻量 reward model 替代昂贵环境 rollout，降低了记忆策略/压缩策略的迭代门槛。对基座研究的启发点在于：1）把长程能力拆成可度量的子能力（压缩事件的安全/有害）比只看最终成功率更可优化；2）用小模型 RM 做内环评估，类似把“昂贵外部世界”蒸馏成可学习的判别器信号。
summary.technical_approach:
MemGym 提供统一的 memory–reasoning 接口：把“记忆模块”作为包装 prompt 的独立组件插在 agent loop 中，使每次压缩/写入/淘汰事件都可观测、可记录，并在固定 reasoner 下做 with-memory vs no-memory 的配对对比，从而把分数解释为“记忆带来的增益”。
组成：
- 五条评测轨道：对既有环境的 wrapper（τ²-bench 对话、SWE-Gym 编码、WebArena-Infinity 电脑使用）+ 两条自建的 memory-grounded 轨道（MemGym-DR 深度检索研究、MemGym-CodeQA）。自建轨道强调“可控长度”和“验证确实需要记忆”，避免信息可从参数记忆/环境中轻易再推导。
- 可控合成数据管线：对 MemGym-CodeQA 与 MemGym-DR 生成可调长度实例，并用 ablation（no-memory、distractor-only、leakage-prone 等）验证评测确实在测目标记忆通道。
- MemRM：用收集到的压缩事件轨迹训练一个轻量标量模型，预测“压缩后行为是否保持不变”的概率，用于替代昂贵的 Docker rollout，既可做快速评测也可做后训练奖励信号。实现上用 Qwen3-1.7B + QLoRA 微调。
summary.experiments:
关键结果（文中明确给出的数字）：
- MemRM 在 SWE-Gym IID split 上对压缩事件好坏的判别 AUROC 达到 0.985，可用一次亚秒级分类调用替代一次环境 rollout 作为内环信号。
- 基准覆盖：7 类记忆策略 + None 对照，在 5 个环境上形成 17 个（track, strategy）评测单元，并提供配对的 baseline-vs-memory delta 以隔离记忆效应。
（当前片段未给出各记忆家族在各轨道上的具体分数表；精读实验章节需要补齐：哪些策略在何种 regime 下有效、memory-isolated 指标如何定义与计算、以及 MemRM 与真实 rollout 的相关性/校准曲线。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议按“接口—指标—闭环”顺序：
1）先看 §3.2/§3.3 的统一接口与 memory-isolated 评分定义：它决定了这个 benchmark 是否真的把记忆从推理里拆出来。
2）再看 §3.4 的两条合成管线与 ablation 验证：重点确认是否避免了“看似测记忆、实际靠参数泄漏/可再推导”的假压力。
3）最后看 §4 的 MemRM 训练与替代 rollout 的证据：AUROC 之外，关注误报/漏报代价、跨环境泛化、以及作为 reward 用于训练时是否引入偏置。
预计阅读时间：30–45 分钟可掌握框架与主要结论；若要用它做训练研究，需要额外通读附录里环境 patch、扰动分类与数据格式。

summary_en.core_problem: Memory evaluation for LLM agents is either (a) long-context/static recall in chat, or (b) long-horizon agent benchmarks where only end-task success is reported, entangling memory failures with reasoning/tool-use errors and making iteration expensive. The paper aims to evaluate and train “memory formation” during agent execution—what to keep, compress, or evict—via a unified, memory-isolated, lower-cost loop.
summary_en.importance: Indirect for pretraining, but highly relevant to the pretrain↔post-train loop: it operationalizes memory as a separable module with paired with-memory vs no-memory comparisons under a fixed reasoner, releases trajectory data, and introduces a lightweight reward model to replace costly environment rollouts. The broader lesson is that decomposing long-horizon capability into optimizable sub-signals (compression events) can be more actionable than optimizing only final success.
summary_en.technical_approach:
MemGym unifies five tracks behind a shared memory–reasoning contract where a memory module wraps the prompt sent to the policy LLM. This makes each compression/write/eviction event observable and scorable, and enables paired runs (same reasoner, with vs without memory) so deltas reflect memory effects.
Components:
- Tracks: wrappers for τ²-bench (tool-use dialogue), SWE-Gym (coding), WebArena-Infinity (computer use), plus two in-house memory-grounded tracks (MemGym-DR deep research, MemGym-CodeQA).
- Controllable synthetic pipelines for DR and CodeQA with length tuning and verifier-style ablations (no-memory, distractor-only, leakage-prone) to ensure the benchmark truly induces memory pressure.
- MemRM: a small scalar reward model trained on collected trajectories to predict P(behavior unchanged | compress), used as a fast proxy for expensive Docker rollouts. Implemented as Qwen3-1.7B fine-tuned with QLoRA.
summary_en.experiments:
Explicit reported numbers and coverage:
- MemRM achieves AUROC 0.985 on the SWE-Gym IID split for classifying compression-event outcomes, enabling sub-second scoring instead of full rollouts.
- Evaluation spans 7 memory families plus a None control across 17 (track, strategy) cells over 5 environments, with paired baseline-vs-memory deltas.
(The excerpt does not include the full per-track score tables or detailed definitions of the memory-isolated metrics; those are essential to validate what is being measured and should be extracted from the main experiments/appendices.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim in this order:
1) The interface and memory-isolated scoring definition (§3.2–§3.3): this determines whether the benchmark truly disentangles memory from reasoning.
2) The synthetic pipeline and ablation verification (§3.4): check how they prevent “illusory memory pressure” and leakage.
3) MemRM evidence (§4): beyond AUROC, look for calibration, failure modes, cross-track generalization, and bias when used as a training reward.
Time: ~30–45 minutes for the core framework; longer if you plan to use the benchmark (appendices contain engineering details and data formats).

recommendation.zh: 做 agent memory 的人该看，但对 pretrain 研究员只需抓住它的隔离评测设计；先看任务分解和 memory-isolated score，别被总分带偏。
recommendation.en: Worth reading if you care about agent memory; for pretraining people, the key is the isolation protocol—read the task decomposition and memory-isolated scoring, not the headline leaderboard.

paper.title: Mem-$π$: Adaptive Memory through Learning When and What to Generate
paper.abstract: We present Mem-$π$, a framework for adaptive memory in large language model (LLM) agents, where useful guidance is generated on demand rather than retrieved from external memory stores. Existing memory-augmented agents typically rely on similarity-based retrieval from episodic memory banks or skill libraries, returning static entries that often misalign with the current context. In contrast, Mem-$π$ uses a dedicated language or vision-language model with its own parameters, separate from the dow

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作处理的是 agent memory 的一个老问题：现有方法大多把记忆做成检索库，推理时从过往轨迹里取相似片段，再塞回上下文。但 agent 场景里的“有用经验”往往不是一条静态片段，而是要根据当前任务、环境状态和执行阶段重新组织成一条短而准的提示。检索式 memory 容易出现三类失配：一是取回内容和当前上下文只部分相关；二是经验过于具体，迁移不到新情境；三是 memory 总是被调用，错误提示会直接干扰下游 agent 行为。Mem-π 的核心问题因此不是单纯“如何生成记忆”，而是同时学习两个决策：什么时候该给 memory，什么时候该 abstain；以及一旦要给，应该生成什么样的 guidance 才能提高最终任务成功率。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身，它不是直接改 pretrain recipe 的论文，但对“参数化记忆”和“把经验压进模型而不是外部库”这个方向有明确启发。它把 memory 从 retrieval module 改成独立的生成策略模型，等于把一部分长期经验做成可训练的条件生成器。这和预训练里常见的外部检索增强形成了一个对照：不是扩大上下文，而是把可复用经验蒸馏进参数，再按需生成。更重要的是，它强调 abstention 和 counterfactual credit assignment，这一点对任何会向主模型注入辅助信号的系统都很关键，包括 tool hints、reasoning hints、critic feedback，甚至 post-train 阶段的 verifier/reflector。贡献量级上，它更像一个方法范式和训练目标设计，而不是通用基础模型层面的范式替换。
summary.technical_approach:
方法上分两层。第一层是建模选择：把 memory 定义成独立参数化策略 π_mem，而不是 memory bank。输入是当前 context，包括任务指令 q 和环境观察 o；输出不是最终动作，而是一段插入到下游 agent 上下文中的 guidance m，或者选择不生成。这样做的直接好处是 memory 模块和执行 agent 解耦：可以用较小的本地模型专门学经验压缩，再服务更强的主 agent。

训练分两阶段。第一阶段是 experience distillation。作者先构造离线经验库 E={(x,m)}，其中 x 是上下文，m 是从成功轨迹或经验总结中得到的 guidance。用监督学习让 π_mem 学会在给定上下文下复现这些可复用提示，相当于把经验库压缩进参数。第二阶段是 adaptation distillation，用 RL 直接根据下游任务结果优化 memory policy。关键点不在“用了 RL”，而在它怎么处理 decision 和 content 的耦合。

作者提出 decision-content decoupled objective，基于 GRPO 做结构化对比 rollout。对于同一个上下文，会构造至少两类分支：生成 guidance 与 abstain；在生成分支内部，还会比较不同 guidance 内容带来的结果差异。这样 advantage 被拆成两部分：decision-level advantage 负责学习“该不该生成”，content-level advantage 负责学习“生成什么”。如果只把整个 memory 输出当成一个普通序列做 policy gradient，模型很难知道失败是因为不该生成，还是因为生成内容不对。这个拆分是全文最有信息量的设计。

从系统角度看，Mem-π 不是让 memory 永久在线，而是把它做成一个可拒答的 intervention policy。作者强调在弱 grounding、模糊上下文、OOD 情况下，错误 guidance 会污染 agent，因此 abstention 不是附属功能，而是可靠性机制。和一些 always-on generated memory 方法相比，这里更接近 selective auxiliary generation。
summary.experiments:
实验覆盖四类 agent benchmark：WebArena、WorkArena、LifelongAgentBench、ALFWorld，分别对应网页操作、企业工作流、终端工具使用和文本环境 embodied task。论文给出的主结论是，adaptive memory generation 在四个 benchmark 上都优于 retrieval-based memory baselines，平均相对 base agent 提升约 20%，其中 WebArena 上相对提升接近 50%。从任务性质看，这个结果说明生成式 memory 对长程、多阶段、上下文依赖强的 agent 任务更有帮助，因为这类任务里“经验重组”比“相似片段复用”更重要。

消融的重点应当有三类。第一，是否需要两阶段训练。只做监督蒸馏通常能学到可读 guidance，但未必和最终任务成功率对齐；加入 RL 后，memory 会更偏向产生真正有用而不是表面合理的提示。第二，是否需要 decision-content decoupling。若去掉 decoupling，模型往往过度生成，或者无法稳定学会 abstain。第三，和 retrieval memory、always-on generated memory、以及不带 memory 的 base agent 比较，可以看出收益主要来自“按需生成”而不是单纯“多一个辅助模型”。

从摘要和正文可见，作者更强调相对增益而不是超大规模绝对分数。没有看到它在参数量或数据量上追求极限，重点是 memory policy 的训练信号设计。若精读全文，建议特别留意不同 benchmark 上的触发率、abstention 率、生成长度、以及错误 guidance 对成功率的负贡献，这些细节比单一平均分更能说明方法是否可靠。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议是先看 Introduction 和方法图，确认它解决的不是传统 RAG memory，而是“生成式、可拒答的 memory policy”。然后重点看 decision-content decoupled objective 的定义和 rollout 构造方式，这是和已有 generated memory 工作拉开差异的地方。实验部分优先看三张内容：主表里的四个 benchmark 结果；abstention/always-on 的对比；以及 RL 与 SFT 两阶段训练的消融。若时间有限，30 到 40 分钟足够抓住主线。若要继续深挖，值得问两个问题：一，经验库中的 guidance 是如何构造和清洗的，是否存在 teacher leakage；二，memory policy 学到的是可泛化经验，还是 benchmark-specific prompt pattern。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper tackles a recurring weakness in agent memory systems: most existing methods treat memory as retrieval from an external bank, but useful experience in agent settings is often not a static past fragment. It needs to be reconstructed into a short, context-specific hint conditioned on the current task, observation, and execution stage. Retrieval-based memory therefore fails in three ways: the retrieved item is only partially relevant, it is too specific to transfer, or it is injected even when no memory should be used. Mem-π frames the problem as a joint policy over two decisions: when to provide memory and when to abstain, and what guidance to generate if memory should be provided at all.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining recipe paper in the narrow sense, but it is relevant to foundation-model research because it turns reusable experience into a parametric generator rather than an ever-growing external store. That is a meaningful contrast to retrieval-heavy augmentation: instead of expanding context with stored trajectories, it compresses experience into model parameters and regenerates task-adaptive hints on demand. The abstention mechanism and the counterfactual credit assignment are also broadly useful ideas for any auxiliary signal injected into a stronger model, including tool hints, reasoning hints, critic feedback, or verifier outputs. The contribution is best read as a training-objective and systems-design idea, not as a new base-model paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The method has two key layers. First is the modeling choice: memory is a separate parametric policy π_mem rather than a memory bank. The input is the current context x=(q,o), where q is the task specification and o is the environment observation. The output is either a short textual guidance m inserted into the downstream agent context, or an abstention decision. This decouples specialization from execution: a smaller model can specialize as memory, while a larger frontier agent remains the executor.

Training is done in two stages. Stage one is experience distillation. The authors build an offline experience bank E={(x,m)} and train π_mem with supervised learning to reproduce reusable guidance from context. This compresses the experience bank into the memory model parameters. Stage two is adaptation distillation, where reinforcement learning optimizes the memory policy directly against downstream task outcomes.

The main technical point is the decision-content decoupled objective built on GRPO. For the same context, the training procedure constructs structured counterfactual rollouts that compare at least two branches: generate guidance versus abstain. Within the generate branch, different candidate guidance contents are also compared. This lets the learning signal be decomposed into a decision-level advantage for whether memory should be generated, and a content-level advantage for what the guidance should say. Without this decomposition, a standard sequence-level policy gradient would conflate two failure modes: generating when it should not, and generating the wrong content when it should. That decomposition is the most important idea in the paper.

From a systems perspective, Mem-π is not an always-on helper. It is a selective intervention policy with abstention as a reliability mechanism. The paper explicitly argues that under weak grounding, ambiguity, or OOD contexts, bad generated memory can harm the downstream agent. That makes abstention central rather than optional.
summary_en.experiments:
The evaluation spans four agent benchmarks: WebArena, WorkArena, LifelongAgentBench, and ALFWorld, covering web navigation, enterprise workflow tasks, terminal tool use, and text-based embodied environments. The headline result is that adaptive memory generation consistently beats retrieval-based memory baselines on all four benchmarks, with roughly 20% average relative improvement over the base agent and nearly 50% relative gain on WebArena. The pattern suggests that generated memory is especially useful when tasks are long-horizon, multi-stage, and strongly context-dependent, where experience recomposition matters more than nearest-neighbor reuse.

The most informative ablations are likely threefold. First, the two-stage training pipeline: supervised distillation alone can produce plausible guidance, but RL is needed to align memory generation with actual task success. Second, the decision-content decoupling: removing it should lead to over-generation or unstable abstention behavior. Third, comparisons against retrieval memory, always-on generated memory, and the no-memory base agent clarify that the gain comes from selective generation rather than merely adding another model.

The paper emphasizes relative gains more than scale. It is not trying to win by sheer parameter count or data volume. The interesting evidence is in trigger rates, abstention rates, guidance length, and the measured harm from bad guidance. Those details matter more than a single average score if one wants to judge whether the method is reliable.
summary_en.reading_guide: Start with the introduction and the method overview to see that this is not standard RAG-style memory, but a generative memory policy with abstention. Then read the section defining the decision-content decoupled objective and the structured rollout construction; that is where the paper separates itself from prior generated-memory work. In the experiments, prioritize the main benchmark table, the comparison between abstention and always-on generation, and the ablation on the two-stage SFT+RL pipeline. A 30–40 minute skim is enough to capture the main idea. For deeper reading, focus on two questions: how the offline guidance bank is constructed and filtered, and whether the learned memory policy captures transferable experience or mostly benchmark-specific prompting patterns.

recommendation.zh: 只看 RL abstention 设计即可；把记忆改成生成器是干净想法，但离预训练还隔着 Agent 外环。
recommendation.en: Read the RL abstention design only; generative memory is a clean idea, but it remains an agent-layer mechanism, not a pretraining signal.

paper.title: Auto-Dreamer: Learning Offline Memory Consolidation for Language Agents
paper.abstract: Language agents increasingly operate over streams of related tasks, yet existing memory systems struggle to convert accumulated experience into reusable knowledge. Retrieval-augmented and structured memory methods record per-session observations effectively, but often couple acquisition and consolidation into a single online process, leaving the agent without a global view across sessions to discover recurring patterns, abstract shared procedures, or prune redundant entries. Inspired by compleme

summary.core_problem: 解决语言智能体在连续任务流中积累大量会话记忆后，难以把零散经验压缩成可复用知识的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent memory 方法工作，贡献在于把在线记忆写入和离线跨会话整合分开。它对预训练研究的直接价值有限，但对长程交互、经验压缩和记忆系统如何形成抽象规则有参考意义。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Auto-Dreamer，一个 learned offline consolidator。系统先保留快速的 per-session memory acquisition，再在离线阶段选取 typed memory bank 的局部工作区域，把其中条目和带 provenance 的源轨迹作为只读证据，通过受限 tool-use 检查、归纳、去重，并合成更紧凑的替代记忆集合。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体任务、模型规模、baseline、提升幅度或消融结果。需要看正文确认 consolidation 是否真正优于简单摘要、聚类去重、LLM 反思式 memory rewrite 等强基线。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign 和 University of California San Diego。Julian McAuley 是推荐系统和数据驱动 NLP 方向的知名研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how language agents can turn streams of session-level memories into compact, reusable knowledge across related tasks.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-memory method rather than a pretraining paper. Its main contribution is to decouple fast online memory acquisition from slower offline consolidation. For pretraining researchers, the indirect relevance is experience compression and abstraction over long interaction histories.
summary_en.technical_approach: Auto-Dreamer is a learned offline consolidator. It operates over a selected region of a typed memory bank, treats the existing entries and provenance-linked source trajectories as read-only evidence, uses bounded tool calls to inspect them, and synthesizes a compact replacement set that abstracts recurring patterns and removes redundancy.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify the task suite, model sizes, baselines, effect sizes, or ablation details. The key thing to verify in the paper is whether the method beats strong simple baselines such as summarization, clustering-based deduplication, and LLM reflection-style memory rewriting.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions are University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign and University of California San Diego. Julian McAuley is a well-known researcher in recommender systems and data-driven NLP.

recommendation.zh: 看方法图和 consolidation 消融即可；若没有强简单基线，这更像 agent memory 工程整理，不改预训练判断。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and consolidation ablations; without strong simple baselines, this is mostly agent-memory engineering rather than a pretraining signal.

paper.title: Library Drift: Diagnosing and Fixing a Silent Failure Mode in Self-Evolving LLM Skill Libraries
paper.abstract: Self-evolving skill libraries face a silent failure mode we term \emph{library drift}: unbounded skill accumulation without outcome-driven lifecycle management causes retrieval degradation, false-positive injections, and performance stagnation. Recent evaluation confirms the symptom--LLM-authored skills deliver +0.0pp gain while human-curated ones deliver +16.2pp (SkillsBench)--yet the underlying mechanism has not been isolated. We provide (1) a reproducible trigger: ablations that isolate drift

summary.core_problem: 诊断自演化 LLM skill library 中技能无限累积导致检索退化、误注入和性能停滞的 failure mode。
summary.importance: 贡献是 Agent/代码智能体系统的机制诊断与治理 recipe。它不直接影响基座训练，但对长期运行的工具库、技能库、agent memory 有工程参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 library drift 概念，并用三类手段处理：构造可复现触发实验隔离 drift；建立 append-only evidence log，记录每个 skill 的贡献分数、归因 verdict 和 router engagement；给出最小治理策略，包括 outcome-driven retirement、bounded active-cap 和 meta-skill authoring prior。
summary.experiments: 摘要报告 SkillsBench 上 LLM-authored skills 带来 +0.0pp，而 human-curated skills 带来 +16.2pp；隔离实验中禁用 skill injection 几乎不变（+0.002），过早 retirement 造成伤害（-0.019）；治理策略将 held-out pass@1 从 0.258 baseline 提升，但摘要截断未给出最终数值。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper diagnoses library drift in self-evolving LLM skill libraries, where unbounded skill accumulation degrades retrieval, causes false-positive injections, and stalls performance.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a mechanism diagnosis and governance recipe for agent or coding-agent systems. It does not directly affect foundation-model training, but it is relevant to long-running skill libraries, tool memories, and agent retrieval systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors define library drift and address it with reproducible triggers, trace-level diagnostics, and a minimal governance recipe. The diagnostics use an append-only evidence log with per-skill contribution scores, attribution verdicts, and router engagement metrics; the fix combines outcome-driven retirement, a bounded active cap, and a meta-skill authoring prior.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports that LLM-authored skills give +0.0pp on SkillsBench while human-curated skills give +16.2pp. Ablations show disabling skill injection is nearly flat (+0.002) and premature retirement is harmful (-0.019). The governance recipe improves held-out pass@1 from a 0.258 baseline, but the final number is not visible in the provided abstract.

recommendation.zh: 作为 agent memory 的负例材料即可；核心图表比方法更有用，别把它当通用训练结论。
recommendation.en: Use it as a negative case study for agent memory; the diagnostics matter more than the recipe, and it should not be read as a general training result.

paper.title: PEEK: Context Map as an Orientation Cache for Long-Context LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate over long and recurring external contexts, like document corpora and code repositories. Across invocations, existing approaches preserve either the agent's trajectory, passive access to raw material, or task-level strategies. None of them preserves what we argue is most needed for repeated same-context workloads: reusable orientation knowledge (e.g., what the context contains, how it is organized, and which entities, constants, and schemas h

summary.core_problem: PEEK 解决的是长上下文 Agent 在反复访问同一外部语料、代码库或文档集合时缺少“上下文方位感”的问题。现有方法保留聊天轨迹、压缩历史、检索原文或积累任务策略，但很少维护一个关于外部上下文本身的、可复用的小型结构化记忆。
summary.importance: 这篇论文不是预训练方法，但对长上下文和 Agent 训练有方法论意义。它把长期记忆从“保存更多历史”转向“保存可迁移的上下文地图”：语料里有什么、结构如何、哪些 schema、常量、实体和证据位置反复有用。对基座研究的启发在于，长上下文能力不只取决于窗口长度，也取决于模型能否形成稳定的外部环境索引。未来如果要训练长期工作流模型，这类 orientation knowledge 可以成为数据构造、过程监督和评测目标。
summary.technical_approach: PEEK 在 system prompt 中维护一个固定 token 预算的 context map。这个 map 不是 KV-cache，也不是聊天摘要，而是面向外部上下文的语义索引。系统包含三个模块：Distiller 从 Agent 执行轨迹中抽取可复用的上下文知识；Cartographer 把抽取结果转成结构化编辑，更新 map；Evictor 在固定预算下按优先级淘汰低价值内容。论文强调抽取与编辑要分离，否则容易把一次性任务事实、对话噪声和重复内容写入 map。相比 RAG，PEEK 不只是被动取回片段；相比 prompt learning，它维护的不是通用任务策略，而是某个固定外部上下文的方位知识。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖两类长上下文任务：reasoning and aggregation，以及 context learning。PEEK 在 OOLONG 上相对各类 baseline 提升 6.3–34.0%；在 CL-bench 上 solving rate 提升 6.0–14.0%，rubric accuracy 提升 7.8–12.1%。相对强 prompt-learning baseline，PEEK 在 OOLONG 上提升 10.7%，在 CL-bench 上 solving rate / rubric accuracy 分别提升 6.0% / 9.9%。效率上，PEEK 在 OOLONG 比该 prompt-learning baseline 少 93–145 次迭代；成本上，OOLONG 低 1.7–5.8 倍，CL-bench 低约 1.4 倍。泛化实验显示，收益可迁移到 GPT-5.5、Qwen3-Coder-Next-FP8，以及不同 Agent backbone OpenAI Codex。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 30–40 分钟。先看 Figure 2，理解它如何区分 Agent/Task State 与 External Context State，以及 active/passive context management。再看方法部分的 Distiller、Cartographer、Evictor，重点关注 context map 的写入规则和 eviction 规则。Section 4.5 的消融值得看，因为它说明为什么不能直接把执行轨迹摘要写进 map。实验部分优先看 OOLONG 和 CL-bench 的质量、迭代次数、成本三组指标，而不只看最终 accuracy。

summary_en.core_problem: PEEK addresses a recurring-context problem in long-context LLM agents. When an agent repeatedly works over the same document collection, repository, or corpus, existing systems preserve chat history, retrieve raw material, compact transcripts, or learn task-level prompts. They usually do not maintain reusable orientation knowledge about the external context itself.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it is relevant to long-context model research and agent training. The key idea is to preserve a compact context map rather than more conversation history. The map records what the external context contains, how it is organized, and which entities, schemas, constants, or evidence locations have been useful. For foundation-model work, the implication is clear: long-context performance is not only about context length or retrieval quality. Models and agents also need stable, reusable indexes over their working environment. This can inform future data construction, process supervision, and evaluations for persistent workflows.
summary_en.technical_approach: PEEK maintains a fixed-budget context map inside the system prompt. The map is not a KV-cache and not a transcript summary. It is a curated semantic index over a recurring external context. The system has three modules. The Distiller extracts transferable contextual knowledge from execution trajectories. The Cartographer converts extracted knowledge into structured map edits. The Evictor enforces the token budget through priority-based eviction. The separation between extraction and editing is important, because direct updates from trajectories tend to leak task-specific facts, duplicate entries, and noisy observations into the map. Compared with RAG, PEEK actively maintains orientation knowledge rather than only retrieving passages. Compared with prompt learning, it stores context-specific knowledge rather than task procedures.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates PEEK on reasoning-and-aggregation tasks and context-learning tasks. On OOLONG, PEEK improves over baselines by 6.3–34.0%. On CL-bench, it improves solving rate by 6.0–14.0% and rubric accuracy by 7.8–12.1%. Against a strong prompt-learning baseline, PEEK gains 10.7% on OOLONG and 6.0% / 9.9% on CL-bench solving rate / rubric accuracy. It is also more efficient: on OOLONG it uses 93–145 fewer iterations than that prompt-learning baseline, and costs 1.7–5.8x less; on CL-bench it costs about 1.4x less. The gains transfer across models, including GPT-5.5 and Qwen3-Coder-Next-FP8, and across agent backbones such as OpenAI Codex.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 30–40 minute skim is appropriate. Start with Figure 2 to understand the distinction between Agent/Task State and External Context State, and between active and passive context management. Then read the method description of the Distiller, Cartographer, and Evictor, with special attention to how map updates and evictions are controlled. Section 4.5 is useful because it explains why simply summarizing trajectories into the map is not enough. In the experiments, focus on the three-way tradeoff among quality, number of iterations, and cost, rather than only the final task score.

recommendation.zh: 只看系统设计和 ablation：orientation cache 是比轨迹记忆更干净的变量，可借鉴到长上下文数据构造。
recommendation.en: Skim the design and ablations: orientation caching is a cleaner variable than trajectory memory and may inform long-context data construction.

paper.title: Mem-π: Adaptive Memory through Learning When and What to Generate
paper.abstract: We present Mem-π, a framework for adaptive memory in large language model (LLM) agents, where useful guidance is generated on demand rather than retrieved from external memory stores. Existing memory-augmented agents typically rely on similarity-based retrieval from episodic memory banks or skill libraries, returning static entries that often misalign with the current context. In contrast, Mem-π uses a dedicated language or vision-language model with its own parameters, separate from the downstr

summary.core_problem: 解决长程 LLM agent 中“记忆该何时用、用什么形式用”的问题：相比从外部记忆库检索静态片段，如何按当前上下文按需生成更贴合任务的指导信息。
summary.importance: 这是一个 agent memory 设计问题，不是基座预训练本身，但它触及一个对 pretrain 有外溢价值的点：把“记忆”从检索对象改成可学习的条件生成器，并显式学习 abstain。贡献类型主要是方法设计加 RL 训练目标，而不是新的基座训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 Mem-π：在下游 agent 之外单独放一个语言模型或视觉语言模型作为 memory generator。该模型基于当前 agent 上下文，联合决定何时生成指导、以及生成什么指导。训练上采用 decision-content decoupled 的 RL 目标，把“是否该说”和“说什么”拆开优化，使模型可以在无益时选择不生成，在有益时输出简洁指导。核心新意是把 memory 从 retrieval item 变成 context-conditional generated guidance，并把 abstention 作为一等决策变量。
summary.experiments: 论文在 web navigation、terminal tool use、text-based embodied interaction 等多类 agent benchmark 上评测，结论是相较于基于 episodic memory bank 或 skill library 的检索式 memory，Mem-π 在复杂任务上更稳，且能减少与当前上下文不匹配的静态记忆调用。摘要未给出模型规模、训练 token 或具体提升幅度，因此更适合作为方法信号而非定量结论来源。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 ServiceNow AI Research、Mila、Université de Montréal、McGill 等。Christopher Pal 是 Mila/ServiceNow 体系内较知名研究者，长期参与大模型与多模态方向。

summary_en.core_problem: It tackles a memory-design problem for long-horizon LLM agents: instead of retrieving static entries from external memory stores, how can an agent generate context-specific guidance only when it is actually useful?
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining paper, but it touches a question that matters to foundation-model researchers: whether memory should be modeled as retrieval over stored traces or as a learned conditional generator with abstention. The contribution is mainly a method plus an RL objective, not a new base-model training paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: Mem-π introduces a separate language or vision-language model, distinct from the downstream agent, to act as an adaptive memory module. Conditioned on the current agent context, it jointly decides when to emit guidance and what guidance to emit. Training uses a decision-content decoupled RL objective so the model can abstain when guidance would not help and otherwise produce concise, task-relevant hints. The key move is to replace retrieved memory snippets with generated, context-conditioned guidance.
summary_en.experiments: The paper evaluates on agentic benchmarks spanning web navigation, terminal-based tool use, and text-based embodied interaction. The reported takeaway is that Mem-π outperforms retrieval-based episodic memory or skill-library baselines by reducing context mismatch and improving task performance on complex settings. The abstract does not provide model sizes, training scale, or exact gains, so this is more useful as a design signal than as a clean quantitative reference.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are from ServiceNow AI Research, Mila, Université de Montréal, and McGill. Christopher Pal is a well-known researcher associated with the Mila/ServiceNow ecosystem and has a strong track record in large-model and multimodal research.

recommendation.zh: 对 pretrain 本身帮助有限，但“生成式记忆+可 abstain”这个接口设计值得记一下；读方法图和 RL objective 就够，不必深挖 benchmark。
recommendation.en: Limited direct value for pretraining, but the generated-memory-with-abstention interface is worth noting; read the method figure and RL objective, not the benchmark details.

paper.title: PEEK: Context Map as an Orientation Cache for Long-Context LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly operate over long and recurring external contexts, like document corpora and code repositories. Across invocations, existing approaches preserve either the agent's trajectory, passive access to raw material, or task-level strategies. None of them preserves what we argue is most needed for repeated same-context workloads: reusable orientation knowledge (e.g., what the context contains, how it is organized, and which entities, constants, and schemas h

summary.core_problem: 长上下文 agent 在反复访问同一外部语料或代码库时，如何保留对上下文结构与有用实体的“定向知识”，而不只是保存历史轨迹或原始文档。
summary.importance: 这是长上下文 agent 的缓存设计问题。贡献点在于提出 orientation cache / context map 这一中间表示，介于原始上下文和任务轨迹之间。对预训练本身不直接，但对长期记忆、外部上下文压缩和 recurrent workload 有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 PEEK，把可复用的 orientation knowledge 压成一个小而常数大小的 context map，放入后续 prompt。系统包含 Distiller、Cartographer、Prioritizer 三个模块：从推理时信号中抽取可迁移知识，转成结构化编辑，再按缓存策略维护。目标是让 agent 在重复面对同一上下文时更快定位内容、组织结构、关键实体、常用 schema 等。
summary.experiments: 摘要未给出具体 benchmark 数字，但任务场景包括长文档语料和代码仓库上的 repeated same-context workloads。比较对象应包括保留轨迹、直接访问原始上下文、任务级策略缓存等方案。论文核心评估点大概率是提示长度固定下的任务成功率、检索效率或多轮调用性能。
summary.authors_note: 作者包括 Omar Khattab 与 Samuel Madden，分别与检索增强、系统和数据库方向有代表性工作；这类组合通常偏系统化 agent 设计。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks how long-context agents can preserve reusable orientation knowledge about a recurring external context, rather than only storing trajectories or raw documents.
summary_en.importance: This is a cache-design paper for long-context agents. Its main contribution is the notion of an orientation cache or context map, an intermediate representation between raw context and task trajectories. It is not directly about pretraining, but it is relevant to memory, context compression, and repeated-workload settings.
summary_en.technical_approach: PEEK stores reusable orientation knowledge as a small constant-sized context map inserted into future prompts. The system has three modules: a Distiller that extracts transferable knowledge from inference-time signals, a Cartographer that turns it into structured edits, and a Prioritizer that maintains the cache under a policy. The goal is to help the agent quickly recover what the context contains, how it is organized, and which entities or schemas matter.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide concrete numbers, but the target workloads involve recurring long-context settings such as document corpora and code repositories. Likely baselines include trajectory memory, passive access to raw context, and task-level strategy retention. The main metrics are likely task success under fixed prompt budget, retrieval efficiency, or repeated-invocation performance.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors include Omar Khattab and Samuel Madden, known for work in retrieval-augmented systems and data systems, which fits a systems-oriented agent design paper.

recommendation.zh: 不是 pretrain 论文，但“缓存上下文结构而不是缓存 token”这个抽象挺干净；看系统图和 cache policy 即可，别指望它回答长上下文建模本身。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the abstraction is clean: cache context structure rather than tokens; read the system design and cache policy, not for answers about long-context modeling itself.

paper.title: RecMem: Recurrence-based Memory Consolidation for Efficient and Effective Long-Running LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Memory systems often organize user-agent interactions as retrievable external memory and are crucial for long-running agents by overcoming the limited context windows of LLMs. However, existing memory systems invoke LLMs to process every incoming interaction for memory extraction, and such an eager memory consolidation scheme leads to substantial token consumption. To tackle this problem, we propose RecMem by rethinking when memory consolidation should be conducted. RecMem stores incoming intera

summary.core_problem: 长时运行的 LLM agent 需要外部记忆来突破上下文窗口，但现有记忆系统普遍对每次交互都做“急切式”LLM 记忆抽取与合并，导致构建阶段 token 成本过高。论文要解决的是：在不显著损失可用性的前提下，如何决定“什么时候值得调用 LLM 做记忆巩固”。
summary.importance:
更偏 agent 系统与成本工程，不是预训练方法论文。对基座研究的启发主要在两点：
1) 把“记忆写入”视为稀缺资源，采用事件触发（recurrence）而非逐步写入，类似把训练信号做门控；这类门控思想在持续学习/在线学习里也常见。
2) 反映了一个现实约束：很多 agent 方案的 token 成本主要消耗在“写记忆”而非“用记忆”，这会影响后续用交互轨迹做 continual pretrain / RL 数据闭环时的采样与记录策略。
summary.technical_approach:
RecMem 提出三层记忆架构与“基于复现的巩固”策略：
- Subconscious memory：对每条原始交互只做轻量 embedding 编码与存储，用于低成本检索与聚类，不调用 LLM。
- Consolidation trigger：当新交互在 subconscious 层检索到足够多语义相近/相关的历史交互（形成语义簇、出现持续复现）时，才调用 LLM 对该簇做记忆巩固，抽取 episodic memory（事件级摘要）与 semantic memory（更稳定的事实）。
- Semantic refinement：针对 episodic 摘要可能遗漏细粒度但对问答关键的信息，回看与该 episodic 关联的原始交互，补抽“持久且缺失”的事实并蒸馏为 semantic memory，降低信息损失。
整体上用“先廉价缓存 + 复现触发写入 + 写入后再精炼”替代“每步都写入”。
summary.experiments:
评测在两个长程记忆 benchmark：LoCoMo 与 LongMemEval-S；对比 Mem0、A-Mem、MemoryOS 等记忆系统。结论是：RecMem 在两套数据上问答准确率高于对比方法，同时显著降低记忆构建 token 成本。
- 在 LoCoMo 上，构建阶段 token 消耗最高可比基线降低 7.8×（论文图 1(d)）。
- 查询阶段 token 成本与现有系统相近，因此长交互历史下端到端成本更低。
（当前给出的全文片段未包含更细的分项数值与消融表；若论文后文提供触发阈值、簇大小、refinement 开关等消融，建议结合阅读以判断收益来自“少调用 LLM”还是“refinement 提升质量”。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读即可，预计 20-30 分钟：
- 先看 Figure 1（尤其 token cost 对比）把握动机与收益量级。
- 重点看 consolidation trigger 的判定规则（相似度度量、阈值、簇维护方式）以及 semantic refinement 的具体抽取提示与合并策略，这两处决定了系统是否稳健。
- 如果关心可迁移性：留意在不同 benchmark/不同交互分布下触发频率如何变化，以及是否会对“长尾但重要的一次性信息”造成漏记。

summary_en.core_problem: Long-running LLM agents rely on external memory to overcome limited context windows, but most existing systems perform eager LLM-based consolidation on every interaction, incurring large token costs. The paper asks when consolidation should happen, aiming to cut construction-time cost without sacrificing downstream QA usefulness.
summary_en.importance: Primarily an agent-memory systems paper rather than pretraining research. The transferable insight for foundation-model work is the gating principle: treat memory writing (and, by analogy, expensive supervision/processing) as a scarce resource and trigger it only under recurrence. It also highlights a practical bottleneck for continual-data loops: in many deployments, token spend is dominated by memory construction, which affects what interaction traces are feasible to log, distill, or reuse for continual pretraining/RL.
summary_en.technical_approach:
RecMem introduces recurrence-based consolidation with a three-tier design:
- A “subconscious” layer stores raw interactions encoded by lightweight embedding models for cheap retrieval, avoiding LLM calls.
- Consolidation is triggered only when an incoming interaction finds enough semantically similar/related past interactions (forming a meaningful cluster). Then an LLM extracts episodic memories (event-level summaries) and semantic memories (more stable facts) from the cluster.
- A semantic refinement step revisits the raw interactions linked to each episodic memory to recover fine-grained but query-critical details that episodic summarization may omit, distilling them into semantic memory to reduce lossy compression.
Overall, it replaces per-turn eager extraction with “cheap buffering + recurrence-triggered write + post-write refinement.”
summary_en.experiments:
Evaluated on LoCoMo and LongMemEval-S, compared against Mem0, A-Mem, and MemoryOS. RecMem reports higher QA accuracy on both benchmarks while substantially reducing memory construction token cost.
- On LoCoMo, construction-time token consumption is reduced by up to 7.8× (as referenced around Fig. 1(d)).
- Query-time token cost remains comparable to baselines, so savings translate to lower end-to-end cost over long histories.
(The provided full-text excerpt does not include detailed ablations; if the paper contains them, the key is to separate gains from reduced consolidation frequency vs. refinement quality improvements.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim-level read, ~20–30 minutes.
- Start with the cost breakdown figure(s) to understand where savings come from.
- Focus on the consolidation trigger mechanics (similarity metric, thresholds, cluster maintenance) and the semantic refinement procedure (what is extracted, how it is merged).
- Check robustness discussions: how often consolidation triggers under different interaction distributions, and whether one-off but important facts risk being missed.

recommendation.zh: 这不是 pretrain 论文，但它把“记忆提炼触发条件”从每步调用改成 recurrence 触发，系统味道很对；只看方法和成本曲线，别把任务收益当成普适结论。
recommendation.en: Not a pretraining paper, but the shift from eager memory extraction to recurrence-triggered consolidation is a clean systems idea; read the method and cost curves, not the task gains as universal truth.
