paper.title: ScrapMem: A Bio-inspired Framework for On-device Personalized Agent Memory via Optical Forgetting
paper.abstract: Long-term personalized memory for LLM agents is challenging on resource-limited edge devices due to high storage costs and multimodal complexity. To address this, we propose ScrapMem, a framework that integrates multimodal data into "Scrapbook Page." ScrapMem introduces Optical Forgetting, an optical compression mechanism that progressively reduces the resolution of older memories, lowering storage cost while suppressing low-value details. To maintain semantic consistency, we construct an Episod

summary.core_problem: 解决边缘设备上的 LLM 个性化 Agent 长期记忆存储成本高、 multimodal memory 难以持续保留的问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型偏系统方法：把个人记忆压缩、结构化检索和多模态记忆管理放到 on-device Agent 场景下。对基座预训练没有直接方法增益，但对长期记忆系统的存储-召回权衡有参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ScrapMem，将多模态经历组织为 Scrapbook Page；用 Optical Forgetting 对较旧记忆逐步降低分辨率，以减少存储并抑制低价值细节；再用 Episodic Memory Graph 将关键事件组织成因果-时间结构，辅助语义一致性和检索。
summary.experiments: 在 multimodal ATM-Bench 上评估。摘要报告 Joint@10 达到 51.0%，Recall@10 达到 70.3%，并通过 optical forgetting 最多降低 93% 的记忆存储。未给出底层 LLM 参数量、训练数据规模或更细的消融信息。
summary.authors_note: 机构为 Nanjing Agricultural University 和 Nanjing University；未从给定信息中确认知名 LLM 基座研究作者。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets long-term personalized memory for LLM agents on resource-constrained edge devices, where multimodal memories are expensive to store and retrieve.
summary_en.importance: This is mainly a system-level contribution for agent memory: it studies the storage-recall trade-off in on-device personalized agents. It is not directly about foundation model pretraining, but the compression and memory-structuring choices are useful to know.
summary_en.technical_approach: ScrapMem represents multimodal experiences as Scrapbook Pages, applies Optical Forgetting by progressively lowering the resolution of older memories, and builds an Episodic Memory Graph to organize key events with causal-temporal structure for more stable retrieval.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation is conducted on multimodal ATM-Bench. The abstract reports 51.0% Joint@10, 70.3% Recall@10, and up to 93% memory reduction. Model size, training data, and detailed ablations are not specified in the provided abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: The listed institutions are Nanjing Agricultural University and Nanjing University. No widely known foundation-model researcher is identifiable from the provided metadata.

recommendation.zh: 只看方法图和存储消融即可；它是 Agent 记忆工程，不会改变预训练或长上下文建模判断。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and storage ablation only; this is agent-memory engineering, not a signal for pretraining or long-context modeling.

paper.title: Feedback-Normalized Developer Memory for Reinforcement-Learning Coding Agents: A Safety-Gated MCP Architecture
paper.abstract: Large language model (LLM) coding agents increasingly operate over repositories, terminals, tests, and execution traces across long software-engineering episodes. Persistent memory is useful, but static vector stores or generic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) are insufficient for reinforcement-learning (RL) code development, where small details can alter Bellman targets, terminal masks, gradient flow, or validation claims. This paper presents RL Developer Memory, a local-first, Model Contex

summary.core_problem: 为长期运行的 RL coding agent 设计一种可记录反馈、可安全门控的开发者记忆系统，避免普通向量库/RAG 在代码 RL 场景中误用细节。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 coding agent 系统架构。它关注 repository、terminal、test、execution trace 等长 episode 记忆管理，但更像工程设计提案，和基座预训练关系较弱。
summary.technical_approach: RL Developer Memory 是 local-first、MCP-native 的记忆架构，把记忆选择建模为带日志的 contextual decision process；issue_match 负责候选排序并记录 telemetry，issue_feedback 把原始反馈映射到有界 reward，issue_record_resolution 将已验证解决方案回连到历史检索事件。部署侧保留确定性 ranker，contextual-bandit residual policy 只在 shadow/canary 模式下保守介入。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出 SWE-bench 类评测、真实仓库规模、agent baseline、成功率提升或安全事故率变化；目前只能判断为架构设计和安全流程说明。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自 PythaLab 和 Yildiz Technical University。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper proposes a feedback-aware, safety-gated developer memory system for long-running RL coding agents operating over repositories, terminals, tests, and execution traces.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is a coding-agent systems architecture. It is relevant to long-episode memory management, but it is closer to an engineering proposal than to foundation-model training research.
summary_en.technical_approach: RL Developer Memory is a local-first, MCP-native architecture that treats memory selection as a logged contextual decision process. issue_match ranks candidates and logs telemetry, issue_feedback maps labels to bounded rewards, and issue_record_resolution links verified fixes back to retrieval events. A deterministic ranker remains deployed while a contextual-bandit residual policy runs in shadow or conservative canary mode.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report SWE-bench-style evaluation, repository scale, agent baselines, success-rate gains, or safety metrics. The available description mainly supports an architectural reading.
summary_en.authors_note: The author is affiliated with PythaLab and Yildiz Technical University.

recommendation.zh: MCP memory 设计有工程味，但缺少硬评测；扫一下安全门控和 feedback schema，当 coding-agent 系统备查。
recommendation.en: The MCP memory design is engineering-relevant but under-evaluated; skim the safety gate and feedback schema as coding-agent systems background.

institutions: PythaLab, Yildiz Technical University, Istanbul, Türkiye

paper.title: Trojan Hippo: Weaponizing Agent Memory for Data Exfiltration
paper.abstract: Memory systems enable otherwise-stateless LLM agents to persist user information across sessions, but also introduce a new attack surface. We characterize the Trojan Hippo attack, a class of persistent memory attacks that operates in a more realistic threat model than prior memory poisoning work: the attacker plants a dormant payload into an agent's long-term memory via a single untrusted tool call (e.g., a crafted email), which activates only when the user later discusses sensitive topics such

summary.core_problem: 持久化 agent memory 让 LLM agent 能跨会话保存用户信息，但也把间接 prompt injection 变成可长期潜伏的攻击。Trojan Hippo 研究的是攻击者只通过一次不可信工具输入植入 payload，随后在用户谈到金融、健康、身份等敏感主题时触发并外传私人数据。
summary.importance: 这项工作与基座预训练的直接关系较弱，主要价值在 agent memory 和 post-training 安全评测。它提醒模型能力、工具调用、长期记忆三者组合后，安全边界会从单轮上下文扩展到跨会话状态。对训练研究的启发是：仅靠通用拒答或单轮安全对齐不足以覆盖持久记忆风险，训练数据和评测需要显式区分用户指令、外部内容、记忆写入、记忆读取和工具调用权限。
summary.technical_approach: Trojan Hippo 的威胁模型比传统 memory poisoning 更贴近部署场景。攻击者没有直接写 memory 的权限，也不假设用户恶意，而是通过邮件等外部工具返回内容植入指令。payload 需要完成三件事：通过安全模型过滤，进入长期 memory，并在之后遇到敏感主题时延迟激活。作者提出动态评测框架，强调三个维度：realism，使用间接注入和黑盒 safety-aligned frontier models；adaptiveness，用 OpenEvolve 对攻击 payload 做迭代搜索，在训练版 agent 环境中优化，再在 held-out 环境测试，减少对固定提示的过拟合；capability trade-off，评估防御时同时看安全性和 agent 记忆能力损失。防御设计基于最小权限、信息流隔离等安全原则。
summary.experiments: 给出的内容显示，实验覆盖异构 memory 架构和多种防御，并在端到端间接注入链路中评估攻击成功率。攻击对象是黑盒、经过安全对齐的前沿模型，payload 由自适应 red-teaming 流程生成，而不是人工固定模板。摘要和引言强调该流程能系统评估攻击与防御，但可见内容没有给出具体 ASR 数字、模型列表、memory 架构细节或各防御的量化结果。因此这里不补充未给出的数值。
summary.reading_guide: 建议泛读 20 到 30 分钟。优先看 threat model，确认攻击者能力、用户假设、memory 写入路径和触发条件；再看 adaptive red-teaming 框架，尤其是 OpenEvolve 如何生成 payload、训练环境和 held-out 测试环境如何隔离。防御章节适合重点看 capability trade-off，因为很多强隔离策略会直接损伤个性化记忆能力。若只关心基座预训练，可略读实验细节，把重点放在 memory-aware safety data 和 agent instruction hierarchy 的启发上。

summary_en.core_problem: Persistent agent memory enables cross-session personalization, but it also turns indirect prompt injection into a durable attack vector. Trojan Hippo studies a setting where an attacker plants a dormant payload through a single untrusted tool output, such as a crafted email, and the payload later activates when the user discusses sensitive topics like finance, health, or identity.
summary_en.importance: The direct relevance to foundation-model pretraining is limited. The main value is for agent-memory safety and post-training evaluation. The key lesson is that once tool use, long-term memory, and personal data are combined, the safety boundary is no longer a single context window. Training and evaluation need to distinguish user instructions, external content, memory writes, memory reads, and tool permissions. Generic refusal behavior or single-turn safety tuning is unlikely to cover this class of persistent-memory failures.
summary_en.technical_approach: The Trojan Hippo threat model is more deployment-like than many earlier memory-poisoning setups. The attacker does not get direct memory-write access and the user is assumed benign. Instead, the attacker controls an external content channel, such as email, and tries to get a payload stored in long-term memory. The payload must pass safety filtering, survive the memory pipeline, remain dormant, and activate only under sensitive-topic conditions. The paper introduces a dynamic evaluation framework with three axes: realism, using indirect injection against black-box safety-aligned frontier models; adaptiveness, using OpenEvolve to iteratively refine attack payloads in a training agent environment and evaluate them on held-out environments; and capability trade-off, measuring defenses not only by attack reduction but also by how much they degrade useful memory behavior. The defense discussion is grounded in principles such as least privilege and information-flow separation.
summary_en.experiments: The visible content indicates systematic evaluation across heterogeneous memory architectures and defenses, using end-to-end indirect injection pipelines rather than direct memory writes. Attack payloads are generated through an adaptive red-teaming loop instead of fixed hand-written prompts. The paper emphasizes held-out evaluation to avoid overfitting to one environment. Specific ASR numbers, model lists, memory-system variants, and defense-by-defense quantitative results are not present in the provided content, so no additional figures are inferred.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 20- to 30-minute skim is appropriate. Start with the threat model: attacker capability, trusted-user assumption, memory write path, and trigger condition. Then read the adaptive red-teaming setup, especially how OpenEvolve optimizes payloads and how the held-out environment is separated from the training environment. The defense section is worth reading for the capability trade-off, since strict memory isolation can easily reduce the usefulness of personalization. For pretraining-focused readers, the main takeaway is about memory-aware safety data and instruction hierarchy rather than model architecture.

recommendation.zh: 读 threat model 和 defense table；它不教你预训练，但会改变对 agent memory 安全边界的默认假设。
recommendation.en: Read the threat model and defense table; it will not inform pretraining directly, but it should update your default assumptions about agent-memory safety boundaries.

paper.title: OCR-Memory: Optical Context Retrieval for Long-Horizon Agent Memory
paper.abstract: Autonomous LLM agents increasingly operate in long-horizon, interactive settings where success depends on reusing experience accumulated over extended histories. However, existing agent memory systems are fundamentally constrained by text-context budgets: storing or revisiting raw trajectories is prohibitively token-expensive, while summarization and text-only retrieval trade token savings for information loss and fragmented evidence. To address this limitation, we propose Optical Context Retrie

summary.core_problem: 解决长时程 LLM agent 记忆受文本上下文预算限制、摘要压缩又丢失细节的问题。
summary.importance: 这是 agent memory 设计上的一个非标准思路：把历史轨迹转成图像作为高密度记忆载体，再按需 OCR 回读。对做长上下文、外部记忆和多模态统一表示的人有一点启发，但离基座预训练较远。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 OCR-Memory。核心做法是把历史交互轨迹渲染成带唯一视觉锚点的图像，检索时先 locate 再 transcribe：先通过视觉锚点定位相关区域，再把局部内容转写回文本供 agent 使用。它试图用视觉存储替代纯文本缓存，在 retrieval 时只回收必要片段，降低 prompt token 开销。
summary.experiments: 摘要强调适用于 long-horizon interactive agent 场景，并与原始轨迹存储、摘要记忆、文本检索记忆进行比较，主打更低 token 成本和更完整证据保留。摘要未给出 benchmark 名称、模型规模和量化提升，因此更像系统想法而非已被充分验证的通用结论。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自香港大学、筑波大学、延世大学等机构；从摘要看更偏 agent memory 系统设计，而非基础模型训练。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses the memory bottleneck of long-horizon LLM agents, where storing raw text trajectories is too expensive and summarization loses detail.
summary_en.importance: This is an unusual agent-memory design: encode past trajectories as images and recover relevant content through OCR-style retrieval. It is mildly interesting for people thinking about external memory and multimodal representations, but it is not close to core pretraining research.
summary_en.technical_approach: OCR-Memory renders historical trajectories into images annotated with unique visual identifiers. At retrieval time, it follows a locate-and-transcribe pipeline: first find relevant regions via visual anchors, then transcribe only the needed local content back into text for the agent. The goal is to replace text-heavy storage with a denser visual memory substrate.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract positions the method for long-horizon interactive agents and implies comparisons against raw trajectory storage, summarization-based memory, and text-only retrieval. The claimed benefits are lower prompt-token overhead and better evidence preservation. However, the abstract gives no benchmark names, model sizes, or quantitative gains, so the result currently reads more like a systems idea than a settled general finding.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with the University of Hong Kong, the University of Tsukuba, Yonsei University, and others. From the abstract, the work is primarily an agent-memory systems paper rather than a foundation-model training paper.

recommendation.zh: 想法有趣但更像系统 hack：把 token 预算转成视觉带宽；只看方法图和成本分析，若缺少强 benchmark，别把它当通用记忆范式。
recommendation.en: Interesting, but mostly a systems hack that trades token budget for visual bandwidth; read the method figure and cost analysis, and do not treat it as a general memory paradigm without strong benchmarks.

paper.title: StratMem-Bench: Evaluating Strategic Memory Use in Virtual Character Conversation Beyond Factual Recall
paper.abstract: Achieving realistic human-like conversation for virtual characters requires not only a simple memorization and recall of past events, but also the strategic utilization of memory to meet factual needs and social engagement. Current memory utilization relevant (e.g., memory-augmented generation, long-term dialogue, and etc.) benchmarks overlook this nuance, treating memory primarily as a static repository of facts rather than a dynamic resource to be strategically deployed in dialogues. To addres

summary.core_problem: 评测虚拟角色对话中模型是否能策略性使用长期记忆，而不只是机械检索事实。
summary.importance: 贡献是 Agent/角色对话记忆 benchmark。它把记忆使用拆成必需记忆、支持性记忆和无关记忆，并关注主动补充、条件性忽略等行为，对通用 Agent memory 评测有轻量参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 构建 StratMem-Bench，包含 657 个角色对话实例，每个实例提供异构记忆池。评测框架包含 Strict Memory Compliance、Memory Integration Quality、Proactive Enrichment Score、Conditional Irrelevance Rate 等指标，用来区分事实遵循、融合质量、主动丰富和忽略无关记忆的能力。
summary.experiments: 摘要未列出被测模型、具体 baseline、分数表或人评协议细节。数据规模为 657 instances，定位更接近小型诊断集而非大规模通用 Agent benchmark。
summary.authors_note: 作者来自东南大学、同济大学及独立研究者。

summary_en.core_problem: The benchmark evaluates whether virtual characters can use long-term memories strategically in dialogue rather than merely recalling facts.
summary_en.importance: The contribution is an Agent / character-dialogue memory benchmark. It separates required, supportive, and irrelevant memories and evaluates proactive enrichment and conditional irrelevance, which makes it mildly useful for studying memory behavior in agentic systems.
summary_en.technical_approach: StratMem-Bench contains 657 dialogue instances with heterogeneous memory pools. The proposed evaluation suite includes Strict Memory Compliance, Memory Integration Quality, Proactive Enrichment Score, and Conditional Irrelevance Rate to measure factual adherence, memory integration, proactive use, and suppression of irrelevant memories.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not specify evaluated models, baselines, score tables, or human evaluation details. With 657 instances, it appears to be a diagnostic benchmark rather than a broad general-purpose evaluation suite.
summary_en.authors_note: The authors are affiliated with Southeast University, Tongji University, and independent research.

recommendation.zh: 记忆评测切分有点细，但规模偏小；看指标定义即可，不必按预训练 benchmark 对待。
recommendation.en: The memory taxonomy is useful but the benchmark is small; read the metric definitions, not the full paper.

paper.title: Memanto: Typed Semantic Memory with Information-Theoretic Retrieval for Long-Horizon Agents
paper.abstract: The transition from stateless language model inference to persistent, multi session autonomous agents has revealed memory to be a primary architectural bottleneck in the deployment of production grade agentic systems. Existing methodologies largely depend on hybrid semantic graph architectures, which impose substantial computational overhead during both ingestion and retrieval. These systems typically require large language model mediated entity extraction, explicit graph schema maintenance, and

summary.core_problem: 解决长周期、多会话 autonomous agent 的持久记忆瓶颈，尤其是现有语义图和知识图谱记忆在写入、维护、检索上的高开销问题。
summary.importance: 贡献类型是 agent memory 架构。它挑战“高保真记忆必须依赖复杂知识图谱”的假设，提出更轻量的 typed semantic memory 加信息论检索方案；对长期 agent 系统有工程参考价值，但与预训练方法关系较间接。
summary.technical_approach: Memanto 采用 13 类预定义记忆类型的 typed semantic schema，配合自动冲突消解和时间版本管理。检索层使用 Moorcheh 的 Information Theoretic Search engine，目标是在不做 LLM 介导实体抽取、显式图 schema 维护、多查询图检索的情况下实现高保真记忆访问。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出具体 benchmark、模型规模、记忆库规模、延迟、成本或准确率数字。能确认的是论文声称面向 production-grade agent memory，并强调相比混合语义图架构降低 ingestion 和 retrieval 开销。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets persistent memory for long-horizon, multi-session agents, focusing on the ingestion and retrieval overhead of semantic-graph and knowledge-graph memory systems.
summary_en.importance: Its contribution is an agent-memory architecture. It challenges the assumption that high-fidelity agent memory requires complex knowledge graphs, proposing a lighter typed semantic memory plus information-theoretic retrieval design. The relevance to foundation-model training is indirect.
summary_en.technical_approach: Memanto defines a typed semantic memory schema with thirteen predefined memory categories, automated conflict resolution, and temporal versioning. Retrieval is built on Moorcheh’s Information Theoretic Search engine, avoiding LLM-mediated entity extraction, explicit graph schema maintenance, and multi-query graph retrieval pipelines.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not report concrete benchmarks, model sizes, memory scales, latency, cost, or accuracy numbers. It claims production-grade applicability and lower ingestion/retrieval overhead compared with hybrid semantic graph approaches.

recommendation.zh: 只看 typed memory schema 和检索接口设计；若没有延迟/召回实测，图数据库替代论先当工程假设。
recommendation.en: Skim the typed schema and retrieval interface; without latency and recall measurements, the anti-graph claim is still an engineering hypothesis.

institutions: implications for scalable deployment of agentic memory systems

paper.title: Stateless Decision Memory for Enterprise AI Agents
paper.abstract: Enterprise deployment of long-horizon decision agents in regulated domains (underwriting, claims adjudication, tax examination) is dominated by retrieval-augmented pipelines despite a decade of increasingly sophisticated stateful memory architectures. We argue this reflects a hidden requirement: regulated deployment is load-bearing on four systems properties (deterministic replay, auditable rationale, multi-tenant isolation, statelessness for horizontal scale), and stateful architectures violate

summary.core_problem: 受监管领域企业级长序列决策Agent的有状态内存架构无法满足可复现、可审计、多租户隔离、无状态水平扩展四个核心合规要求
summary.importance: 首次提出适配受监管场景的无状态内存架构，解决了有状态内存的原生合规缺陷，属于系统创新
summary.technical_approach: 提出Deterministic Projection Memory（DPM），采用仅追加事件日志+决策时刻任务条件投影的结构，无需维护常驻状态
summary.experiments: 在10个受监管决策案例、3种内存预算下测试，宽松内存预算下与摘要式内存效果持平，20倍压缩比下事实精度提升0.52、推理连贯性提升0.53

summary_en.core_problem: Stateful memory architectures for enterprise long-horizon decision agents in regulated domains fail to meet four core compliance requirements: deterministic replay, auditable rationale, multi-tenant isolation, and stateless horizontal scaling
summary_en.importance: First stateless memory architecture adapted for regulated scenarios, solves native compliance defects of stateful memory, belongs to system innovation
summary_en.technical_approach: Propose Deterministic Projection Memory (DPM), which adopts append-only event log plus task-conditioned projection at decision time, no need to maintain resident state
summary_en.experiments: Tested on 10 regulated decision cases under 3 memory budgets, matches summarization-based memory performance under generous budgets, improves factual precision by 0.52 and reasoning coherence by 0.53 at 20x compression ratio

recommendation.zh: 针对合规场景的Agent内存设计，无预训练相关洞察，作为通用Agent架构参考备查即可
recommendation.en: Agent memory design for compliance scenarios, no pretrain-related insights, only for literature reference.

paper.title: FSFM: A Biologically-Inspired Framework for Selective Forgetting of Agent Memory
paper.abstract: For LLM agents, memory management critically impacts efficiency, quality, and security. While much research focuses on retention, selective forgetting--inspired by human cognitive processes (hippocampal indexing/consolidation theory and Ebbinghaus forgetting curve)--remains underexplored. We argue that in resource-constrained environments, a well-designed forgetting mechanism is as crucial as remembering, delivering benefits across three dimensions: (1) efficiency via intelligent memory pruning,

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM Agent内存管理侧重记忆留存，缺乏适配资源约束、质量优化、安全要求的选择性遗忘机制
summary.importance: 首次系统性提出Agent选择性遗忘的分类框架和实现方案，属于方法创新
summary.technical_approach: 借鉴人类认知的海马体索引和艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线，将遗忘分为被动衰减、主动删除、安全触发、自适应强化四类，结合向量数据库实现
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露完整实验数据，仅说明在效率、质量、安全三个维度验证了框架收益

summary_en.core_problem: Existing LLM agent memory management focuses on retention, lacks selective forgetting mechanisms adapted to resource constraints, quality optimization and security requirements
summary_en.importance: First systematic classification framework and implementation scheme for agent selective forgetting, belongs to methodological innovation
summary_en.technical_approach: Inspired by human cognitive hippocampal indexing and Ebbinghaus forgetting curve, divides forgetting into four categories: passive decay, active deletion, safety-triggered, adaptive reinforcement, implemented with vector database
summary_en.experiments: Full experimental data not disclosed in abstract, only verifies framework benefits in three dimensions: efficiency, quality and security

recommendation.zh: Agent记忆遗忘的分类框架可做参考，无预训练相关的核心洞察，无需读正文
recommendation.en: Agent memory forgetting taxonomy for reference, no core pretrain insights, no need to read full text.

paper.title: Ask Only When Needed: Proactive Retrieval from Memory and Skills for Experience-Driven Lifelong Agents
paper.abstract: Online lifelong learning enables agents to accumulate experience across interactions and continually improve on long-horizon tasks. However, existing methods typically treat retrieval from past experience as a passive operation, triggering it only at task initialization or after completing a step. Consequently, agents often fail to identify knowledge gaps during interaction and proactively retrieve the most useful experience for the current decision. To address this limitation, we present Proact

summary.core_problem: 解决长期在线交互型 Agent 在执行过程中不会主动识别知识缺口、也不会及时从历史经验中检索可用记忆与技能的问题。
summary.importance: 这是一个 Agent 记忆与终身学习方向的方法工作，贡献点不在基座预训练，而在把经验库从被动检索改成决策时机驱动的主动检索，并把记忆更新与策略演化放进同一闭环。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 ProactAgent 框架。核心包括两部分：一是 ExpOnEvo，用于在线持续改进，既更新策略也精炼经验库；二是结构化经验库，把历史交互拆成 factual memory、episodic memory、behavioral skills 等类型。系统在交互过程中判断当前是否存在知识缺口，再主动触发对相应记忆或技能的检索，而不是只在任务开始或步骤结束后被动调用。
summary.experiments: 从摘要可见，实验聚焦长程任务中的在线终身学习与经验驱动决策，对比对象应是被动检索或仅初始化检索的 Agent 基线。摘要强调主动检索能提升当前决策质量与持续改进能力，但未给出参数规模、具体 benchmark、提升幅度或统计显著性，因此结论更适合作为 Agent memory 设计信号，而不是可直接迁移到 pretrain 的强证据。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括华东师范大学与上海 AI Laboratory。后者在 Agent、通用模型与系统方向持续有产出，但这篇更偏 Agent 记忆框架，不属于基座预训练主线。

summary_en.core_problem: It addresses the failure of lifelong interactive agents to detect knowledge gaps during execution and proactively retrieve useful memories or skills from past experience.
summary_en.importance: This is an agent-memory and lifelong learning paper rather than a foundation pretraining paper. Its contribution is turning retrieval from a passive operation into a decision-time proactive mechanism, while coupling memory refinement with policy evolution.
summary_en.technical_approach: The paper proposes ProactAgent. Its core pieces are: (1) ExpOnEvo, an online continual-improvement loop that updates both policy and memory; and (2) a structured experience base that separates factual memory, episodic memory, and behavioral skills. During interaction, the agent decides when a knowledge gap exists and proactively retrieves the relevant experience, instead of only retrieving at task start or after a step finishes.
summary_en.experiments: From the abstract, experiments focus on long-horizon online lifelong tasks and likely compare against passive-retrieval or initialization-only agent baselines. The claimed gain is better decision quality and continual improvement through proactive retrieval, but the abstract does not provide model sizes, benchmarks, or effect sizes. For pretraining researchers, this is a weak signal about memory design rather than strong evidence for changing training methodology.
summary_en.authors_note: The institutions include East China Normal University and Shanghai AI Laboratory. The latter has a visible track record in agents, general models, and systems, but this work is much more about agent memory than core pretraining.

recommendation.zh: 更像 Agent memory orchestration，不会直接改你的 pretrain 方案；若在做外部记忆或 continual pretrain 接口，只看主动检索触发机制即可。
recommendation.en: This is mostly agent-memory orchestration, not something that changes pretraining priors; only read the retrieval-trigger design if you care about external memory or continual-pretrain interfaces.

paper.title: Cognis: Context-Aware Memory for Conversational AI Agents
paper.abstract: LLM agents lack persistent memory, causing conversations to reset each session and preventing personalization over time. We present Lyzr Cognis, a unified memory architecture for conversational AI agents that addresses this limitation through a multi-stage retrieval pipeline. Cognis combines a dual-store backend pairing OpenSearch BM25 keyword matching with Matryoshka vector similarity search, fused via Reciprocal Rank Fusion. Its context-aware ingestion pipeline retrieves existing memories befo

summary.core_problem: 为对话式LLM Agent提供可持续的“长期记忆”检索与更新机制，避免跨会话遗忘并支持个性化。
summary.importance: 属于Agent记忆/RAG系统工程：把检索、重排、时间权重、版本管理做成可复用组件；对预训练本身不直接，但对“外部记忆替代长上下文/continual”有间接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 双存储检索（OpenSearch BM25 + Matryoshka向量检索）并用RRF融合；写入侧先检索再抽取以做版本跟踪（保留历史、保持一致性）；时间boost；BGE-2 cross-encoder重排提升最终命中质量。
summary.experiments: 在LoCoMo与LongMemEval上，覆盖8个生成模型，报告SOTA；但主要是系统组合与参数/组件选择，缺少对“记忆写入策略/冲突解决”更干净的因果消融信息（从摘要无法确认）。
summary.authors_note: Lyzr Research（开源并已生产部署）。

summary_en.core_problem: Provide persistent, context-aware long-term memory for conversational LLM agents across sessions via retrieval and update mechanisms.
summary_en.importance: Agent memory/RAG engineering: packages retrieval fusion, reranking, temporal weighting, and versioning into a reusable component. Indirectly relevant to pretraining via the external-memory vs long-context/continual-learning trade-off.
summary_en.technical_approach: Dual-store retrieval (OpenSearch BM25 + Matryoshka embedding search) fused with Reciprocal Rank Fusion; ingestion does retrieve-before-extract for version tracking (keep full history while maintaining consistency); temporal boosting; BGE-2 cross-encoder reranking.
summary_en.experiments: Reports SOTA on LoCoMo and LongMemEval across eight generator models; appears largely a systems composition, with unclear causal ablations on write/update policies from the abstract.
summary_en.authors_note: Lyzr Research (open-sourced and deployed in production).

recommendation.zh: 当作“记忆=检索+版本管理”的工程配方看即可：只读系统结构与LoCoMo/LongMemEval结果，别期待对预训练有新结论。
recommendation.en: Treat it as an engineering recipe for memory = retrieval + versioning; skim the architecture and LoCoMo/LongMemEval tables, not a pretraining insight paper.

paper.title: To Know is to Construct: Schema-Constrained Generation for Agent Memory
paper.abstract: Constructivist epistemology argues that knowledge is actively constructed rather than passively copied. Despite the generative nature of Large Language Models (LLMs), most existing agent memory systems are still based on dense retrieval. However, dense retrieval heavily relies on semantic overlap or entity matching within sentences. Consequently, embeddings often fail to distinguish instances that are semantically similar but contextually distinct, introducing substantial noise by retrieving con

summary.core_problem: Agent 记忆检索在“语义相近但情境不同”时容易被 dense retrieval 误召回，而开放式生成式检索又会产生不存在的 key（结构性幻觉）导致查找失败。
summary.importance: 贡献点在于把“记忆访问”从纯检索改成“受约束的生成”，试图在可控性与表达力之间折中；对 tool/memory 设计有启发，但对基座预训练方法影响有限。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 SCG-MEM：用“schema（认知图式）”作为中间结构，对记忆条目进行结构化组织；回忆时先在 schema 空间内生成受约束的查询/键，再映射到存储的记忆项以避免生成不存在的 key，并减少语义相似导致的错配召回。摘要未给出足够实现细节（schema 如何学习/定义、约束形式、检索接口）。
summary.experiments: 摘要未披露具体模型规模、数据集与量化结果；仅描述要解决 dense retrieval 噪声与结构性幻觉两类失败模式，缺少可判断“是否干净对比”的信息。

summary_en.core_problem: Agent memory suffers from (1) dense retrieval confusing semantically similar but contextually distinct entries, and (2) open-ended generative access producing non-existent keys (“structural hallucination”) that break lookup.
summary_en.importance: The paper reframes memory access as constrained generation rather than pure retrieval, aiming for a controllability–expressivity trade-off; useful for agent memory design, but only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: SCG-MEM organizes memories with explicit schemas and performs recall by generating queries/keys within schema constraints, then mapping them to stored entries to avoid non-existent keys and reduce context-mismatched retrieval. The abstract lacks key implementation details (how schemas are learned/defined, constraint mechanism, and retrieval interface).
summary_en.experiments: No concrete model sizes, datasets, or quantitative results are provided in the abstract, making it hard to assess cleanliness of comparisons or effect size.

recommendation.zh: 把“生成式记忆访问”加结构约束来治 key 幻觉是对的方向，但摘要缺关键细节与硬指标；先等正文/代码再决定是否跟进。
recommendation.en: Constrained generative memory access is the right direction to curb key hallucinations, but the abstract is light on mechanisms and hard numbers—wait for full details/code before investing.

paper.title: PolicyBank: Evolving Policy Understanding for LLM Agents
paper.abstract: LLM agents operating under organizational policies must comply with authorization constraints typically specified in natural language. In practice, such specifications inevitably contain ambiguities and logical or semantic gaps that cause the agent's behavior to systematically diverge from the true requirements. We ask: by letting an agent evolve its policy understanding through interaction and corrective feedback from pre-deployment testing, can it autonomously refine its interpretation to clos

summary.core_problem: 解决 LLM agent 在自然语言组织政策存在歧义和缺口时，如何通过交互测试与纠错反馈逐步修正自身政策理解，而不是机械记忆错误规则。
summary.importance: 这篇工作的价值在 agent memory 与 policy compliance 机制，而不是基座模型本身。它有一定方法新意：把“政策理解”视为可演化对象，并构造了能区分对齐失败与执行失败的测试基准。
summary.technical_approach: 作者提出 PolicyBank，一种结构化记忆机制，用于维护工具级 policy insight，并在预部署测试中根据纠错反馈迭代更新。与把原始 policy 文本视为不可变真值的记忆方法不同，PolicyBank 允许 agent 显式修正对规则的解释。论文还扩展了一个 tool-calling benchmark，注入可控 policy gap，用来隔离 specification gap 带来的失败。
summary.experiments: 摘要没有给出模型规模和具体 benchmark 名称，但给出了关键对比设定：现有 memory 机制在原始 policy 上接近零违规，却在真实需求上仍有高违规率；PolicyBank 旨在缩小这种“表面合规、实则错误”的差距。若看正文，重点应放在 policy gap 构造方式、违规率定义和 ablation，而不是绝对分数。
summary.authors_note: 机构包括 Google Cloud 和 University of Wisconsin-Madison。作者中 Jinsung Yoon、Tomas Pfister 具备较强工业研究背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper addresses how an LLM agent can refine its understanding of ambiguous natural-language organizational policies through interaction and corrective feedback, instead of rigidly memorizing flawed policy text.
summary_en.importance: Its value is mainly in agent memory and policy-compliance methodology rather than foundation-model research. The key novelty is to treat policy understanding as an evolvable object and to build a benchmark that separates alignment failures from execution failures.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors propose PolicyBank, a structured memory mechanism that stores tool-level policy insights and iteratively updates them using corrective feedback from pre-deployment testing. Unlike prior memory approaches that treat the original policy as immutable ground truth, PolicyBank explicitly revises the agent's interpretation. They also extend a tool-calling benchmark with controlled policy gaps to isolate failures caused by specification ambiguity.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract does not provide model sizes or the exact benchmark name, but it highlights the key comparison: existing memory methods can achieve near-zero violations against the raw policy text while still violating the true requirements at a high rate. The important parts to inspect are the construction of policy gaps, the violation metrics, and the ablations, rather than the headline scores.
summary_en.authors_note: The work is from Google Cloud and the University of Wisconsin-Madison. Jinsung Yoon and Tomas Pfister have strong industry research backgrounds.

recommendation.zh: agent 方向里算有方法意识，但离基座研究较远；只看 benchmark 设计和“compliant but wrong”这个 failure mode，别在分数上停太久。
recommendation.en: This is method-aware by agent-paper standards but still far from core pretraining; read it for the benchmark design and the 'compliant but wrong' failure mode, not the raw scores.

paper.title: MemEvoBench: Benchmarking Memory MisEvolution in LLM Agents
paper.abstract: Equipping Large Language Models (LLMs) with persistent memory enhances interaction continuity and personalization but introduces new safety risks. Specifically, contaminated or biased memory accumulation can trigger abnormal agent behaviors. Existing evaluation methods have not yet established a standardized framework for measuring memory misevolution. This phenomenon refers to the gradual behavioral drift resulting from repeated exposure to misleading information. To address this gap, we introd

summary.core_problem: 论文要评测带持久记忆的 LLM Agent 在长期交互中如何因误导信息、噪声工具输出和偏置反馈而发生 memory misevolution，即记忆驱动的行为漂移。
summary.importance: 贡献主要是 benchmark：把长期记忆安全从单轮越狱或短程工具错误，扩展到多轮记忆污染与行为演化评测。对做 Agent memory 的人有用，但对基座预训练研究是外围信息。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 MemEvoBench，覆盖 7 个领域、36 类风险的 QA-style 任务，并把 20 个 Agent-SafetyBench 环境改造成含噪工具返回的 workflow-style 任务。核心设计是混合 benign 与 misleading memory pool，在多轮交互中观察记忆累积如何改变后续行为。
summary.experiments: 摘要说明在代表性模型上进行了评测，但未给出具体模型名单、规模和量化结果。就定位看，这是安全 benchmark，不是方法论文，也不直接回答如何在预训练阶段缓解该问题。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper benchmarks how LLM agents with persistent memory undergo memory misevolution—behavioral drift caused by misleading information, noisy tool outputs, and biased feedback over long interactions.
summary_en.importance: Its main contribution is a benchmark: it extends agent safety evaluation from single-turn jailbreaks or short-horizon tool errors to multi-turn memory contamination and behavioral drift. Useful for agent-memory work, but peripheral to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: It introduces MemEvoBench, with QA-style tasks spanning 7 domains and 36 risk types, plus workflow-style tasks adapted from 20 Agent-SafetyBench environments with noisy tool returns. The key design is mixing benign and misleading memory pools across multi-round interactions to simulate memory evolution.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract says representative models are evaluated, but does not provide model names, scales, or quantitative results. This is a safety benchmark rather than a method paper, and it does not directly answer how to mitigate the issue at pretraining time.

recommendation.zh: 如果你做 agent memory safety，可收下 benchmark 设计；否则知道有“记忆误演化”这个 failure mode 就够了，不必细读正文。
recommendation.en: If you work on agent memory safety, keep the benchmark design; otherwise, it is enough to know that 'memory misevolution' is a real failure mode without reading the full paper.

paper.title: Thought-Retriever: Don't Just Retrieve Raw Data, Retrieve Thoughts for Memory-Augmented Agentic Systems

summary.core_problem: 在检索增强LLM（RALM）中，外部知识库规模很大但上下文窗口有限，传统“top-K原文chunk拼接”导致召回受限；而层次化/树状摘要又是“与查询无关的静态压缩”，难以适配未来多样查询。本文要解决的是：如何在不扩展上下文长度的前提下，让LLM在交互过程中把“用过的知识”沉淀为可复用、可追溯、可去冗余的记忆单元，从而在后续查询中实现近似“任意长外部数据条件化”的知识利用。
summary.importance: 对基座预训练本身不是直接方法创新，但对“记忆/检索作为外部上下文扩展”的范式有启发：1）把RAG的中间产物（回答过程中的推理/归纳）结构化为长期记忆（thought），相当于一种在线的、查询驱动的数据压缩与索引机制；2）提出root source可追溯映射与基于溯源的precision/recall度量，强调可验证的知识压缩（对后续做可追溯训练数据构造、持续学习记忆库、以及RAG评测更有价值）；3）整体是模型无关、低额外开销的系统化流程，适合作为后续“用RL/持续学习训练记忆生成与合并策略”的基线框架。
summary.technical_approach:
核心概念是Thought：由一次查询Q、检索到的上下文Ki与模型生成的回答A共同抽象得到的“持久化认知单元”Ti=Abstract(Q,A,Ki)。Thought必须满足三属性：Query-conditioned（与特定查询绑定）、Abstractive（从对话/证据中提炼知识点）、Validated（通过置信度检查ci与新颖性检查si，避免幻觉与冗余）。

关键机制：
1）Thought的溯源（root source mapping）\hat{O}(·)：对原始chunk K，\hat{O}(K)={K}；对由检索集合R生成的thought T，\hat{O}(T)=⋃_{r∈R}\hat{O}(r)。这使得高层thought始终可追溯到最初的原始证据chunk集合，便于事实核验与评估。
2）评测指标扩展：用\hat{O}(Ti)替代“本次检索到的top-K chunk”，定义Precision=|Ki∩\hat{O}(Ti)|/|\hat{O}(Ti)|，Recall=|Ki∩\hat{O}(Ti)|/|Ki|，强调“通过thought间接覆盖到的根证据”能提升召回。
3）系统流水线（Figure 2 / Algorithm 1）：(a) Thought retrieval：同时从外部知识库与thought memory检索；(b) Answer generation：基于检索结果生成回答；(c) Thought & confidence generation：再生成thought及其置信用于验证，抑制幻觉；(d) Thought merge：计算相似度，判断是否冗余（阈值ε）；(e) Memory update：丢弃无意义/冗余thought，仅保留新颖thought写入记忆。

与树状摘要式层次RAG的差异：树摘要是离线、与未来查询无关的静态聚类压缩；Thought-Retriever是在线、由真实查询驱动的动态结构，记忆内容随“被问到什么/用到什么证据”演化，理论上更贴合长尾查询分布。
summary.experiments: 给定你提供的“全文内容”片段主要覆盖方法定义、溯源映射与指标、以及流程概述（并提到Appendix A.2含prompt细节），但未包含具体实验设置、数据集、基线对比、指标数值、消融结果、开销评估等段落与表格。因此无法基于当前全文片段可靠提取：参数量、知识库规模、top-K、召回提升百分比、以及thought合并阈值ε的敏感性等具体数字结论。若补充论文实验章节/表格（或PDF），可进一步按：任务类型（QA/agent任务）、记忆增长曲线、溯源precision/recall、幻觉率、以及计算成本（额外调用次数/延迟）做定量复盘。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约15–25分钟）：
1）重点看Thought的形式化定义与三属性（Query-conditioned/Abstractive/Validated），理解它与“摘要/笔记”的本质差异。
2）精看root source mapping \hat{O}(·) 的递归定义与示例（K1,K2,K3），这是其可追溯评测与可验证记忆的核心。
3）看Figure 1对比：标准RAG的召回瓶颈、树状层次摘要的刚性、以及Thought-Retriever的动态记忆直觉。
4）看Figure 2与Algorithm 1把握工程落地：thought生成、置信验证、相似度合并与记忆更新的具体接口；并翻Appendix A.2的prompt以判断其对模型/任务的敏感性。

带着问题读：Validated具体如何实现（自评置信/外部校验/一致性检查）？相似度度量与ε如何选？记忆增长是否会导致检索噪声与分布漂移？这些点决定其能否成为可训练的“记忆压缩策略”。

summary_en.core_problem: RAG-style LLM agents face a hard context bottleneck: retrieving top-K raw chunks from a massive KB yields high precision but low recall, while hierarchical/tree summarization is a rigid, query-agnostic compression built offline. The paper targets a practical question: how to let an LLM condition on effectively unbounded external knowledge without increasing context length, by turning interaction-derived reasoning/abstractions into persistent, reusable memory units that remain grounded and non-redundant.
summary_en.importance: Not a pretraining algorithm per se, but it contributes a useful memory-augmentation paradigm for foundation-model systems: (1) it elevates “thoughts” (query-conditioned abstractions produced during normal RAG answering) into a long-term memory substrate—an online, usage-driven compression/indexing mechanism; (2) it introduces provenance-aware evaluation via a recursive root-source mapping, which is valuable for building verifiable compressed memories and for future work on training/RL-optimizing memory writing/merging policies; (3) it is model-agnostic and designed to add minimal overhead, making it a plausible baseline for continual/agentic memory research.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The key construct is a Thought Ti, defined as a persistent cognitive unit abstracted from a specific query Q, the generated answer A, and retrieved context Ki: Ti = Abstract(Q, A, Ki). A valid thought must be (i) query-conditioned, (ii) abstractive (distills a coherent knowledge point), and (iii) validated via confidence (ci) and novelty (si) checks to reduce hallucination and redundancy.

Core mechanisms:
1) Provenance tracking with root source mapping \hat{O}(·): for a raw chunk K, \hat{O}(K)={K}; for a thought T generated from a retrieved set R (raw chunks and/or prior thoughts), \hat{O}(T)=⋃_{r∈R}\hat{O}(r). This ensures every high-level thought can be traced back to original evidence chunks.
2) Provenance-aware retrieval metrics: redefine precision/recall using \hat{O}(Ti) to measure how much of the required evidence set Ki is covered by the thought’s root sources, highlighting recall gains beyond the immediate top-K context.
3) End-to-end pipeline (Figure 2 / Algorithm 1): retrieve from both KB and thought memory → generate answer → generate thought + confidence for validation → merge by similarity (threshold ε) to avoid redundancy → update memory by keeping only meaningful, novel thoughts.

Contrast to hierarchical RAG: tree summaries are static and query-agnostic; Thought-Retriever builds a dynamic, query-driven memory that evolves with actual usage patterns.
summary_en.experiments: The provided full-content excerpt focuses on definitions, provenance mapping, metrics, and the pipeline overview, but does not include the experimental section, tables, or quantitative results. Therefore, no reliable numbers (datasets, KB size, top-K, recall/accuracy gains, latency/overhead, ablations on validation/merge threshold ε) can be extracted from the current material. With the experiment section/PDF, a proper analysis would cover: performance vs. standard RAG and hierarchical summarization, memory growth vs. retrieval noise, hallucination reduction from validation, and compute overhead (extra LLM calls).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (15–25 minutes):
1) Read the formal Thought definition and its three required properties—this is the conceptual novelty.
2) Study the recursive root-source mapping \hat{O}(·) and the K1/K2/K3 example; it underpins verifiability and the proposed metrics.
3) Use Figure 1 to understand the motivation: top-K recall limits and why static trees fail under diverse future queries.
4) Use Figure 2 + Algorithm 1 to understand implementation hooks (thought generation, confidence validation, similarity merge, memory update). Check Appendix A.2 prompts to gauge robustness/sensitivity.

Questions to keep in mind: how exactly are confidence/novelty validated, what similarity metric is used for merging, and how does memory scale without drifting into noisy retrieval?

recommendation.zh: 值得看溯源映射+precision/recall定义：把“thought”当可追溯记忆单元很干净，适合作为后续用RL/持续学习训练记忆生成/合并策略的基线。
recommendation.en: Worth it for the provenance mapping and precision/recall definitions: treating “thoughts” as traceable memory units is a clean baseline for RL/continual-learning work on memory write/merge policies.

paper.title: Drawing on Memory: Dual-Trace Encoding Improves Cross-Session Recall in LLM Agents

summary.core_problem: 带持久记忆的 LLM Agent 往往以“扁平事实”存储信息，缺乏学习时上下文，导致跨会话回忆、时间推理与更新跟踪能力弱。
summary.importance: 方法创新（记忆表示/写入策略）+ 明确量化收益：提出一种低门槛的记忆编码改造，在不改变底座模型的前提下显著提升跨会话召回与时间相关推理；对长期记忆、RAG/Memory 设计与评测具有直接启发。
summary.technical_approach: Dual-Trace Encoding：每条记忆由两部分组成——(1) fact trace：抽象事实；(2) scene trace：对“学习当下情境”的叙事性重建，强迫编码时承诺具体上下文细节，从而形成更可区分的记忆痕迹；与 fact-only 控制组在覆盖与格式上匹配以减少混杂因素。
summary.experiments: 在 LongMemEval-S（4,575 sessions，100 recall questions；其中 99 个问题用于与对照共享比较）上评测：dual-trace 总体准确率 73.7% vs 53.5%，提升 +20.2pp；在 temporal reasoning（+40pp）、knowledge-update tracking（+25pp）、multi-session aggregation（+30pp）等子能力上提升更显著，并报告置信区间与 bootstrap 显著性。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM agents with persistent memory often store flat facts without learning context, hurting cross-session recall, temporal reasoning, and update tracking.
summary_en.importance: A practical memory-representation/write strategy with clear gains: improves long-term, cross-session recall without changing the base model, offering actionable insights for agent memory and evaluation.
summary_en.technical_approach: Dual-Trace Encoding stores each memory as (1) a fact trace and (2) a scene trace—a narrative reconstruction of the learning moment—forcing commitment to contextual details to create more distinctive memory traces; compared against a format- and coverage-matched fact-only control.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on LongMemEval-S (4,575 sessions, 100 recall questions; 99 shared for controlled comparison): 73.7% accuracy vs 53.5% (+20.2pp). Larger gains on temporal reasoning (+40pp), knowledge-update tracking (+25pp), and multi-session aggregation (+30pp), with CIs and bootstrap significance.

recommendation.zh: 低改动却真提升跨会话回忆，值得立刻在自家memory/RAG栈做ablation；重点看双轨写入格式与跨会话评测那张主表。
recommendation.en: Small intervention with measurable cross-session recall gains—worth reproducing as an ablation in your memory/RAG stack; focus on the dual-trace write schema and the main cross-session table.

paper.title: M$^\star$: Every Task Deserves Its Own Memory Harness

summary.core_problem: 现有LLM Agent的记忆系统往往是为特定任务手工设计，跨任务迁移差，缺少“按任务自适应”的记忆机制构建方法。
summary.importance: 贡献在于把“记忆系统设计”形式化为可执行程序并用搜索/进化自动发现，属于Agent系统层的方法创新；对长期交互、工具使用、RAG/记忆编排有启发，但对基座预训练本身是间接相关。
summary.technical_approach: 将memory harness表示为Python“记忆程序”，显式包含(1)数据Schema、(2)存储/读写逻辑、(3)Agent工作流指令；用反思式代码进化（population-based search + 基于失败案例的迭代修复）联合优化上述组件，以任务指标为导向自动生成更合适的记忆编排。
summary.experiments: 在4个不同基准上评测（摘要截断未给出具体基准名与数值细节）；对比固定记忆设计/常见记忆架构，展示跨任务下自动发现的memory program更稳健（具体提升幅度、模型规模与消融需看正文）。

summary_en.core_problem: LLM agents typically rely on hand-crafted, task-specific memory systems that transfer poorly across tasks; there is no general way to automatically tailor memory designs per task.
summary_en.importance: Reframes memory-system design as executable programs and uses evolutionary search to discover task-optimized memory harnesses—methodologically interesting for agent memory/RAG orchestration, but only indirectly relevant to foundation-model pretraining.
summary_en.technical_approach: Represents a memory harness as a Python “memory program” specifying (1) data schema, (2) storage/read-write logic, and (3) agent workflow instructions; jointly optimizes them via reflective code evolution using population-based search and failure-driven refinement.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on four benchmarks (details truncated in the abstract). Compared against fixed memory designs/common memory architectures; reports improved robustness/performance, but model sizes and exact gains require the full paper.

recommendation.zh: 把记忆编排当程序再用搜索自动发现，适合当“记忆系统自动化”文献索引；细节实现噪声大，读方法概览与搜索空间定义即可。
recommendation.en: Treats memory harnesses as programs and auto-discovers them via search—good literature anchor for automated memory orchestration; details are noisy, read the method overview + search space only.

paper.title: ClawVM: Harness-Managed Virtual Memory for Stateful Tool-Using LLM Agents

summary.core_problem: 有状态的工具调用型 LLM 智能体把上下文窗口当作工作内存，但现有 agent harness 对“状态驻留（residency）与持久性（durability）”的管理多为 best-effort：压缩/裁剪后关键状态丢失、reset 时绕过 flush、写回覆盖式破坏（destructive writeback）。这些问题导致重复工具调用、偏好/约束丢失、计划中断且难以诊断与复现。
summary.importance: 随着智能体运行时长从分钟扩展到小时/天、跨多轮上下文窗口与多 session，状态管理成为可靠性的决定因素。仅靠检索质量提升、摘要压缩调参或外部记忆插件无法提供可执行的契约：什么必须保留、何时必须落盘、丢失如何可观测。作者主张应像操作系统管理内存一样，把“上下文=物理内存、外部存储=磁盘”的问题上升为虚拟内存机制，并在 harness 层强制执行。
summary.technical_approach:
ClawVM：一种由 harness 管理的“虚拟内存层”，核心设计包括：
(1) Typed pages：把 agent 状态拆成带类型的页面（而非自由文本块），便于策略化管理与验证。
(2) Minimum-fidelity invariants：每页定义最低保真不变量（在 token 预算压力下最多可降级到什么程度），避免 compaction 把关键状态降到不可用。
(3) Multi-resolution representations：同一页可在多分辨率/多表示间切换（全量细节→压缩→结构化字段→指针），实现“渐进降级”而非全有或全无。
(4) Staged, validated writeback：在每个生命周期边界（compaction/pruning/reset 等）执行分阶段、可验证、非破坏性的写回协议，防止 flush 被绕过与覆盖式写回。
(5) Observable faults + deterministic replay：当不变量被破坏或状态丢失时触发可观测 fault，使问题可诊断、可回放；并用 offline oracle（具备未来需求知识）分析在线策略是否仍有改进空间。
summary.experiments: 在合成工作负载、12 条真实 session trace、对抗压力测试与 OpenClaw 派生工作负载上评估：ClawVM 将“策略可控的 faults”（refetch、duplicate-tool、post-compaction bootstrap、flush-miss）从检索基线的平均 67.8/配置、以及“实践者调参的 compaction+retrieval”基线的 1.5/配置降到 0；paging instability 分别降低 77.4% 与 11.4%。在最紧 token 预算下，30 个任务级回放成功率 100%（对比实践者基线 76.7%）。策略引擎开销中位数 <50 微秒/turn。离线 oracle 显示在线策略已达最优 fault 数（零剩余 headroom）。
summary.reading_guide:
must_read（精读）：
- 重点章节：Introduction（把 harness 视作“agent OS kernel”的论证与问题分类）；方法章节中关于 typed pages、minimum-fidelity invariants、multi-resolution 表示的形式化定义与示例；writeback 协议（如何做到 validated、non-destructive、覆盖所有 lifecycle boundary）；fault model 与 deterministic replay（如何让错误可观测、可回归测试）；offline oracle 分析（如何证明在线策略已最优）。
- 重点图表/结果：Figure 1（整体架构与数据流）；fault 类型统计与归零结果；不同 token budget 下的稳定性/成功率曲线；开销评估（<50μs/turn）。

skim（泛读）：
- 先读 Introduction + Contributions（问题与方案一页抓住）；再扫 Background（为何现有 pruning/retrieval/compaction 不够）；然后直接看实验主表（fault=0、成功率提升、开销）；最后快速浏览 writeback 与 fault model 的小节以理解“为什么能保证”。
summary.authors_note: 作者的核心立场是：状态可靠性不是“更好的检索/更长的上下文/更聪明的摘要”能根治的，而需要像 OS 虚拟内存一样的可执行契约与故障模型；且唯一合适的强制点在 harness（它天然掌控 prompt 组装、工具调用与生命周期事件）。论文贡献更偏系统与工程可验证性：用不变量、写回验证、可观测 fault 与确定性回放，把智能体记忆从启发式调参变成可审计的运行时机制。

institutions: Max Planck Institute for Software SystemsSaarbrücken, Saarland

summary_en.core_problem: Stateful tool-using LLM agents treat the context window as working memory, but today’s agent harnesses manage state residency and durability on a best-effort basis. This causes recurring failures: critical state is lost after compaction, flushes are bypassed on reset, and writeback can be destructive (overwrite instead of merge). The result is repeated tool calls, lost preferences/constraints, broken plans, and failures that are hard to diagnose or reproduce.
summary_en.importance: As agents run for hours/days across multiple context windows and sessions, state management becomes the dominant reliability bottleneck. Improving retrieval quality, tuning compaction, or adding memory plugins does not provide an enforceable contract for what must remain resident, what must be durable, and how losses become observable. The paper argues for an OS-style framing—context as physical memory, external stores as disk—and for enforcing virtual-memory-like guarantees at the harness layer.
summary_en.technical_approach:
ClawVM is a harness-managed virtual memory layer with:
(1) Typed pages: agent state is managed as typed pages rather than free-form text.
(2) Minimum-fidelity invariants: each page declares how far it may degrade under token pressure.
(3) Multi-resolution representations: pages can gracefully degrade (full detail → compressed → structured fields → pointer) instead of all-or-nothing compaction.
(4) Staged, validated writeback: deterministic, non-destructive commits at every lifecycle boundary (compaction/pruning/reset), preventing bypassed flushes and destructive overwrites.
(5) Observable faults + deterministic replay: invariant violations/state loss raise explicit faults, making issues diagnosable and replayable; an offline oracle (with future demand knowledge) is used to assess optimality/headroom.
summary_en.experiments: Evaluated on synthetic workloads, 12 real-session traces, adversarial stress tests, and OpenClaw-derived workload families. ClawVM eliminates all policy-controllable faults (refetch, duplicate-tool, post-compaction bootstrap, flush-miss): from 67.8 mean faults per workload-budget configuration (retrieval baseline) and 1.5 (practitioner-tuned compaction+retrieval) down to 0. Paging instability is reduced by 77.4% and 11.4% respectively. At the tightest token budget, task-level replay success is 100% vs 76.7% for the practitioner baseline. Median policy-engine overhead is <50 μs per turn. Offline oracle analysis indicates the online policy already achieves the optimal fault count (no remaining headroom).
summary_en.reading_guide:
must_read (deep dive):
- Key sections: Introduction (harness as an “agent OS kernel” and failure taxonomy); the formal design of typed pages, minimum-fidelity invariants, and multi-resolution representations; the staged validated writeback protocol across lifecycle boundaries; the fault model and deterministic replay methodology; offline oracle analysis for optimality.
- Key figures/results: Figure 1 (system overview); fault breakdown and the “faults to zero” results; curves across token budgets; overhead measurements (<50 μs/turn).
- Innovation checklist: (i) enforceable memory contract at the harness (not via prompts/plugins); (ii) invariants + multi-resolution pages for controlled degradation; (iii) validated non-destructive writeback at lifecycle boundaries; (iv) observable faults + deterministic replay + oracle upper bound for auditability and regression.

skim (overview):
- Read Introduction + Contributions; skim Background to see why pruning/retrieval/compaction are insufficient; jump to the main experimental tables (fault=0, success gains, overhead); then skim writeback and fault-model sections to understand the guarantees.
summary_en.authors_note: The paper’s thesis is that agent memory reliability cannot be solved by “better retrieval/longer context/smarter summaries” alone; it requires an OS-like, enforceable runtime contract and a fault model. The harness is the natural enforcement point because it already controls prompt assembly, tool mediation, and lifecycle events. The contribution is primarily systems engineering with verifiable guarantees: invariants, validated writeback, observable faults, and deterministic replay turn memory management from heuristic tuning into an auditable runtime mechanism.

recommendation.zh: 值得看其“虚拟内存式契约”定义：把状态丢失从提示工程问题升级为 harness 责任边界；动作是按 residency/durability 做可观测与强制 flush。
recommendation.en: Worth it for the “virtual-memory contract” framing: it shifts state loss from prompt hacks to harness responsibility; actionable takeaway is to enforce observable residency/durability + mandatory flush semantics.
